jobs.title: Sr. Product Analyst (Brazil & Argentina ONLY)
jobs.excerpt: About NicheNiche is the leader in school search.  Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free.
jobs.description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only. We will not be considering US based candidates at this time. All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

**Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**

Niche's product teams make dozens of decisions each quarter about what to build. We are looking for an analytically rigorous, product-minded Senior Product Analyst to help Niche decide what to build and know whether it worked. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded with our product teams and reporting to the Director of Product Analytics.

You will own how we measure key product areas across our family-facing and school-facing experiences, such as rankings, scholarships, registration, and new products. You will be a strategic partner to product leadership, not a request queue. That means shaping questions before work starts, running the experiments that answer them, and staying with the work through the decision.

Our analytics team works Claude-first: you will use Claude and Claude Code every day and help shape how the team and its partners use them.

What You Will Do

Product Strategy & Insight

  • Embed with product teams as their analytics partner. Join planning and roadmap conversations and help identify and size opportunities before work is prioritized
  • Define the metrics that matter for each product area and keep definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer
  • Own the measurement of product funnels, feature adoption, engagement, and retention for both families and school partners
  • Run deep-dive analyses on user behavior and segments, and pair every finding with a recommendation and a clear next step
  • Identify where users struggle or drop off and bring those opportunities to product managers proactively. Partner with Design and UX Research to pair behavioral data with qualitative insight

Experimentation

  • Own A/B tests with product teams end to end: design and sizing based on product requirements, guardrails and duration, tracking setup in GTM and GA4, and interpreting results with honest calls on signal versus noise
  • Contribute to experimentation standards and apply them across your teams so tests are tied to business outcomes, not just clicks
  • Measure launches that can't be randomized, using appropriate causal methods and clear statements of confidence

Measurement Partnership

  • Write clear measurement requirements and GA4 event specs for new features before launch, build and test the GTM tags, and partner with Data Engineering on server-side and pipeline needs
  • QA product data after launch, review GTM changes from partner teams, account for consent and tracking gaps, and flag quality issues early
  • Build and maintain the dashboards and self-serve views (Streamlit) that let product managers answer their own recurring questions.
  • Contribute to dbt models and the self-serve semantic layer with Data Engineering
  • Support new data systems and tracking changes, such as consent management, with reporting requirements, GA4 reconciliation, and launch measurement

Claude-Powered Analytics

  • Use Claude and Claude Code as core daily tools: writing and reviewing SQL, exploring data, drafting readouts, and building Streamlit apps
  • Build and maintain the semantic layer, Claude skills, and context (metric definitions, table guides, experiment standards) that make Claude reliable on Niche's data
  • Automate recurring work, such as test readouts, KPI monitoring, and launch reviews, with Claude-driven workflows
  • Keep pace with AI-assisted product development by using Claude to spot launches that need measurement
  • Help product managers self-serve with Claude: maintain the skills and sanctioned definitions they rely on, coach them on reading data, and review findings before they drive decisions
  • Help analysts and product partners adopt Claude, and help define the team's standards for validating its output

Analytical Rigor & Influence

  • Model rigor in product data: reproducible SQL, documented methods, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation
  • Hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own: check the queries, numbers, and logic before anything ships
  • Mentor analysts informally, and review and pressure-test analyses from the team and from product partners, including AI-assisted work
  • Present findings to product and company leadership with a clear "so what"

During the First Month:

  • Meet stakeholders across Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering to learn team goals, roadmaps, and workflows
  • Get set up with Claude, Claude Code, and the team's existing skills. Learn our stack (Snowflake, dbt, Streamlit, GA4 data) and how product events are defined and captured
  • Review existing product dashboards and reports to build a baseline view of core product KPIs

Within 3 Months:

  • Act as analytics partner to your assigned product teams, including defining metrics and reading out launches and tests
  • Write measurement requirements for upcoming launches with Data Engineering
  • Learn the boundaries and collaborations between Product Analytics and Data Engineering so ownership of shared data is clear

Within 6 Months:

  • Apply and help evolve experimentation standards across your teams
  • Become the go-to expert on product behavior data, presenting findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams
  • Ship at least one self-directed deep dive that influences a product decision, and build or improve one Claude skill or workflow the team reuses

Within 12 Months:

  • Use deep product and user knowledge to inform roadmap prioritization
  • Build a scalable measurement framework for your product areas that helps teams make data-informed decisions on their own
  • Contribute to the Analytics roadmap with new methods, tools, or process improvements

What We Are Looking For

Experience

  • 5+ years in product analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data role
  • Demonstrated experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and owning product measurement end to end
  • Hands-on experience analyzing web or app behavioral data (GA4, GTM, PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar), including its limitations
  • Hands-on experience using Claude, Claude Code, or similar AI tools in analytics work, with examples of workflows you built or automated
  • Track record of influencing product decisions and roadmaps with data
  • Proven ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations for non-technical partners, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question
  • Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities

Skills

  • Senior SQL proficiency; comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging complex queries independently
  • Strong grounding in statistics and experimentation, with Python or R for analysis
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work
  • Strong dashboarding skills in Streamlit, Looker, or similar
  • Fluency with Claude or similar AI tools: prompting well, giving models the right context, and checking every query and number they produce
  • Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority and working self-directed on ambiguous problems

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is a plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience building Claude skills, MCP connectors, or agent workflows for a team
  • Understanding of K-12 or college admissions processes
  • Experience with causal inference methods beyond A/B tests
  • Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer
  • Background in marketplace, consumer internet, SaaS, or education technology

Interview Process

Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

  • Video Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

  • Video Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes

  • Team Interview - 3 separate 30 Minutes Interviews

  • Case Study & Presentation w/ Analytics Team

  • Hiring Manager Follow-up if successful - 30 Minutes

**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only. We will not be considering US based candidates at this time. All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

**Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**

jobs.description:
At Flexspring, you will have the autonomy and flexibility to tackle your role in a way that is right for you. We foster a learning culture that will allow you to develop new skills and progress in your career.

Who We Are

Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) company specializing in HR data integrations. We partner with HR teams and HR software companies to design and deliver custom integrations that connect HR, payroll, and business systems, reduce manual work, improve data accuracy, and help people's operations run more efficiently.

The Role

As a PM at Flexspring, you’ll lead client-facing integration projects from initiation through delivery. You’ll partner closely with both French and English-speaking clients and internal teams to support the successful execution of technical workstreams.This role is a great fit for someone who has experience with HRIS and who loves to solve problems, plan, and execute projects in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do

  • Lead client-facing HRIS and Payroll integration projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions with HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT stakeholders to define scope, requirements, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Translate business and operational requirements into structured documentation, including data mapping and integration flow diagrams.
  • Coordinate internal technical consultants and external stakeholders to ensure alignment, accountability, and execution.
  • Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes — particularly where payroll timing, compliance, or downstream financial reporting may be impacted.
  • Monitor project health, communicate progress clearly, and drive decision-making when trade-offs are required.
  • Support post-launch validation and ensure integrations are operating as expected in real-world environments.
  • Identify expansion or optimization opportunities and prepare change requests where appropriate.

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 3+ years of project management experience delivering technology projects in a client-facing environment (SaaS, implementations, integrations, or similar).
  • Fluency in both French & English (written and verbal).
  • Experience working with HRIS and/or Payroll systems, or leading projects where employee/payroll data is a core input/output.
  • Ability to lead the full project lifecycle: kickoff → discovery → delivery → go-live → stabilization.
  • Strong requirements facilitation skills: running workshops, capturing decisions, and translating needs into clear project deliverables and documentation.
  • Solid fundamentals in scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and change control across multiple concurrent projects.
  • High ownership and follow-through in a fully remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
  • Experience delivering system-to-system integrations (APIs, SFTP, ETL/data transformations, middleware/iPaaS).
  • Familiarity with HR and Payroll platforms such as Workday, Oracle HCM, ADP, UKG, Ceridian Dayforce, BambooHR, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of payroll timing, data quality impacts, and downstream reporting needs (including cost centers and GL mapping).
  • Experience supporting multi-entity or multi-country environments.
  • Additional languages (French, Spanish, Arabic, others).

What You Get

  • Work from home with flexible hours.
  • 4 weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Comprehensive health benefits package for you and your family.
  • Team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • Competitive base salary.

For more information about Flexspring, visit:

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Flexspring is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. Flexspring is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Flexspring are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Flexspring does not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Flexspring encourages applicants of all ages.

*************************************************************************************************************************************

Chez Flexspring, vous aurez l'autonomie et la flexibilité nécessaires pour aborder votre rôle d'une manière qui vous convient. Nous favorisons une culture d'apprentissage qui vous permettra de développer de nouvelles compétences et de progresser dans votre carrière.

Qui nous sommes

Flexspring est une entreprise iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) spécialisée dans les intégrations de données RH. Nous collaborons avec des équipes RH et des entreprises de logiciels RH pour concevoir et livrer des intégrations personnalisées qui relient les systèmes RH, de paie et d'affaires, réduisent le travail manuel, améliorent l'exactitude des données et aident les opérations liées au personnel à fonctionner plus efficacement.

Le rôle

En tant que chef de projet chez Flexspring, vous dirigerez des projets d'intégration en contact avec la clientèle, du lancement jusqu'à la livraison. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec des clients francophones et anglophones ainsi qu'avec les équipes internes afin de soutenir la bonne exécution des volets techniques. Ce rôle convient parfaitement à une personne ayant de l'expérience avec les SIRH et qui aime résoudre des problèmes, planifier et exécuter des projets dans un environnement dynamique.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Diriger des projets d'intégration SIRH et de paie en contact avec la clientèle, du lancement jusqu'à la mise en production et la stabilisation.
  • Animer des séances de découverte avec les parties prenantes des RH, de la paie, des finances et de l'informatique afin de définir la portée, les exigences, les échéanciers et les critères de réussite.
  • Traduire les exigences opérationnelles et d'affaires en documentation structurée, y compris la cartographie des données et les diagrammes de flux d'intégration.
  • Coordonner les consultants techniques internes et les parties prenantes externes afin d'assurer l'alignement, la responsabilisation et l'exécution.
  • Gérer de manière proactive les risques, les dépendances et les changements de portée, particulièrement lorsque le calendrier de paie, la conformité ou les rapports financiers en aval peuvent être touchés.
  • Surveiller l'état d'avancement des projets, communiquer clairement les progrès et orienter la prise de décision lorsque des compromis sont nécessaires.
  • Soutenir la validation post-lancement et s'assurer que les intégrations fonctionnent comme prévu dans des environnements réels.
  • Repérer les occasions d'expansion ou d'optimisation et préparer des demandes de changement, le cas échéant.

Ce que vous apportez

Indispensable

  • 3 ans ou plus d'expérience en gestion de projet, à livrer des projets technologiques dans un environnement en contact avec la clientèle (SaaS, mises en œuvre, intégrations ou similaire).
  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (à l'écrit et à l'oral).
  • Expérience de travail avec des systèmes SIRH et/ou de paie, ou direction de projets où les données des employés ou de la paie constituent un intrant ou un extrant essentiel.
  • Capacité à diriger l'ensemble du cycle de vie d'un projet : lancement, découverte, livraison, mise en production, stabilisation.
  • Solides compétences en animation de la collecte des exigences : diriger des ateliers, consigner les décisions et traduire les besoins en livrables et documentation de projet clairs.
  • Bonnes bases en matière de portée, d'échéanciers, de risques, de dépendances et de contrôle des changements pour plusieurs projets simultanés.
  • Grand sens des responsabilités et rigueur dans le suivi, dans un environnement entièrement à distance.

Atout

  • Certification Project Management Professional (PMP) ou équivalent.
  • Expérience dans la livraison d'intégrations système à système (API, SFTP, transformations ETL ou de données, intergiciels ou iPaaS).
  • Connaissance des plateformes RH et de paie telles que Workday, Oracle HCM, ADP, UKG, Ceridian Dayforce, BambooHR ou similaires.
  • Solide compréhension du calendrier de paie, des répercussions sur la qualité des données et des besoins de rapports en aval (y compris les centres de coûts et la cartographie du grand livre).
  • Expérience dans le soutien d'environnements multi-entités ou multi-pays.
  • Langues additionnelles (français, espagnol, arabe, autres).

Ce que vous obtiendrez

  • Travail à domicile avec horaires flexibles.
  • 4 semaines de vacances payées par année.
  • Régime d'avantages sociaux complet pour vous et votre famille.
  • Événements d'équipe et occasions de rencontrer vos collègues.
  • Possibilité de travailler avec des technologies de pointe.
  • Salaire de base compétitif.

Pour plus d'informations sur Flexspring, visitez :

Déclaration d'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi

Flexspring est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et interdit toute forme de discrimination et de harcèlement. Flexspring s'engage envers le principe de l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi pour tous les employés et à offrir à ses employés un environnement de travail exempt de discrimination et de harcèlement. Toutes les décisions d'emploi chez Flexspring sont fondées sur les besoins de l'entreprise, les exigences du poste et les qualifications individuelles, sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion ou les croyances, l'origine nationale, sociale ou ethnique, le sexe (y compris la grossesse), l'âge, un handicap physique, mental ou sensoriel, le statut VIH, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'état matrimonial, l'union civile ou le statut de partenariat domestique, le service militaire passé ou présent, les antécédents médicaux familiaux ou les renseignements génétiques, la situation familiale ou parentale, ou tout autre statut protégé par les lois ou règlements en vigueur dans les lieux où nous exerçons nos activités. Flexspring ne tolère aucune discrimination ou harcèlement fondé sur l'une de ces caractéristiques. Flexspring encourage les candidats de tous âges à postuler.

jobs.description:
About the Position

At Thryv, we are a team that lives by teamwork. However, it’s not the work that drives us, it’s the respect, trust, and care for each other that defines us as a team. We’re a diverse community of trendsetters who do our best work in a fun, relaxed environment. Technology never stops evolving and neither do we. We’re always looking for the best and brightest team players to join us.

This role leads a team of engineers responsible for designing, developing, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing scalable, high-performance software and product applications. Leveraging industry best practices, the Manager of Software & Product Engineering plans and directs the resources and processes needed to execute the vision and strategy, delivering robust, customer-focused solutions that drive product innovation.

Responsibilities

  • Provides leadership, innovation, and direction to guide and support the Software & Product Engineering team, shaping the specifications and standards that guide scalable, high-quality development.
  • Leads a team of engineers responsible for coding, debugging, testing, and troubleshooting across the full development lifecycle to ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Assists in the determination of project milestones and delivery timelines. Manages resources to release products on time and within budget.
  • Evaluates application requirements and architects database solutions that ensure scalability, performance, and data integrity. Identifies tools and methodologies to streamline development.
  • Ensures the team meets project milestones and completes projects within the established timeline. Evaluates issues, provides resolution, and notifies senior leadership of any recurring issues. Organizes, manages, and reports on delivery for projects.
  • Drives continuous improvement activities, reviews progress reports, and recommends process improvements to facilitate development and implementation.
  • Establishes and/or approves team's operating policies and procedures and monitors to ensure efficient and effective workflow.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent), required.
  • Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 6+ years of related experience required.
  • 8+ years of related experience, preferred.
  • Experience in people management, software or product engineering experience collaborating with Product Managers and Designers in cross-functional teams, required.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub, JIRA, Confluence, CircleCI, required.
  • Experience developing in Agile, SCRUM, or similar iterative methodologies, required.
  • Experience in fast-growing companies or entrepreneurial environments, required.
  • GitHub or Stack Overflow profile showing contributions to open-source or personal projects, required.
  • Comprehensive industry knowledge with an understanding of best practices and processes related to leading software & product engineering teams.
  • Technical acumen with the ability to abstract from a detailed business requirement the necessary technical specifications to see how that detail can broadly be delivered utilizing all available tools and technologies.
  • Expert interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor and develop others and build strong working relationships with key stakeholders across the business.
  • Proven project management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities with competing deadlines or conflicting demands, implementing or adapting to change in work or procedure as needed.
  • Highly skilled in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Asana, etc. with the ability to utilize various programming languages, technology stacks, and related data technologies along with other internal and external integration frameworks.
  • Proven problem-solving skills with the ability to easily prototype and experiment.
  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Must successfully complete pre-employment screening process, as required.
  • Must successfully complete any required training or orientation courses, as needed.

What We Offer

Life requires balance. So we provide benefits around health and wellness, continued education, and work/life balance to help you live your best life when you’re working…and when you’re not.

  • Law benefits
  • Private medical insurance covered by us
  • Remote work
  • Life insurance
  • Education subsidy
  • Electricity & Internet subsidy
  • Flexible extra time off
  • Paid time off during winter
  • International discounts
  • Internal programs

Who We Are

At Thryv, we’re a team fiercely devoted to the success of local businesses. We’ve been around for over 100 years, always with one goal in mind — helping small businesses compete, win and succeed. We provide the technology, software and local business automation tools small business owners need to better manage their time, communicate with clients, and get paid, so they can take control of their business and be more successful.

We support businesses across the U.S. and we have team members all around the country (even internationally). In fact, we’re a work-from-anywhere company, because that’s how we get work done.

Culture is vital at Thryv because it shapes our identity and, therefore, our measurements for growth. We have an identified set of values that hold all of us accountable paving the way for our company success and our legacy. All of this helps us deliver results for our clients and creates success for our employees. At Thryv, making a positive impact within our team and in our local community is the reason we get out of bed every morning.

Thryv Core Values:

  • Client Devoted – Be humble with a servant mentality. Understand the uniqueness of each interaction while being flexible, knowledgeable, and genuine.
  • Under Promise, Over Deliver – Deliver expectations and exceed them, have accountability, listen and understand the ask.
  • Act Like You Own the Place – Taking ownership and accountability in your day-to-day decisions empowers you to act like you own the place.
  • Invest in our People – Hire people that are aligned with Thryv’s core values. Provide learning opportunities to enable all of us to adapt, belong, and create a lifelong career.
  • DONE3 – Define what you say (Done), Do what you say (Done), Follow up and ensure completion (Done).
  • Making $$ is a Byproduct of Helping People – Always be devoted to people, act with integrity.
  • Think Long Term, Act with Passion & Integrity – Focus on making every interaction exceptional. Bring enthusiasm and devotion to every act. This includes doing the right thing, even when no one is looking. Think five years out or think for the long play.

Find out more at corporate.thryv.com/careers/

Belonging at Thryv

We believe in a work environment where all individuals are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources, and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. We want our employees to feel a part of something big and we encourage the sharing of ideas and collaboration across the organization.

We strive to ensure our work environment reflects diversity, fairness and meritocracy. We believe all employees should have the opportunity to perform effectively in their position. We value every employee and the authenticity they bring to their role and to the organization. As a result, our employee policies and internal practices focus on ability and merit as the standards for success.

The duties and responsibilities in this job description may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

The final job level offered may vary based on the applicant’s competencies and qualifications such as experience and education, and other job-related reasons.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Thryv is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, without regard to gender, color, race, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any characteristic protected by law. Admissions Representative
American Public University/American Military University

The Admissions Representative partners with potential students interested in attending American Military University and American Public University. This role is expected to help potential students discover goals, needs, and advise toward solutions, and enrollment decisions, work toward an action plan to achieve goals, and ultimately make admissions decisions regarding student fulfillment of admissions requirements. The Admissions Representative uses marketing materials/opportunities provided by American Public University System (APUS) to serve assigned potential students as determined by management. This is a student facing professional position in higher education. It reports to either an Admissions Manager or Senior Admissions Manager, who report to a Director of Admissions or Director of Prospect Management, who report to the Vice President of Admissions.

Responsibilities:

  • Consults and advises potential students to jointly discover goals, advise toward solutions around degree planning, payment, transfer credit, and other enrollment decisions, and implement an action plan to support students in achieving identified goals
  • Provides regular follow up to potential students in an efficient and timely manner either via telephone, email, or other electronic means. Makes educated admissions decisions regarding fulfillment of admission requirements and follow-up strategies
  • Protects the privacy of student accounts through compliance with federal student privacy law (Family Education Rights and Privacy Act).
  • Evaluates the academic records and documents of potential students for admission to APU/AMU programs.
  • Demonstrates skill in using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and other software applications used in Admissions.
  • Resolves routine and escalated concerns with and on behalf of potential students in a professional, efficient manner.
  • Maintains a productive working relationship with other University departments, such as Financial Aid, Fulfillment, Veteran and GI Bill assistance, Student Services and Marketing.
  • Meets or exceeds performance goals and metrics as determined by department leadership.
  • Keeps a professional appearance at all times.
  • Adheres to assigned work schedule
  • Follows campaigns and follow-up strategies for student recruitment and enrollment
  • Performs other duties and assists with special projects as assigned by department leadership

  • Per the US Department of Education Program Integrity Rules, postsecondary institutions that participate in the student financial assistance programs pursuant to Title IV of the Higher Education Act (HEA) are barred from providing incentive payments to any person or entity engaged in student recruiting and/or admissions activities.

Requirements:

  • 1-2 years of work experience in telemarketing, sales, service, online or higher education preferred
  • Associates Degree required

About Us:

American Public University System (the System) is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) (www.hlcommission.org), an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. HLC accredits degree-granting institutions nationwide and is also recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation. The System is comprised of American Military University, American Public University, Rasmussen University, and Hondros College of Nursing. The System is authorized by the West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission and other appropriate agencies in the states where it has campuses. The System is authorized to operate as a postsecondary educational institution by the Illinois Board of Higher Education. American Public University System, Inc., which operates the System, is a wholly owned subsidiary of American Public Education, Inc. American Public University System, American Public University, and American Military University are not affiliated with American University or the U.S. Military.

It is the policy of American Public University System (APUS) to afford equal opportunity to all qualified persons. We treat all qualified individuals equally as to their recruitment, hiring, assignments, advancements, compensation, and all other terms and conditions of employment. American Public University System (APUS) does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, or physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Title: Customer Experience Agent

Reporting To: Customer Experience Lead

Job Summary

The Customer Support Agent is in charge of responding to all inquiries and correspondence we receive from customers across multiple touchpoints – this includes phone, chat, and email. This role is in charge of resolving customer complaints, processing refunds and replacements when needed and providing the best possible customer service to anyone who tries to contact us through the proper channels.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Customer Interaction Across Channels:

  • Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via phone, chat, reviews, email, and platform-specific messaging (Amazon, Walmart, Macy's, TikTok, Shopify).
  • Use approved canned responses where applicable, while also providing personalized support as needed.
  • Manage Address, Fraud, and Operator Holds following the processes outlined in the SOP.

Order Inquiries on TikTok and Shopify:

  • Monitor Amazon performance metrics related to customer service (e.g., response time, satisfaction ratings) and work to maintain high standards.

ShipHero:

  • Manage Shipment tracking, returns, and order holds.

Phone Support:

  • Receive inbound customer calls and address concerns related to orders, products, or service issues.
  • Escalate unresolved issues appropriately while ensuring the customer feels heard and supported.
  • Log all calls and outcomes accurately into the support system.

General Support Responsibilities:

  • Proactively identify recurring customer issues and suggest improvements to internal processes or FAQs.
  • Stay up to date with product knowledge, promotions, and policy changes.
  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and feedback loops to continuously improve support quality.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in a customer support or customer service role, ideally supporting e-commerce or DTC brands
  • Hands-on experience using Gorgias as a CRM is required (must be comfortable managing tickets, macros, tags, and workflows)
  • Demonstrated experience handling chat, email, and voice (phone) support in a fast-paced customer service environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adapt tone across different support channels
  • Experience supporting customers across multiple platforms such as Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopify, or similar e-commerce channels
  • Proven ability to resolve customer complaints, order issues, refunds, and returns with empathy and professionalism
  • Comfortable using canned responses while knowing when to personalize communication to ensure a positive customer experience
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately document interactions, refunds, returns, and call outcomes
  • Ability to investigate order-related issues including delayed, lost, or incorrect shipments and escalate when appropriate
  • Familiarity with customer service KPIs such as response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction metrics
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple customer inquiries simultaneously
  • Willingness to work shifting schedules, including coverage across different time zones if required
  • Comfortable using time-tracking tools and support systems to accurately log hours and customer interactions
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to identify recurring issues and suggest process or FAQ improvements

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Windchill Java Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.


Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Windchill Java Developer focused on deep, low-level Windchill customizations using Java, PTC APIs, and PTC’s customization frameworks. This role suits engineers who enjoy working close to the platform, extending its behavior through services, listeners, and processors while preserving a clean and upgrade-friendly customization layer. The ideal candidate will bring strong Java fundamentals, deep familiarity with the Windchill platform internals, and a disciplined, performance-aware engineering style. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop advanced Java customizations within Windchill, including custom services, listeners, processors, validators, and helpers.
  • Extend the Windchill data model with custom types, attributes, and relationships using Type and Attribute Management (TAM).
  • Build custom JSP and HTML extensions, including custom tables, actions, and wizard pages.
  • Develop custom queues and background processes for asynchronous Windchill tasks.
  • Implement complex workflow expressions and robot delegates in Java, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize performance of Java customizations, including profiling, query tuning, and caching strategies.
  • Adhere strictly to PTC customization best practices, ensuring upgrade-friendly customizations.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy customizations to modern PTC-supported patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Conduct code reviews and uphold internal engineering standards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of Java development experience, with strong focus on Windchill customization.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Windchill Java API and customization frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of Windchill data model, lifecycle, and workflow internals.
  • Strong Java OO design and performance-engineering skills.
  • Experience with JSP, HTML, and Windchill client-side customization.
  • Hands-on experience with Type and Attribute Management (TAM).
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Oracle or SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting Windchill upgrades.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PTC Windchill development certifications.
  • Experience with PTC ThingWorx development.
  • Exposure to Windchill RV&S customization.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tooling for Windchill.

Contract Job Title: Recruiter

Reports to: Talent Acquisition Manager

Location: Remote (Preference for Mountain or Pacific Time Zone)
Status: Independent Contractor/Consultant

Term: November 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027 (initial training to take place in November 2026 and interviewing support to follow). Potential for this scope of services to be renewed annually, contingent on performance and funding.

Hours & Schedule: This position is structured as an on-call opportunity to assist with interviewing. During periods of active hiring, you can expect to work approximately 10 to 20 hours per week, though schedules will vary based on organizational needs and hours are not guaranteed.

Contract Fee:$30 to 45 per Hour; fee placement within range will be based upon professional and academic experience as it relates to the required qualifications of this contract position.

About Blueprint Schools Network

Founded in 2010, Blueprint Schools Network (“Blueprint”) is a national nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing educational equity and improving student outcomes. Blueprint partners with states, districts, and schools to design and implement evidence-based school improvement initiatives that help students thrive academically and beyond.

The Blueprint Math Fellows Program was developed from Blueprint’s research-based school improvement framework, which identifies the practices most strongly associated with student success. Central to this work is high-impact, small-group math instruction tailored to students’ individual learning needs. Since launching in 2010, the program has helped schools accelerate math achievement through data-driven tutoring and targeted academic support.

Blueprint partners with public school districts and charter school networks in Oakland, CA; Phoenix, Yuma, Apache Junction, Miami, and Sierra Vista, AZ; Saint Louis, MO; Plainville, CT; and Washington, DC to implement high-impact math tutoring programs that support students and schools.

The Opportunity

Blueprint Schools Network is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Contract Recruiter to support staffing needs across our national network on an as-needed, on-call basis (10–20 hours per week).

In this role, you will lead end-to-end recruitment efforts for critical positions, including Blueprint Math Fellows (tutors), internal positions and consultants. The ideal candidate thrives in an agile environment, moves quickly to build candidate pipelines, and brings a passion for our mission.

Key Responsibilities

1. Candidate Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Proactively source qualified candidates via Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, university career centers, education networks, and referral programs.
  • Target recruitment efforts to attract diverse, mission-aligned candidates.
  • Build and maintain an active pool of talent for recurring and urgent hiring needs.

2. Full-Cycle Recruitment Execution

  • Screen resumes and conduct preliminary phone interviews to assess qualifications, mission fit, and availability.
  • Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
  • Manage high-volume applicant pipelines through JazzHR - Blueprint’s Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

3. Hiring Partner & Candidate Experience

  • Deliver a high-touch, responsive candidate experience from initial contact through offer stage.
  • Maintain clear communication with Talent Acquisition Manager and internal leadership regarding candidate pipelines, time-to-fill metrics, and sourcing strategies.
  • Conduct reference checks and assist with onboarding handoffs as requested.

Hours & On-Call Structure

  • Hours: Variable between 10 to 20 hours per week, based on active requisition volume and organizational hiring cycles (e.g., peak seasonal hiring for school-year positions). Availability to accommodate interviews in Mountain and Pacific time zones.
  • Schedule: Flexible and remote; hours are allocated dynamically as hiring needs arise.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years of talent acquisition/recruitment experience. Prior experience in K–12 education, charter management networks, tutoring organizations, or educational nonprofits is strongly preferred.
  • Sourcing Skills: Demonstrated track record of proactive passive sourcing and running high-volume recruiting campaigns.
  • Tech Savvy: Proficiency with modern Applicant Tracking Systems, Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, and Google Workspace.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to represent Blueprint warmly and professionally to prospective candidates.
  • Independence: Strong self-management skills to operate independently in a flexible, variable-hour contract engagement.

Terms of Service

  • Engagement: This is an independent contractor role.
  • Schedule: Remote, ability to work across multiple US time zones as needed to support interview availability (EST, MST, PST).
  • Compliance: Must successfully clear Blueprint background screenings.
  • Onboarding: Training will be provided by the Blueprint Program and Human Capital Teams.

Blueprint Schools Network is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.excerpt: At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society.
jobs.description:
At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.

R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, and J.P. Morgan. We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling our operations across multiple markets.

As a Consolidation & Reporting Associate (IC2), you will be responsible for preparing the group’s monthly consolidation and financial reporting across all entities where R2 operates, and will actively participate in the monthly accounting close and financial control activities.

You will report to the Accounting Lead and will work closely with our Controllership, FP&A, Treasury/FinOps and Capital Markets teams and interact with multiple stakeholders in different countries.

What you’ll work on

  • Perform the monthly consolidation process for the group’s entities, including intercompany eliminations, FX translation (IAS 21) and consolidation adjustments under IFRS 10.
  • Prepare the monthly reporting package (BS, P&L, cash flow and flux analysis) for leadership, the Board and investors.
  • Prepare the entities’ individual and consolidated annual financial statements under IFRS, including notes and disclosures, in line with group accounting policies.
  • Support the monthly accounting close across the group’s entities, ensuring accuracy and adherence to closing deadlines.
  • Prepare accruals, provisions and accounting estimates (e.g., bonuses and other accrued expenses), and support expected credit loss (ECL) calculations.
  • Perform intercompany reconciliations and support resolution of discrepancies across multiple entities.
  • Analyze the entities’ trial balances and key account fluctuations, ensuring balances are accurate, properly classified and ready for consolidation.
  • Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance the efficiency and quality of accounting operations.
  • Support external and internal audits by preparing documentation, schedules, and responding to audit requests.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of accounting policies, internal controls, and finance procedures.
  • Work closely with external service providers (BPOs and advisors) to ensure accurate and timely accounting deliverables.

Who you are

  • 4+ years of accounting experience, including at least 2 years in consolidation and/or group reporting.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and active CRC registration.
  • Advanced English (written and spoken); Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, with hands-on experience in group consolidation (IFRS 10, IAS 21), including intercompany eliminations and multi-entity, multi-currency structures.
  • Experience preparing individual and consolidated financial statements, disclosures, and management/Board reporting packages.
  • Experience with ERP consolidation modules (e.g., NetSuite) or consolidation tools is a plus.
  • Experience with month-end close processes, provisions and accounting estimates, and financial statement preparation.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems; SQL or BI tools are a plus.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or multinational, multi-jurisdiction environments is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience at a Big Four accounting firm is a plus.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus

  • A growth mindset and the ambition to develop quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Enthusiasm for solving problems and interest in navigating high complexity.
  • A proactive approach to improving processes, reducing manual work, and enhancing operational efficiency.
  • Experience working with finance data workflows and automation initiatives within accounting and reporting processes.

Job Title: Enterprise Account Executive

Job Location:

  • US Remote — This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Enterprise Account Executives land new business within our largest prospective accounts. You are responsible for running full-cycle enterprise sales motions — from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close — bringing our Predictive Revenue System to enterprise organizations for the first time.

This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying closing role focused on new logo acquisition within the enterprise segment. You will build multi-stakeholder relationships within target accounts, run consultative sales cycles, and use our own AI-powered platform to manage your pipeline and forecast with precision. As you build a track record here, this role is a natural path toward Enterprise Account Director responsibility over our most strategic existing accounts.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle within an assigned book of target accounts — from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close.
  • Build relationships across multiple stakeholders within target accounts, including senior and C-level executives.
  • Develop and execute account and territory plans that consistently generate and convert enterprise-segment pipeline.
  • Run consultative, outcome-focused conversations that connect the Salesloft platform to enterprise-scale revenue impact.
  • Use AI-surfaced buyer signals, deal-health scoring, and pipeline intelligence to manage your pipeline and forecast accurately.
  • Coordinate internal resources — Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing — to support your deals through close.

This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll drive enterprise sales cycles proactively, and use AI-native selling tools to manage complexity that would overwhelm a less disciplined approach. And in the spirit of how we are Customer-Inspired, you'll win new business by making enterprise buyers genuinely more successful — not by out-muscling a procurement process.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a driven enterprise seller with a track record of running full-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals and consistently hitting quota. You are comfortable building a business case with a champion and then carrying that case all the way to a C-level decision-maker.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you forecast your pipeline honestly, let buyer signals and deal data drive your strategy, and bring intellectual honesty to where a deal really stands rather than sandbagging or overselling it. You are strategic, resilient, and driven to consistently exceed an enterprise quota.

This is the right role if you want to build a career closing the deals that define a category-leading platform's enterprise presence.

THE TEAM:

The Salesloft Enterprise Sales organization is responsible for hunting and closing net new business. Account Executives here run full-cycle new-business motions within the enterprise segment, working closely with Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success, and alongside Enterprise Account Directors who manage our most strategic existing relationships.

The team Moves as One — Account Executives, SEs, and marketing share ownership of new-logo wins and coordinate directly on complex pursuits. And we are relentlessly Customer-Inspired: enterprise deals are won by demonstrating genuine, executive-level value, because our largest customers stay and grow only when the platform makes them measurably more successful.

THE SKILL SET:

  • 5+ years of proven net-new hunting and closing experience in B2B SaaS, with a track record of closing full-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals and consistently meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect into and qualify enterprise-segment accounts, not just work inbound pipeline.
  • Experience building relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders within large organizations.
  • Strong account and territory planning skills.
  • Excellent consultative communication skills, with the ability to lead outcome-focused conversations with senior buyers.
  • Experience selling a sales engagement, revenue intelligence, or revenue operations platform — Salesloft, Clari, Gong, Outreach, or adjacent tools.
  • Fluency with AI-powered selling tools — deal-health scoring, buyer-signal prioritization, or pipeline intelligence.
  • Experience with a structured sales methodology such as MEDDIC or MEDDPICC.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Senior Event-Driven Researcher to strengthen the firm’s ability to interpret complex, fast-moving situations inside crypto markets.

The role focuses on crypto-native event catalysts—regulatory developments, protocol governance, token unlocks, and special situations—and translating them into actionable insight and tradeable opportunities.

You’ll research and synthesize fragmented and evolving information into a coherent view of what matters, what does not, and how it should inform positioning and risk for the firm.

This role sits within a best-in-class crypto research operation, where research directly informs decision-making and ideas are rigorously challenged and debated.

You'll work alongside on-chain and real-time intelligence teams, with access to unique data sources and proprietary tooling that most crypto firms don't have.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advance the firm’s understanding of event-driven situations by developing deep, context-rich views that provide informational edge over the market. You'll own situations end-to-end, maintaining a running view as facts and narratives evolve.
  • Monitor and interpret new information as it emerges, exercising judgment to distinguish signal from noise and clearly communicate what matters, what does not, and how it changes the decision set/probability tree.
  • Identify actionable, asymmetric opportunities early, grounded in a well-developed understanding of the situation rather than reactive interpretation.
  • Contribute to the development of the firm’s research capabilities, working with engineering to shape tools and workflows that support our event-driven trading style.

Requirements

  • Prior experience (5 years+) in information and flows-driven research or trading, within a tier1 buy-side or proprietary trading environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in event-driven settings, where outcomes depend on interpreting incomplete information, incentives, and evolving situations rather than static fundamentals.
  • Comfort engaging with a wide range of event-driven situations, requiring intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly build conviction across diverse topics.
  • Deep crypto experience is not required, but you should demonstrate genuine intellectual curiosity about the space and a credible path to ramping up quickly.

Backgrounds that tend to translate well include roles in macro, EM, FX, commodities, event-driven or special situations research, and other environments where information flow, positioning, and timing are central.

Backgrounds that tend to be a weaker fit include highly systematic or delta-neutral strategies, and roles focused primarily on long-only fundamental analysis rather than events and decision-making under uncertainty.

Desired Attributes

  • Ability to go deep into details when required, while maintaining a holistic view of the situation and its implications.
  • Ability to hold and adapt coherent views as situations evolve.
  • Comfort with rigorous debate, constructive challenge, and the ability to collaborate effectively across research, trading, and engineering teams.
  • Strong intrinsic motivation to become an exceptional, top-tier researcher.

Interview Process

  • CV Screening – Review of your background and experience relative to the role.
  • Initial Interview – Discussion focused on your ability to ask the right questions, exercise judgment with incomplete information, and frame event-driven situations.
  • Technical / Case Interview – Evaluation of problem solving and writing skills.
  • Co-Founder/CIO Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience - We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

We’re solving problems that no one has been able to solve before. This is an opportunity to join a team that is transforming the way that supply chains are structured.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

You have a knack for problem solving and are always seeking to learn more about accounting and bookkeeping. If you take immense satisfaction from getting a difficult reconciliation to balance or solving what feels unsolvable you would be a good fit for our team.

Who We Are

Treewalk is an advisory practice based out of downtown Vancouver specializing in financial reporting and corporate services for public companies. We offer clients a complete service package to assist them with timely and accurate disclosures. Our clients are from all industry sectors and are issuers on the TSX-V, CSE, NASDAQ, and the OTC.

We are one of the fastest growing accounting firms in Canada, and we’ve got some big goals that are going to send us to the top. We are a firm with an anti-firm culture - think tech startup, but accounting. We’re ditching the traditional top-down management hierarchy approach and are leaning into a Holacratic system of organizational governance. We are on a journey to become the go-to training place for accountants of all levels who want to work in industry. Our accounting practice specializes in assisting public companies with their financial reporting and accounting needs, and we help private companies navigate the waters of going and staying public. When it comes to clients, we are industry-agnostic. We never shy away from clients in new and emergent industries, and we’ve worked with companies in e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, cannabis, mining, and biotechnology, to name a few. We’ve got a lot on the go, and as far as we’re concerned, the only barrier to reaching our goals is finding exceptional talent to keep building out our team.

Our Core Values

Mastery: At Treewalk, we pursue knowledge. We aspire to be the best at our craft, and we create and pursue opportunities to build on our expertise.
Support: At Treewalk, you're never alone. Teamwork and collaboration are our bedrock, and constant support for each other and our clients is what sets us apart.
Ownership: At Treewalk, we fight to take responsibility. We own our mistakes and our oversights and are relentlessly committed to our responsibility to our colleagues and our clients.
Kaizen: At Treewalk, we don't settle. Kaizen is a business philosophy that means "change for the better", or "continuous improvement". We recognize that nothing is perfect, but we're striving for it anyway.

What will your days look like

 

  • Bookkeeping for multiple public and private clients that work in a variety of exciting industries - Have a particular industry of interest? We will do everything we can to get you the experience you want. Industries we work with include e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, cannabis, blockchain, mining and biotechnology

  • Is interested in taking on challenging work to grow their skills within a supportive learning environment
  • Embraces new technology
  • Is extremely detail-oriented and meticulous, even to the point where some might find it annoying

Bonuses would be…

  •  Previous accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Customer service or client service experience

Application Requirements

Even if your graduation date isn’t for a little while we are still interested in talking with you!

Benefits

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
