jobs.title: Director, Technical Account Management
jobs.excerpt: Total Expert is the Customer Operating System for financial services.
jobs.description:
Total Expert is the Customer Operating System for financial services. Our purpose-built platform combines a system of context with a system of action that enables humans and AI Assistants to engage in the moments that matter and earn customers for life. Since 2016 Total Expert has enabled more than seven trillion dollars of funded loan volume.

Technical Account Management is one of three pillars of Total Expert's Customer Success organization, alongside Customer Success Management and Customer Success Operations. The TAM team brings technical depth inside accounts and delivers Admin Copilot, Total Expert's subscription-based technical services offering sold in time blocks.

The mandate for this role is to build on the foundation already in place and take it to a durable growth engine: one that compounds by continuously expanding what the team is capable of delivering, creating additional customer demand.

We are looking for a leader who runs this like a business: owns the growing recurring revenue, builds delivery capability ahead of demand, uses AI and Total Expert extensibility toolsets to expand what a subscribed hour can accomplish, and makes realized value so visible that expansion becomes the customer's idea.

Technical depth is the raw material of this offering. What customers subscribe to (integrations, journey automation creation and optimization, data hygiene, reporting, and platform optimization) is technical work, so the ceiling on what we can sell is the ceiling on what this team can competently build. This leader is expected to know the Total Expert platform and its extensibility surface deeply enough to see what is possible, and to raise the team's technical bar deliberately and continuously.

For candidates based in the Coppell, TX or Minneapolis, MN area, the position follows a hybrid schedule with 3 on-site days per week. This position would be remote for qualifying candidates residing outside of those areas.

What you'll be doing

Grow Admin Copilot into a scaled subscription business

  • Own the Admin Copilot revenue line (contracted CARR, net time-block expansion, and retention of subscribed blocks) and forecast it within CS with the same rigor as any other recurring subscription service.
  • Drive expansion as a repeatable motion: surface accounts consuming beyond their subscribed blocks, quantify the value already delivered, and partner with CSMs and Sales to convert that demand into additional blocks well ahead of renewal.
  • Lead the conversion of legacy "designated TAM" and POD-funded work into support functions or paid, papered services that deliver value customers are willing to subscribe to, migrating remaining accounts onto the Admin Copilot model without destabilizing the relationship.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales and Professional Services on pricing, packaging, rate and ARR tracking, including resolving scope overlap with Professional Services and establishing a clear ownership line.

Continuously expand team capability and the service catalog

  • Expand the scope of what Admin Copilot delivers, shifting the team from reactive configuration support toward proactive optimization. Every new capability becomes new addressable scope and a new reason for a customer to subscribe to more hours.
  • Make AI-enabled delivery the operating norm: use AI tooling and Total Expert extensibility tools to increase the throughput and sophistication of a subscribed hour, and build it into how the team works rather than running it as a perpetual pilot.
  • Productize what the team proves once (reference integrations, journey blueprints, reusable query and reporting libraries, automation scripts, and documented build patterns), so a capability delivered once can be delivered many times at a predictable cost.
  • Define and maintain the service catalog with unambiguous boundaries: what belongs in Admin Copilot, what routes to an SOW, and what should no longer consume TAM capacity at all.
  • Evolve POD boundaries so every request lands in the right delivery motion, reducing POD dependency while protecting the customer experience.

Own the technical standard

  • Define the technical competency model for the team (what a TAM must be able to do unaided at each level across platform configuration, integrations, data and AI tooling), and certify against it rather than assume it.
  • Set and enforce technical quality standards for work performed in customer environments: documented configuration, change control, testing before deployment, and a rollback path.
  • Own the team's technical enablement as the platform evolves, including early adoption of extensibility and AI capabilities, such as the Total Expert MCP server, while they are still maturing.

Run delivery with capacity and margin discipline

  • Own capacity planning across delivery models (Admin Copilot, POD, and transitional designated-TAM), modeling utilization, backlog and hiring needs against the revenue forecast so staffing leads demand while the mix deliberately shifts toward subscription.
  • Hold the delivery standard: turnaround commitments, backlog health and consistent execution quality.
  • Lead technical depth inside customer accounts: activation acceleration, configuration, data hygiene and optimization work that drives adoption and product penetration.

Make realized value visible

  • Build AI-enabled Admin Copilot value reporting (hours delivered, work completed, in flight and backlogged, with the associated value attached), so every renewal conversation starts from evidence.
  • Partner with CS Operations and data teams on Planhat and success metric reporting, built on queryable platform and usage data rather than hand-built tallies, so the value story is repeatable and automated.
  • Arm CSMs and Sales teams with proof of value from Admin Copilot customers they can use directly in renewal, risk mitigation and expansion conversations.

Build and lead the team

  • Lead and grow a team of Technical Account Managers and Team Leads, and design the org structure the next phase of scope expansion requires.
  • Create career paths, specialization and enablement that build genuine platform and lending-domain depth, and develop Team Leads who can own delivery quality independently.
  • Define and mature the necessary roles as Admin Copilot evolves (AI-enabled operations, solution-oriented technical talent), and build hiring practices that evaluate technical skill directly.
  • Set team accountability and performance metrics, and enforce standards tied to both customer outcomes and business results.

Partner across Total Expert

  • Customer Success Management: joint account strategy, renewal risk mitigation and expansion plays.
  • CS Operations: health scoring, account signals, and EBR/QBR and renewal tooling.
  • Product and Engineering: a disciplined customer feedback loop, roadmap influence, and the platform and extensibility capabilities this service depends on.
  • Sales: attach Admin Copilot in new business and expansion motions, and equip sellers to position it credibly.
  • Finance: forecasting, pricing, and clean revenue tracking for a subscription service delivered in time blocks.
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally and the trusted technical advisor externally.

Technical expertise

Total Expert platform mastery

  • Expert-level command of platform configuration: journey orchestration and automation (multi-step, branching, trigger and audience logic), lead management and routing, segmentation and customer intelligence, AI-assisted sales tooling, content and template management, co-branding, and compliance approval workflows.
  • Enterprise-scale administration: user, role and permission models, org hierarchy and multi-brand structures, and the downstream implications of each for data access and reporting.
  • Able to translate a lender's actual business process (lead to application to funded loan to customer for life, loan officer and branch structure, marketing compliance review) into configuration that holds up at enterprise scale.

Integration strategy

  • Fluent in how APIs, webhooks and event-driven integrations work, enough to lead a strategic conversation with a customer's technology leaders about how Total Expert connects to their LOS, POS, pricing engines, CRM and martech stack, and where stitching those systems together creates compounding value.
  • Able to assess an integration approach at the design-conversation level (what data should flow, in which direction, triggered by what, and with what tradeoffs and risks), and to direct the team or partners who build it.
  • Knows where an integration need belongs: Admin Copilot, an SOW, a partner, or the product roadmap.

Data fluency

  • Understands how platform and usage data is structured and what it can answer: able to frame the right questions, interpret results critically, and direct the TAMs and analysts who write the queries.
  • Able to scope and direct data hygiene efforts (deduplication, normalization, hierarchy resolution and reconciliation across systems), and to hold the team to proving the result.
  • Defines the metrics that make Admin Copilot value defensible at renewal, and knows when a number is trustworthy and when it is an artifact of the data.

AI capabilities

  • A fluent personal user of modern AI tooling, able to turn AI-assisted workflows for configuration, QA, documentation and value reporting into standard team practice.
  • Working understanding of agentic tooling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP): how an MCP server exposes platform capability to an AI client, and how to put that to work inside a delivery team to expand what a subscribed hour accomplishes or can deliver to a customer.
  • Sound judgment about AI output: where it is reliable, where it requires human verification, how to evaluate quality, and how to handle customer data responsibly inside AI workflows.
  • Able to tell the difference between AI that genuinely expands delivery capability and AI that only relocates the effort.

Development landscape

  • Understands the development landscape (APIs, SQL, scripting languages such as Python and JavaScript, middleware and iPaaS, AI agents) well enough to judge what is possible, what effort it takes, and which skills the team needs to deliver it.
  • Uses that understanding to set technical skill targets for the team, scope work accurately, and match the right technical talent to the right problems.
  • Comfortable in the operating tooling of technical delivery (Jira, Confluence, support and knowledge base platforms), and able to read a technical escalation well enough to judge its severity and route it.

Compliance and security fluency

  • Understands the compliance surface this work touches: TCPA and DNC implications, consent capture and suppression, audit logging, and communication controls, and positions platform capability as enablement, recognizing that regulatory responsibility rests with the lender.
  • Handles PII and NPI appropriately, understands role-based access and data retention expectations, and can engage credibly with a customer's security and compliance reviewers.

What we're looking for:

Required

  • Leadership experience: Leading a customer-facing technical delivery organization (technical account management, managed services, professional services or technical customer success), including leading through managers or team leads.
  • Commercial ownership: Accountability for a services or subscription revenue line, with real ownership of growth, expansion and forecast accuracy. Experience turning an informal or unpaid service motion into a priced, packaged, papered offering is a strong signal.
  • Delivery economics: Capacity planning, utilization and backlog management in a billable or subscribed-hours model, with the analytical ability to build both the value case and the staffing case.
  • Platform depth: Credibility at the administration and configuration level of a complex, highly configurable SaaS platform, able to earn the trust of customer administrators and technology leaders, and to engage substantively with Product and Engineering. If that depth was built on another platform, demonstrated ability to reach expert level on ours quickly.
  • Technical leadership: Strategic fluency in APIs, integrations and data, enough to shape how platforms are stitched together to create customer value, and to direct the technical talent who build it. You should be able to walk through an integration or data initiative you led: the decisions you made and why.
  • AI leverage: Demonstrated use of AI and automation to expand what a delivery team can take on, not merely to reduce effort. This includes familiarity with agentic or MCP-style tooling.
  • Cross-functional range: Partnering with Finance and Sales on pricing and packaging, and holding clear scope boundaries with Professional Services.
  • Executive presence: Working with high-profile, strategic customers at the executive level, including ownership of escalations and difficult commercial conversations.
  • People development: People management and development grounded in accountability, continuous learning and improvement, including building technical skill in others, not only managing their workload.
  • Up to 10% travel.

Preferred

  • Mortgage, banking, credit union or broader financial services background, including familiarity with LOS, POS and pricing engines and the martech ecosystem lenders rely on.
  • Vertical SaaS experience, particularly in a regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with Planhat, or comparable customer success platforms.
  • Experience with AI and MCP or similar AI integration tooling in a delivery context.
  • Experience building a technical certification or competency program for a delivery team.
  • Experience with BI and visualization tooling beyond spreadsheets.

Compensation/Benefits: The anticipated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 annually. Final total compensation offered is dependent upon the selected individual's qualifications and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on company performance and other factors. As an employee of the company, you will be eligible to participate in the Employee Stock Option Plan. This is a remote position.

Job Title: SNAP EBT Planning Consultant

Work Arrangement: Remote

Location: Remote, United States

Employment Type: Contract (approximately 29 months, starting on or about January 1, 2027)

Engagement Type: W-2 or 1099 ($40 to $50 per hour)

Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring a SNAP EBT Planning Consultant on behalf of its client, a state human services agency. The consultant will guide the agency through the re-procurement of its Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) services, from updating the EBT services RFP and preparing the federal Advance Planning Documents, through the evaluation of vendor responses, to acceptance testing of the new EBT system. The consultant will build and maintain the project timeline, keep every activity on track with U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Service (USDA FNS) deadlines, and work closely with agency leadership, the state evaluation team, FNS and the EBT processor. The engagement is expected to run approximately 29 months, starting on or about January 1, 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the project timeline for the EBT re-procurement and make sure all activities meet USDA FNS deadlines.
  • Review the agency's SNAP EBT Services RFP and prepare updated drafts that address current federal requirements, including SNAP EBT regulations, FNS policy guidance and procedures, provisions of the Agricultural Act of 2018 and later amendments, and industry technical standards such as the Quest Operating Rules applicable to SNAP.
  • Research and document the state's business and technical requirements and build them into the RFP.
  • Take part in project calls with USDA FNS on the re-procurement RFP and the Advance Planning Document, and help the agency evaluate and implement FNS recommendations and changes.
  • Develop the plan the agency's team will use to evaluate RFP responses, including technical and cost evaluation criteria, the pricing evaluation structure, and scoring guidelines aligned with the state's statutory RFP evaluation criteria.
  • Prepare training materials, train the evaluation team on the evaluation tools (on site or virtually), and compile scores and summary documents that support the final award decision.
  • Develop and submit for FNS approval the Implementation Advance Planning Document (IAPD), and IAPD Updates (IAPDU) as needed, in line with the current FNS Handbook 901 and all applicable federal regulations. This includes the transmittal letter, executive summary, functional requirements, general system design, capacity study, project management plan and resource requirements, security planning, training plan, schedule of activities, milestones and deliverables, cost allocation plan, and proposed budget.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Test Plan, following FNS Handbook 901, Section 3.5.24, that defines the testing types (unit, integration, performance, end-to-end, user acceptance, regression and fail-safe testing), test team roles and responsibilities, test databases, test cases and scripts, the test schedule, acceptance testing procedures, Go/No-Go criteria, and contingency plans to revert to the legacy system.
  • Manage all testing processes and coordinate testing activities with the EBT processor to confirm the system meets program requirements, design specifications, performance standards, usability expectations, capacity demands and security requirements.
  • Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) covering functional requirements, security, recovery, system controls and what-if scenarios; prepare all SAT documents, scenarios and evaluation materials; review specifications, interface specifications and outputs; provide written comments; attend tests and test result walk-throughs; and take part in regression testing.
  • Train state staff to perform user acceptance testing.
  • Evaluate the overall completeness and results of testing, and prepare the written evaluation of test results for FNS review and approval.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in consulting, program management or procurement for state human services, public benefits or health and human services information systems.
  • Direct experience with SNAP EBT (or WIC EBT) services for a state agency, including at least one EBT procurement, re-procurement or processor conversion.
  • Working knowledge of federal SNAP EBT requirements, including 7 CFR Part 274, FNS policy guidance, the Agricultural Act of 2018 and the Quest Operating Rules.
  • Experience preparing federal Advance Planning Documents (IAPD or IAPDU) under FNS Handbook 901, or comparable federal Advance Planning Documents for state human services systems.
  • Experience writing or rewriting state government RFPs and designing proposal evaluation criteria, scoring tools and evaluator training.
  • Experience leading system or user acceptance testing for a state system, including test plans, test scripts, Go/No-Go criteria and written evaluations of test results.
  • Excellent writing skills and the ability to produce clear, federally compliant documents.
  • No current employment with, or contract to, an EBT processor.
  • Available for the full engagement, starting on or about January 1, 2027.
  • Three professional references from previous engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting an EBT processor transition, including card issuance, retailer integration and conversion planning.
  • Familiarity with eWIC, Summer EBT or other EBT-delivered benefit programs.
  • Experience working directly with FNS regional office staff.
  • Experience with state cost allocation plans and federal financial participation.
  • Experience with Medicaid Enterprise System (MMIS) procurements or CMS Advance Planning Documents.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

How to Apply

Send your updated resume and three professional references (name, title, organization, phone number and email address) to with "SNAP EBT Planning Consultant" in the subject line. Please include your current location and your availability to start on or about January 1, 2027.

jobs.description:
About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As the Revenue Operations Engineer at Venn, you'll make our go-to-market systems work as one. Our revenue stack spans HubSpot, Vitally, Nooks, Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora.You will own how those tools connect, how data flows between them, and how the business gets trustworthy reporting out of them. You'll sit in Finance and work daily with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, so that lead generation, pipeline, and customer data tie cleanly together from first touch through renewal. This is a hands-on, builder-minded role: you'll design integrations and automations, fix the data problems behind the numbers, and give leadership a single, reliable view of revenue.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrations and data flows between our GTM systems, including HubSpot (CRM), Vitally (customer success), Nooks (AI phone dialer), Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora so that data moves accurately and automatically between them
  • Build and maintain automations and workflows that reduce manual work for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams
  • Serve as the technical owner of HubSpot, including objects, properties, workflows, lead routing, lifecycle stages, and data hygiene
  • Design and maintain reporting and dashboards for pipeline generation, conversion, sales activity, forecasting, and customer health, working with Finance on revenue reporting
  • Define and document metrics and data definitions so Sales, Marketing, CS, and Finance all work from the same numbers
  • Partner with Marketing on lead flow, attribution, and campaign reporting from first touch through closed-won
  • Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline visibility, forecast inputs, and rep productivity reporting
  • Partner with Customer Success on connecting customer health, usage, and renewal data to the CRM
  • Audit data quality across systems, find and fix sync errors, duplicates, and gaps, and put safeguards in place to prevent them
  • Evaluate new GTM tools and AI-driven workflows, and manage vendor setup, permissions, and integrations
  • Document systems, processes, and integrations so the revenue stack is easy to maintain and scale
  • Support Finance with revenue, bookings, and pipeline data for board reporting, planning, and audits

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in revenue operations, GTM operations, marketing operations, sales operations, or a similar technical GTM role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep, hands-on experience with HubSpot, including workflows, custom properties and objects, reporting, and integrations
  • You know the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You can connect AI tools to business systems with MCP connectors (for example, HubSpot, Zuora, and Google Drive)
  • Experience connecting systems and building integrations through native connectors, APIs, webhooks, and iPaaS tools (e.g., Zapier, Workato, Make, n8n, or similar)
  • Strong reporting and analytics skills, with experience building dashboards and translating messy data into clear answers for leadership
  • Familiarity with the types of tools in our stack, such as customer success platforms, sales dialers and engagement tools, and conversation intelligence platforms (Vitally, Nooks, and Gong experience is a plus)
  • Comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical teammates
  • A detail-oriented, systems-thinking approach, with a habit of documenting what you build
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to prioritize competing requests from multiple stakeholders
  • Comfort in a startup or scale-up environment, with a bias toward action and a willingness to build process as you go

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of SQL, JavaScript or Python, or scripting for data transformation and API work
  • Experience with BI or data tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Google Sheets or BigQuery modeling)
  • Experience supporting finance reporting, such as bookings, ARR, and revenue recognition inputs
  • Experience with AI-driven GTM tools and automation
  • HubSpot certifications

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
  • Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

jobs.title: Sr Manager of Contracts and Procurement
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Epilepsy Foundation is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manager of Contracts and Procurement with deep experience in government grant compliance, contract negotiation, procurement, and regulatory reporting within the nonprofit sector.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Epilepsy Foundation is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manager of Contracts and Procurement with deep experience in government grant compliance, contract negotiation, procurement, and regulatory reporting within the nonprofit sector.

This role is responsible for overseeing the organization’s contracts and procurement functions while ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA), Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), and applicable state charitable registration requirements.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience navigating complex regulatory requirements, managing high-stakes contracts and agreements, and partnering across departments to mitigate organizational risk and ensure compliance. This position will serve as a key subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting, and regulatory obligations while supporting the Foundation’s mission and organizational priorities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Contracts & Procurement Management: Execute and oversee the end-to-end contracts and procurement function, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance for federally and state-funded grants.
  • Federal Grant Compliance: Ensure organizational adherence to federal grant requirements, including FFATA reporting, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), cost principles, procurement standards, and other applicable requirements.
  • Contract Development & Negotiation: Lead the review, drafting, negotiation, and administration of contracts, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, and vendor contracts.
  • Charitable Registration Compliance: Coordinate state charitable solicitation registrations, renewals, and related compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions.
  • Policies & Procedures: Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve procurement and contracting policies and procedures that align with nonprofit best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Grant & Funder Requirements: Monitor and report on compliance with funder-specific procurement requirements, contractual obligations, and reporting requirements.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Programs, Development, and other internal stakeholders to align procurement and contracting activities with organizational goals, grant requirements, and deliverables.
  • Vendor & Subcontractor Management: Manage supplier, vendor, subcontractor, and subrecipient due diligence, contractual obligations, compliance requirements, and performance.
  • Audit Support: Play an integral role in organizational audits, including the annual Uniform Guidance Audit, by ensuring appropriate procurement and contracting documentation and compliance.
  • Training & Guidance: Develop and provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement compliance, contracting procedures, ethics, and federal and state funding requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify and mitigate contractual, procurement, and compliance risks while ensuring appropriate documentation and internal controls.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen contracting and procurement processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance organizational compliance.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Public Administration, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required; JD or master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in contract management and procurement, including at least 5 years supporting federal and state grant compliance within a nonprofit, government, or government-funded environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of FFATA, 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), federal procurement requirements, cost principles, and state charitable registration requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex grant-related contracts, subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, subcontracts, and vendor relationships.
  • Strong contract drafting, review, negotiation, and risk assessment skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of procurement regulations, internal controls, audit readiness, and compliance requirements applicable to nonprofits and federal grantees.
  • Experience supporting organizational audits, including Uniform Guidance Audits.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Ability to interpret complex regulatory and contractual requirements and communicate them clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Legal, Finance, Programs, Development, and other organizational functions.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex priorities and deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion, and ethical decision-making.
  • Proficiency with contract, grant, financial, and organizational management systems; experience with Salesforce and Sage Intacct preferred.

Key Competencies:

  • Regulatory & Compliance Expertise
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation
  • Federal & State Grant Compliance
  • Nonprofit Legal & Regulatory Acumen
  • Procurement & Vendor Management
  • Risk Assessment & Mitigation
  • Attention to Detail
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Strategic Thinking & Process Improvement
  • Ethical & Transparent Decision-Making

Travel & Work Requirements:

  • This is a remote position with travel required approximately 4–6 times annually for organizational meetings, conferences, audits, trainings, or other business-related activities.
  • Must be able to work effectively and collaboratively in a remote work environment.
  • Occasional flexibility outside of standard business hours may be required to support audits, reporting deadlines, contract negotiations, or other time-sensitive organizational needs.

jobs.title: GM, Industrial Products & Services
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary:As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority. You will identify where we can win, decide where to invest, and build the team and client relationships to deliver sustained growth. Your mandate covers winning new enterprise clients, expanding existing relationships, and increasing the value clients receive from Toptal’s capabilities.

You will bring a clear perspective on the challenges facing potential clients and where Toptal can help. Working with our Services leaders and subject matter experts, you will translate those challenges into viable sales proposals across our AI solutions, managed services, management consultancy, and talent offerings. You will choose which markets, accounts, and opportunities to pursue, allocate resources accordingly, and give your team a focused plan.

You will lead from the front: personally leading executive client conversations, shaping proposals, working through difficult commercial negotiations, and helping close critical pursuits. Your team should see the selling standard you expect in your own work. You will understand what is driving performance, where growth is constrained, and what needs to change.

You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Set and execute the industry strategy. Identify the markets, client problems, and offerings with the strongest growth potential. Build an IPS business plan with clear priorities, financial objectives, and investment decisions. Test your assumptions with clients and adjust the plan as evidence changes.
  • Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Set and manage the budget, allocate resources, and evaluate returns on investments in people and growth initiatives. Understand how pricing, delivery economics, retention, and portfolio mix affect results, and act when performance diverges from the plan. Win new enterprise clients. Lead your team in pursuing priority accounts. Develop a credible reason for each client to engage with Toptal, build relationships with decision-makers, and personally advance important opportunities through discovery, solution development, negotiation, and close.
  • Expand and retain client relationships. Work with Client Partners to understand client priorities, broaden relationships across buying centers, and develop opportunities across Toptal’s portfolio. Stay close to important engagements, resolve concerns with the responsible teams, and turn successful outcomes into further business.
  • Make account planning actionable. Establish clear priorities and ownership. Expect your team to explain why an account matters, whom they need to engage, what opportunity they are pursuing, and how they will create progress. Ensure priority accounts receive sustained attention.
  • Bring the right expertise into the sale. Work with Services leaders, solution architects, and specialists to diagnose needs and develop credible proposals across services, AI-based solutions, and talent. Coordinate with supporting functions to resolve obstacles and keep opportunities moving toward a decision.
  • Maintain a credible forecast. Challenge the evidence behind opportunity values, close dates, and expected revenue. Understand the assumptions connecting pipeline to the financial plan, identify risks early, and take specific action to address shortfalls.
  • Build and develop the team. Recruit strong commercial talent, set clear expectations, and coach people through real client situations. Review calls, account plans, and active pursuits; demonstrate stronger approaches and follow through on improvements. Address underperformance promptly and develop future leaders.
  • Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members on the Industrial Products and Services team.
  • Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.
  • Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, sales process, and client value proposition.
  • Meet your team and the leaders whose functions support the IPS business.
  • Begin reviewing the client portfolio, active opportunities, P&L, budget, and growth priorities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet priority clients and develop an informed view of their needs, our relationships, and the opportunities ahead.
  • Assess the team’s capabilities and identify immediate coaching, performance, and hiring priorities.
  • Establish a consistent rhythm for account planning, opportunity reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching.
  • Present your proposed IPS business plan, including priority markets and accounts, revenue and profitability assumptions, investment choices, and the first actions you will take.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, account priorities, and ownership.
  • Be personally advancing major pursuits, helping close new business, and building qualified pipeline in priority accounts.
  • Have specific expansion plans for key clients and be executing the talent decisions needed to strengthen the team.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable commercial progress against the plan through closed new business, expansion revenue, and margin performance.
  • Show that coaching, account planning, and opportunity reviews are improving seller performance and commercial results.
  • Manage the P&L against the budget, address material variances, and refine investment priorities using evidence from sales and delivery outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver against the agreed IPS revenue, profitability, and budget objectives.
  • Have built a stronger team with clear accountability, consistent execution, and emerging leadership capability.
  • Demonstrate deeper client relationships and broader adoption of Toptal’s services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities.
  • Present the next stage of the industry business plan, including the investments required to sustain profitable growth.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of proven success leading professional services sales teams specifically in Industrial Products and Services, with in-depth experience in the Energy Sector, specifically Oil & Gas is required.
  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience running and managing an industry business unit with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Deep industry relationships ranging from director-level to C-level contacts is expected.
  • A sustained record of leading enterprise SaaS or services sales teams, winning new clients, and expanding existing relationships. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to those results.
  • Industry expertise and demonstrated sales experience in at least one of Oil & Gas, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, or Defense & Aerospace.
  • Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, hiring, investment, and account priorities affected revenue, margin, and profitability.
  • Experience closing complex enterprise opportunities, including shaping a business case, coordinating technical expertise, navigating procurement, and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Strong industry relationships and a record of earning access to senior decision-makers through relevant insight and demonstrated value.
  • Evidence of hiring strong sellers, improving individual and team performance through specific coaching, and developing future leaders.
  • Disciplined qualification and forecasting skills. You distinguish client interest from a credible buying process, assess the evidence behind a forecast, and act when an opportunity loses momentum.
  • Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently and recognize when deeper specialist expertise is needed.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex client problem into a compelling proposal and explain business performance without obscuring the issues.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

[We show compassion to heal minds.]

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. jobs.excerpt: Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel LeadershipAbout AscendAscend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site.
jobs.description:
Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership

About Ascend

Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.

We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.

Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.

As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

  • Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,
  • Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders
  • Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception
  • Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations

  • Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities
  • Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client
  • Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need
  • Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences

  • Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up
  • Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment
  • Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations
  • Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence

  • Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team
  • Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively
  • Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation
  • Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend

  • Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale
  • Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations
  • Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset
  • 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines
  • Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work
  • A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership
  • Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

  • Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs
  • Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms
  • A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs
  • Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones
  • Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.

What Makes You Stand Out

We are especially interested in candidates who:

  • Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove
  • Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them
  • Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client
  • Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium
  • Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path

The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain

We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

  • We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers
  • Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback
  • A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you
  • A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance

  • Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance
  • Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late
  • A global team with talented colleagues across continents
  • Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead

  • Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry
  • How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations
  • Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.

Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

  • Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win
  • Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours
  • Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust
  • Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it
  • Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?

If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:

  • Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?
  • Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?
  • Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?
  • Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role

This is perfect for someone who:

  • Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders
  • Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership
  • Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow
  • Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices
  • Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, and Benefits

Ascend is a remote-first, global team. For candidates based in India, employment will be through Ascend's designated Employer of Record (EOR), which will be the legal employer and administer payroll, applicable statutory deductions, tax deductions and employment-related compliance.

Compensation will be stated in USD and paid in INR through the EOR's payroll, based on the applicable conversion arrangement. The salary breakup, statutory contributions, deductions and payment terms will be detailed in the employment offer. Any personal income tax return filing obligations remain the employee's responsibility.

This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends or public holidays, depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.

The monthly compensation accounts for the rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements of the role. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime or additional hours are not provided unless required by applicable law or specified in the employment terms.

Ascend does not currently provide additional employer-sponsored medical insurance or mediclaim for this role beyond any applicable statutory coverage. Details of leave entitlements, schedules and employment policies will be shared during the offer and onboarding process.

Ascend values work-life balance and aims to distribute schedules thoughtfully. At the same time, because this is a client-facing operational role, some flexibility and responsiveness may be required from time to time.

jobs.title: Senior Head of Organic Content Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Are you a senior content operator and leader? And when you hear of the challenge of building and leading a world-class organic media machine that needs to grow from 1.
jobs.description:
Are you a senior content operator and leader?

And when you hear of the challenge of building and leading a world-class organic media machine that needs to grow from 1.5M followers to 10M followers in the next 24 months... does that excite you?

If so - working alongside our founder Richard Yu and our company Impact Clients might just be your dream role...

Now, to be clear:

This is not a social media manager role.
This is not a “make posts and schedule content” job.
This is not a gig or a short-term contractor position.

We're looking for a true executive, owner of tasks, and team builder who can grow to become a partner in our portfolio of companies.

Our Company Mission: To help ordinary people build extraordinary businesses online, and teach them the mindset and skills necessary to not just to make money, but more importantly to improve in all aspects of their lives.

Who We Are: We are an online education company that teaches people (9-5ers, busy parents, university students, etc) how to build thriving online digital product businesses.

Why We Are Looking For This Role: Richard and our team have grown our social media accounts to 1.5M+ followers (Over 1 million on Instagram @richardyuzee (feel free to look), Richard Yu on Youtube (150K+ subscribers)... and we use organic content (meaning NO advertising or boosting posts) to drive leads (customers and qualified booked calls) to our coaching programs and digital software services that we offer.

You are essentially building the "Traffic Engine" that will supply our company with unlimited amounts of leads so our company can continue to serve and impact more and more people through the coaching and software products that we offer.

Our Founder’s Story: Richard Yu began documenting his life at age 19 from his college dorm room in UCLA. Within 2 years, he launched a $500 productivity course (teaching college students how to wake up early and be productive), that ended up doing $500K in sales in 8 months. So many of his peers asked him “how did you do it?!” so he began to teach others how to monetize their knowledge and sell digital products (courses, PDFs, coaching, etc).

That grew into a consulting and education company that has now done over 30 million in sales and a team of 62 full time staff.

Feel free to reference a documentary made about his life here (1 hr documentary series):

Also - Richard's TedX talk about how we get our clients results, and transform their lives:

Our mission is to build one of the most influential organic-first personal media brands in the world with 10M+ followers across platforms while driving massive, profitable traffic into our software companies and education businesses.

We strongly believe that income is a reflection of the impact we make on this world, and so through our content we aspire to positively impact 10M followers in the next 24 months.

We are intentionally shifting away from paid growth on social and moving 100% organic-first.

This role will own that transformation as the key leader, operator, and soon business partner in our company.

Current Context

  • Instagram account with ~1M followers, generating multiple seven figures per year
  • Two YouTube channels:

Personal brand / vlog-style channel (~150K subs)

Business education channel (~40K subs in <90 days), Alex Hormozi–style sit-down teaching content, already driving meaningful revenue

  • Existing team members:
    • Dedicated Instagram copywriter
    • Dedicated Instagram video editor
    • YouTube scriptwriter / channel owner
    • Graphic Designer (for all platforms)
    • Two Video Editors
  • Marketing Leadership Team (that will support you, you will work alongside us)
    • CEO and Founder (and actor talent in this case): Richard Yu
    • COO
    • Head of Marketing (on the paid media side, so he leads every initiative and team of 10 people on the paid advertising side, this individual will be your accountability peer since you be the equivalent of him, but on the ORGANIC team side)

You will lead, not replace, these people, and then build an even more talented team on top of it.

The perfect example of this role is this individual Sam that we respect, that is the Head of Organic Content for another company in our industry.

Please watch this 60 second IG reel to understand what he does (and what we are looking for):

More context, full Youtube interview (extremely valuable where he breaks down their 8-figure/year media company:

Your Mission

Build, scale, and lead the entire organic content ecosystem—starting with Instagram, then expanding outward into YouTube, short-form platforms, and written platforms—while earning the trust, respect, and performance of a growing content team.

Operator FIRST Responsibilities:

First off - this is not a "creative first" type of role. If you just want to write copy all day for writing viral IG reels, please apply to be our copywriter (which we are always hiring for), not this role.

You will running L10 meetings (reference the book Traction, by Gino Wickman).

You will be sharing screen and typing NAS (next action steps) for every individual that shows up to meetings, and host Mon/Wed/Fri stand-ups for 30-60 min as an organized disciplined operator and cut people off on the meeting (politely :-)) when they ramble to make sure meetings are efficient.

You will be reading end of week reports that are both quantitative AND qualitative, and adding comments on the google doc to provide coaching and feedback to the Head of IG and Head of YT (and other team members).

Again - you're an operator FIRST, logical thinker, highly organized and disciplined, with a strong understanding of organic content.

ALL channel leaders (Head of IG, Head of YT, Head of Linkedin, and any outside agencies/vendors will all report to you. Think of yourself as a COO of the media company, an extremely detailed project manager making sure everyone is getting their responsibilities done on time, and ensuring overall growth.

Richard wants to be fully removed from ALL day to day operations, so examples of things that Richard is doing that he does NOT want to be doing and you will take over completely are:

  • If the videographer uploaded the footage late 2 days and therefore IG content goes out late because the editors didn't get the raw footage in time... Richard is NOT calling this out. You are. And you are immediately creating an SOP/process (and tough conversation with the videographer if needed) so Richard does NOT have to do it.
  • If the content word-for-word scripts, which are due by 5 PM EST every Monday are submitted LATE by a copywriter, YOU are the one getting ahead of this and calling it out.
  • If one video editor is approaching his 12 month term and is asking for a compensation bump, YOU are the one that is conducting the salary negotiation and structuring the comp structure so that it motivates the copywriter, and is sustainable for our P&L.

Phase 1: Instagram Organic (Immediate Priority)

You will work directly with our Head of Instagram to achieve 100,000 NET NEW followers gained per month (current growth: 70K/month followers)

This includes:

  • Leading the team of Instagram (Head of Instagram, 2 IG copywriters, 2 dedicated video editors for IG)
  • You must fundamentally understand how to do each one of the below tasks (even if you're not the one directly doing it):
    • Conducting viral content research to find the most viral and trending content that exists
    • Writing word for word teleprompter scripts for Richard to read off of when filming content that match his brand voice truly and sound like him
    • Writing or approving copy
    • Exceeding existing KPIs of: views, new followers, and up front cash collected

You must deeply understand Instagram before you can lead it.

Phase 2: Instagram + YouTube

Once Instagram is operating at a high level:

  • You will oversee both Instagram and YouTube
  • The YouTube channel owner and scriptwriter will report to you
  • You must understand:
    • Long-form retention
    • Thumbnails and titles
    • Watch time and session growth
    • Content packaging for education-based channels

We do not believe in leaders who “manage” channels they don’t understand.

Phase 3: External Traffic - Podcast Interviews and Speaking

Once IG and Youtube systems are set up and growing at a consistent pace of 100K/month new followers on IG and 30K/month new subscribers on Youtube, you will own the expansion to getting Richard on well known top 50 podcasts to be interviewed by key thought leaders.

  • This is key to helping Richard cross-pollinate with the audiences of other people's YT channels, podcasts, etc.,
  • This way, we are able to gain 10,000 + new followers per month from OTHER people's audiences instead of relying only on our own growth
  • Taking all of the content and "mining" it into tactical 20-60 second long clips to be used for short form content that can go insanely viral by themselves.

Phase 4: Short-Form Expansion (FB + TikTok)

You will expand organic distribution to:

  • Facebook (organic, not ads)
  • TikTok

This is not copy-paste repurposing from Instagram videos. Each platform has unique nuances, and you must be able to understand what they are and build a team, realistically growing or hiring a Head of FB/TK and coaching them up to excellence.

You must understand:

  • Platform-native hooks
  • CTA differences
  • Formatting nuances
  • Audience psychology differences

Phase 5: Written Platforms (X + LinkedIn)

You will eventually oversee:

  • X (Twitter)
  • LinkedIn (a major priority)

This includes ghostwriting in the founder’s voice, narrative-based authority content, and business storytelling.

Leadership Expectations

We hire top-down.

You must be able to:

  • Hire and negotiate compensation
  • Train and develop talent
  • Run effective meetings
  • Hold people accountable to output and performance
  • Work with agencies short-term (3–6 months), learn from them, then build in-house

This is an operator role, not an individual contributor role—though you must still have a strong personal content skillset.

Who This Role Is For

  • You have led organic growth before
  • You’ve worked with creators or brands at hundreds of thousands to millions of followers
  • You want to build something massive—not just manage tasks
  • You’re comfortable with ownership, accountability, and pressure
  • You want to be a long-term partner, not a short-term hire

Requirements

Required: A Content Superpower

You must clearly know your core creative superpower, such as:

  • Cinematic videography / shooting
  • Elite video editing / storytelling
  • High-conversion copywriting / ghostwriting
  • Visual direction / creative strategy

You do not need to be great at everything—but you must be exceptional at something.

In-Person Preference (Strongly Preferred, Not Mandatory)

We strongly prefer candidates who:

  • Can travel 1–2x per month to shoot content with Richard
  • Are comfortable being on-location for filming
  • Can work closely with editors and/or an on-site videographer who does the shooting.

*NOTE: If you are not able to travel at all - this is totally understandable, and you will own the end to end hiring, training, and ongoing management of an onsite videographer. We are okay if we have to fly in a videographer every week, though it would be ideal to have someone local in Puerto Rico to shoot with Richard.

Richard's expectations is that we shoot a full day every single week on Tuesdays with a videographer so we always have sufficient content.

Richard is based in Dorado Beach, Puerto Rico (you’re encouraged to look it up).

Travel is not mandatory, but it is a major advantage.

Benefits

Compensation is flexible and merit-based.

  • Performance-based growth expected

This role is designed to evolve into a partner-level position:

  • Potential profit share
  • Potential equity discussions after ~12 months
  • Exposure to software companies already valued at multiple eight figures
