jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Robotics
jobs.excerpt: About MenloMenlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
jobs.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will own the design, analysis, and validation of the structural and kinematic systems that make Asimov move. You will take components from concept through production-ready hardware -- working across joints, actuators, enclosures, and structural members -- ensuring every design holds up mechanically and integrates cleanly with the broader electromechanical system.

What You'll Do

  • Design and develop mechanical assemblies across the full humanoid body, including joints, actuators, sensor mounts, and structural members

  • Develop detailed 3D part, drawings and assembly models across plastics, metal, and composite materials in Solidworks or equivalent CAD tools

  • Run hands-on test rigs: load testing, fatigue cycling, thermal soak, and kinematic validation across body segments

  • Execute DFM reviews alongside contract manufacturers, going to the floor to understand tooling constraints, cycle times, and failure modes firsthand

  • Create and maintain production drawings with GD&T and inspection callouts for handoff to CMs and QA

  • Set up and instrument test stands, wire sensors, and collect data to analyze failure modes and close the loop on design iterations

  • Work across plastics, metals, and composites, selecting materials and joining methods appropriate for the loading conditions and production intent

  • Coordinate with firmware and electrical teams to physically integrate actuators, sensors, and PCBs into mechanical assemblies, ensuring cable routing, connector access, and serviceability are accounted for

  • Contribute to Menlo's open-source hardware releases, including build guides, BOM documentation, and assembly instructions for the communityContribute to Menlo's open-source design efforts, including CAD releases, manufacturing documentation, and build guides for the broader robotics community

What You'll Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on mechanical design experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

  • Strong proficiency in Solidworks, across both detailed parts, multibody assemblies, surfaces and drawings

  • Proven track record with sheet metal fabrication and traditional/additive manufacturing

  • Experience with GD&T and producing 2D engineering drawings for manufacturing and QA

  • Ability to run FEA simulations; static, dynamic & thermal as well as interpret results to inform design decisions

  • Comfortable working within aggressive cost and weight constraints without sacrificing reliability

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with material selection, actuator selection, fasteners and mechanisms

  • Proficient in rapid prototyping methods (FDM, SLA, CNC, laser cutting) and able to support the team on design decisions spanning the full product lifecycle, from concept through end-of-life disassembly and material recovery

  • Strong communication skills to drive alignment across suppliers, cross-disciplinary engineers, and leadership

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware, legged locomotion platforms, or high DOF manipulators

  • Participated in robotics competitions

  • Familiarity with parallel mechanisms and non-standard joint configurations such as RSU ankle designs or parallel actuation

  • Knowledge of plastics engineering including material selection, shrinkage factors, and mechanical property optimization

  • Scripting or automation experience in Python to streamline CAD workflows and data analysis

  • Experience with deploying control systems to hardware

  • Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer

  • Prior involvement in robotics or wearable systems where mechanical tolerances and ergonomics are critical

Why Join Menlo?

You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. If you thrive in fast-paced, open-collaborative environments, let's build the future of robotics together.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.
  • Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.
  • Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.
  • Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.
  • Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.
  • Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.
  • Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.
  • Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring

  • Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.

  • Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.
  • The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.

  • Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.
  • Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.

If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.

Description

Czy czujesz, że Twój szwedzki zasługuje na coś więcej niż tylko okazjonalne rozmowy? Chcesz budować doświadczenia klientów jednej z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych marek na świecie, pracując z Gdańska lub hybrydowo? Dołącz do nas i nadaj swojej karierze realne znaczenie w świecie CX!

U nas otrzymasz:

  • Wynagrodzenie w wysokości 8250 zł brutto + premię (do 800 zł brutto).
  • Elastyczność: możliwość pracy w biurze w Gdańsku lub zdalnie.
  • Pełne wsparcie: szkolenie wdrożeniowe i pomoc zespołu, na którą zawsze możesz liczyć.
  • Rozwój: w pierwszych 3 miesiącach rozwiniesz umiejętność komunikacji i prowadzenia rozmów w założonych ramach.
  • Stały, codzienny kontakt z żywym językiem szwedzkim w zgranym zespole.
  • Realne możliwości awansu - ponad 90% rekrutacji na wyższe stanowiska wygrywają nasi wewnętrzni pracownicy.
  • Bonus do 3000 zł brutto za każdą osobę, którą polecisz i która do nas dołączy.
  • Pakiet benefitów: opieka medyczna Medicover, karta Medicover Sport, kafeteria Worksmile i konsultacje z psychologiem.
  • Dofinansowanie wypoczynku i zniżki na produkty naszych partnerów.

Jak wygląda dzień pracy?

Dzień zaczynamy od sprawdzenia zmian w procedurach, by zawsze być na bieżąco. Następnie udzielamy wsparcia klientom, łącząc rozmowy telefoniczne z zadaniami back-office, a w trudniejszych sytuacjach zawsze możemy liczyć na pomocną dłoń Team Leadera.

  • Odpowiadasz na pytania klientów drogą telefoniczną oraz mailową (back office).

  • Udzielasz porad technicznych i pomagasz w umawianiu wizyt serwisowych.

  • Śledzisz bieżące procedury, by zawsze oferować rzetelne wsparcie.

  • Współpracujesz z zespołem i Team Leaderem, by wspólnie osiągać cele.

  • Wprowadzasz pozytywne zmiany na podstawie otrzymanego feedbacku.

Wyróżniają Cię:

  • Biegła znajomość języka szedzkiego (min. C1) - niezbędna do obsługi klientów.
  • Umiejętność słuchania i czytania ze zrozumieniem, tworzenia jasnych wypowiedzi z szacunkiem do drugiej osoby.
  • Sprawnej obsługi komputera – wszystkie zadania wykonujemy elektronicznie.
  • Otwartości na naukę, ciekawskiej natury i zaangażowania podczas szkoleń.
  • Umiejętności współpracy w grupie i chęci pomagania innym członkom zespołu.
  • Dyspozycyjność w godzinach 8-18 od poniedziałku do piątku.
  • Z doświadczenia wiemy, że kandydaci, którzy mają kompetencje, mają także tendencję do zaniżania oceny swoich umiejętności. Dlatego daj sobie szansę i aplikuj!

Wymagania pracy zdalnej:

Stałe łącze internetowe, w technologii kablowej (np. ADSL, światłowód), minimalna prędkość pobierania 5 Mbps – minimalna prędkość wysyłania 2 Mbps.

O nas

W Transcom jesteśmy nieustannie zaangażowani w relacje między sobą i naszymi klientami. Każdego dnia ktoś nowy zaczyna z nami przygodę i wykorzystuje swój potencjał, przekształcając go w umiejętności przyszłości. Doceniamy ciężką pracę, grę zespołową i wzajemną pomoc, wspieramy pozytywne i trwałe zmiany. Tacy właśnie jesteśmy, dbamy o siebie i od samego początku sobie kibicujemy, a przy odpowiednim nastawieniu nie ma przed nami ograniczeń i możemy zajść naprawdę daleko.

jobs.excerpt: Role can be based remotely or at one of our office locations What we do is complex, so things do go wrong from time to time.
jobs.description:
Role can be based remotely or at one of our office locations

What we do is complex, so things do go wrong from time to time. When they do, it’s important we resolve issues quickly and effectively, ensuring customers get the right outcomes and we understand what happened and how we can reduce the chance of it happening again. You’ll need to be able to look at problems from a number of different angles and propose a way forward that balances the needs of all those involved. You will work with a small team of Incident Managers and Incident Analysts, supporting the day to day management of incidents, delivering customer remediation that fairly addresses poor customer outcomes as well as looking at root cause analysis and reporting.

We’re looking for someone who can use their experience to support effective incident resolution and remediation, with a passion for doing the right thing for our customers and the ability to see incidents as opportunities to deliver improvements to the customer experience and our processes and controls.

To be successful in this role, you’ll have a strong understanding of operational processes, risk management and incident response within a highly regulated environment. You’ll be a great communicator able to breakdown complex information to a level everyone understands, have excellent relationship building skills to collaborate across the business, and will be passionate about delivering great customer outcomes and cultivating efficiencies and opportunities.

A bit about you
Your friends would probably describe you as the questioning and creative one. You’ll enjoy generating robust and sustainable practices that enable us to deliver excellent customer experiences every day as well as a desire for continual learning and driving improvements across what we do. Constantly learning, being challenged, having your own chunk of responsibility and being trusted to make it happen describe, in a nutshell, the environment you really thrive in. You want to be part of a collaborative culture where you feel empowered but always know you’ll never be left alone.

This role is extremely varied, day to day you’ll spend your time:
  • Supporting the management of operational incidents by maintaining accurate and comprehensive records of operational incidents, including detailed incident reports, post incident reviews, root cause analysis findings and remediation plans.
  • Co-ordinating and issuing incident communications across the business during live incidents.
  • Working closely with relevant stakeholders to implement remediation plans including communications with advisers, clients and other third parties.
  • Documenting agreed remediation calculation approaches to ensure consistent decisions that provide fair customer outcomes.
  • Providing accurate and insightful analysis and reporting of incident root cause to support senior management reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Providing regular reporting highlighting incident and remediation trends, performance metrics and progress on remediation initiatives to support senior management reporting.
  • Working with the Incident Management and Operational Resilience team to support delivery of incident response exercises.

We’ve always placed more importance on cultural contribution above technical ability, but we’d in this role really like you to have/be:
  • Demonstrated ability to define approach/calculations for new and complex remediations.
  • Skilled at analysing data and themes to provide insight and drive improvements.
  • Proficient at using Excel pivot tables.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and documentation.
  • A learning aptitude towards emerging technology, establishing innovative ways to use tools available to you.
  • Strong relationship building skills and collaboration experience with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • The ability to communicate at all levels, translating technical to non-technical/business language, and making informed decisions.
  • The ability to work under pressure with minimal supervision.
  • A strong team player who is approachable, helpful and willing to go the extra mile and enjoys collaborating with others.

A little about us 
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.

People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too. 

Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact. 

Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work. 

Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus 
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. 

For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector. 

More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development. 

At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.

Job Title: Performance Marketing Manager (Web)

Department: Growth & Marketing
Employment type: Full-Time
Location: Remote, from anywhere

Location and Hours

This role is fully remote. The country you live in does not matter to us. You may see this job listed under a specific country on a job board. That is a limitation of how those boards work, not a requirement, so do not let it put you off applying from somewhere else.

We do ask for a working day that overlaps with Pacific hours, because that is when the team is online and when the decisions that affect your budget get made. Outside that overlap you run your own schedule.

About ImagineArt

We're redefining how the world creates and designs.

ImagineArt is one of the fastest-growing GenAI companies in the world. We've scaled faster than most funded startups, with zero outside funding.

  • $35M+ ARR crossed this year

  • 100M+ social impressions

  • Built and shipped our own image generation model, now ranked #3 globally for photo realism

No funding. No shortcuts. Just a sharp, driven team building one of the strongest GenAI products in the world, and we're just getting started.

Almost all of that growth has come from people finding us and subscribing on the web. We are now hiring someone to own that engine properly.

About the Role

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition for our web product.

This is a web-first role. You will own the funnel from ad impression to paid subscription, across Meta, TikTok and Google, with real budget behind it from day one. ImagineArt is a consumer subscription product, so the numbers that matter to you are CAC, payback window and trial to paid conversion, not lead volume or MQLs.

The honest constraint in this role is creative. In consumer AI, paid social rewards volume and iteration speed more than clever targeting, and you will be shipping a lot of creative against a product that generates images and video. That is an unusual advantage and we want someone who will actually use it.

What You'll Do

Own paid acquisition on the web

  • Own strategy and daily execution across Meta, TikTok and Google

  • Manage budget at real scale, with responsibility for CAC and payback targets

  • Build and scale web to web and web to app funnels, including paywall and checkout testing

Make the funnel convert

  • Run structured CRO on landing pages, paywalls, pricing and onboarding

  • Own trial to paid conversion alongside product and growth

  • Build the measurement setup you need, from attribution through to incrementality testing

Ship creative at volume

  • Work with designers, editors and creators to keep a constant flow of new ad concepts

  • Build a testing cadence where losing creative is killed fast and winners are scaled

  • Use ImagineArt itself, and AI tooling generally, to compress the time from idea to live ad

Own the numbers

  • Report on spend, CAC, payback, LTV and contribution margin honestly, including what is not working

  • Forecast what more budget would actually buy

  • Decide where the next dollar goes

What We're Looking For

Required

  • You have personally managed $1M+ USD in paid media. Not an agency aggregate across many clients, not a team total. Budget you owned.

  • Direct experience with consumer subscription economics: CAC, payback window, trial to paid

  • Hands-on ownership of Meta, TikTok or Google at meaningful daily spend

  • Web funnel experience. You have built and optimised web checkout or paywall flows, not only app store installs.

  • You can show your own numbers and explain what you would do differently

Nice to have

  • Experience in consumer AI, creative tools, or another category where creative volume is the bottleneck

  • AI tooling already inside your own workflow, not just as a product you market

  • Experience scaling in more than one market or language

  • You have worked remotely across time zones before and know how you stay effective at it

Not a fit if

  • Your experience is mainly B2B lead generation or brand marketing

  • Your spend figure is an agency total rather than budget you owned

  • You need a large existing team and established processes to be effective

How We'll Assess You

We will ask you one question early, so you may as well know it now: what is the largest monthly budget you personally owned, on a single account, and what was the payback window. Bring real numbers. We would much rather hear about a channel that stopped working and what you did about it than a highlight reel.

Why Join

  • Profitable, no outside funding, so the growth is real and so is the budget

  • A product that makes the creative your ads depend on

  • Direct access to founders and genuine ownership of the number

  • Fully remote, from any country, with a day that overlaps Pacific hours

jobs.description:
Ready to be the make-or-break voice that turns "just looking" into "let's talk"?

We're on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven Sales / Appointment Setter to be the front line of our sales engine. If you love the rush of a hot lead, know how to read buying intent in seconds, and hate letting opportunities slip through the cracks — this is your seat.

Pro tip: Applications with an intro video jump to the top of the pile.

Fully remote — but since it's video-call heavy, you'll want to be comfortable on camera and on the phone.

ROLE SUMMARY

You're not a script-reader. You're not a message-forwarder. You are the first impression a prospect gets of our company — and the difference between a lead that converts and one that goes cold.

Every single day, you'll be in the thick of it:

  • A steady stream of inbound inquiries
  • Leads ranging from "just browsing" to "ready to buy today"
  • Messy or incomplete info you'll need to dig out
  • Calendars to juggle and conflicts to solve
  • Prospects who need a nudge (or three) to follow through
  • Multiple channels demanding fast, sharp responses

Bottom line: you own the pipeline. No lead gets lost on your watch.

Not for everyone: If you need someone tapping you on the shoulder to follow up, or voice calls make you nervous, this isn't your role. We're looking for someone who runs toward the opportunity, not away from it.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES (REAL-WORLD EXECUTION)

  1. Catch Every Lead, Fast - Jump on inbound inquiries from landing pages, social, email, and beyond. Fill in the gaps, qualify quickly, and never let a hot lead sit.
  2. Qualify Like a Pro - Sort leads into Tier 1, 2, or 3 based on budget, authority, urgency, and intent. Route the good ones to sales — and flag the scorching-hot ones immediately.
  3. Own the Calendar - Book discovery calls, coordinate schedules, send reminders, and chase down no-shows until the meeting happens.
  4. Keep the CRM Airtight - Every interaction, every note, every follow-up date — logged and current. You'll also help migrate our tracker into a full CRM down the line.
  5. Never Let a Lead Go Cold - Persistent, smart follow-up with warm and stalled prospects. You track things until they're truly resolved — not just until you feel like you've done enough.
  6. Support Social Selling - Post approved content, monitor DMs and comments, respond to inquiries, and funnel qualified prospects into the pipeline.
  7. Report What Matters - Track appointments, lead sources, and conversion outcomes. Spot patterns. Flag what's not working.

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

  • Real experience in Sales, Appointment Setting, Inside Sales, or Lead Qualification
  • Fluent, confident English — written and spoken
  • Comfort (even enjoyment) handling voice-based sales conversations
  • Sharp qualification instincts and solid objection-handling
  • A track record of managing calendars and scheduling appointments
  • CRM and pipeline fluency
  • Serious organization and time management chops
  • The ability to juggle multiple conversations without dropping details
  • A self-starter mentality — you don't wait to be told twice
  • Comfort learning new tools and workflows on the fly

TOOLS

  • Asana
  • Email
  • Google Calendar
  • Google Workspace / Microsoft Office
  • Social Media (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn)
  • CRM / spreadsheet tracker

WHAT WE VALUE MOST

  • You respond to new opportunities like the clock is ticking (because it is)
  • You qualify — you don't just forward
  • Your pipeline is clean, current, and reliable
  • You follow up before anyone has to ask you to
  • You sound professional whether you're typing or talking
  • You take ownership until the job is actually done

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • A support desk that only answers questions
  • A passive scheduler with no qualifying involved
  • A social media management gig
  • Pure cold-calling with no inbound
  • A "forward and forget" lead-passing job
  • A fit for anyone uneasy with voice calls or proactive outreach

POSITION DETAILS

  • Location: Remote, Egypt-based candidates
  • Type: Full-time, independent contractor
  • Hours: US business hours or significant overlap
  • Pace: Fast, performance-driven sales environment

Show Us You've Got What It Takes

Here's your first real scenario — treat it like the job:

A prospect submits an inquiry through our website asking for more info. On your first call, you learn they have the budget and authority to buy — but they're hesitant because they're comparing a few competitors.

Tell us:

  • What do you do in the first 15 minutes of handling this lead?
  • How do you qualify them and address their hesitation?
  • How do you move them toward booking a discovery call?
  • How do you document the interaction?

We care more about how you think than how polished your writing is. Show us your sales instincts.

We're evaluating:

  • Sales communication skills
  • Lead qualification process
  • Decision-making and prioritization
  • Follow-up strategy
  • Organization and attention to detail

Think you're the one who never lets a lead slip? Let's talk.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • HMO
  • Fully Remote Work

Embedded problem solving and delivery. Sit inside a function for the length of an engagement. Map the workflow, find where AI removes friction or creates capacity, and ship the fix. Automation, agents, and AI-native tools. jobs.description:
Event Operations Coordinator – Events, Logistics & Scheduling | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Central Standard Time (CST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Event Operations Coordinator to manage event logistics, field team scheduling, travel coordination, expenses, and day-to-day operations across multiple active event campaigns.

This is not a basic administrative or assistant role. You’ll take ownership of the operational details required to move events from planning through execution, ensuring representatives, venues, schedules, travel, equipment, expenses, and deadlines remain coordinated.

You’ll serve as a central point of operational coordination, making sure teams have the right information, resources, and coverage before each event.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, can manage multiple events simultaneously, and stay organized when plans change, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Event & Logistics Coordination

  • Manage the event pipeline across multiple active campaigns
  • Coordinate events from initial planning through execution
  • Source, negotiate, and confirm event logistics
  • Coordinate:
    • Booth requirements
    • Load-in and load-out schedules
    • Equipment
    • Venue requirements
    • On-site logistics
  • Communicate event details clearly to field representatives and internal stakeholders
  • Track event deadlines, requirements, and dependencies
  • Proactively identify and resolve logistical issues
  • Ensure teams have the information and resources needed before each event
  • Maintain clear visibility into the status of upcoming and active events

Scheduling & Field Team Coordination

  • Build and maintain representative schedules using Sling or similar scheduling tools
  • Collect and track representative availability
  • Publish and manage weekly schedules across campaigns
  • Handle:
    • Schedule changes
    • Coverage needs
    • Conflicts
    • Last-minute adjustments
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for field representatives regarding scheduling and logistics
  • Coordinate closely with leadership to maintain appropriate operational coverage
  • Ensure representatives receive accurate event details and schedule updates on time

Travel & Expense Management

  • Coordinate travel arrangements for field representatives
  • Manage:
    • Flights
    • Hotels
    • Ground transportation
    • Travel itineraries
  • Track event and travel-related expenses
  • Maintain organized receipts and supporting documentation
  • Reconcile expenses accurately
  • Monitor spending against established budgets
  • Flag potential budget issues before they escalate
  • Ensure travel information is clearly communicated to representatives

Reporting & Operational Support

  • Prepare weekly operations and performance reports
  • Maintain accurate trackers for:
    • Upcoming events
    • Event status
    • Representative schedules
    • Travel
    • Expenses
    • Operational deadlines
  • Keep event documentation organized and current
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into active campaigns
  • Track outstanding action items through completion
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and other operational initiatives when required

Requirements

  • Previous experience in:
    • Event Coordination
    • Logistics Coordination
    • Operations
    • Scheduling
    • Administrative Operations Support
  • Experience managing multiple events, schedules, or operational workflows simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, including:
    • Google Sheets
    • Google Docs
    • Google Drive
    • Google Calendar
    • Gmail
  • Ability to work during U.S. CST business hours
  • Comfortable operating under tight deadlines and changing priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Ability to independently coordinate multiple stakeholders and operational priorities
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Sling, TravelPerk, or similar scheduling and travel platforms
  • Experience supporting field sales representatives or event-based teams
  • Experience coordinating booths, venues, or event equipment
  • Experience tracking operational expenses and budgets
  • Startup or high-growth company experience
  • Experience supporting multiple simultaneous event campaigns

Tools & Technology

Google Workspace | Google Sheets | Google Docs | Google Drive | Google Calendar | Gmail | Sling | TravelPerk | Scheduling Tools | Travel Management Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and rarely let details fall through the cracks
  • Can manage multiple events and priorities simultaneously
  • Proactively identify problems before they disrupt operations
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams and external partners
  • Remain organized when schedules or event details change unexpectedly
  • Take ownership from initial planning through final execution
  • Are comfortable being the person others rely on for accurate operational information
  • Follow up consistently without needing repeated reminders
  • Stay calm and execution-focused when last-minute changes occur

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start your day by reviewing upcoming events, checking representative coverage, and confirming venue, booth, and travel logistics.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate with field representatives, venues, and internal teams; make travel arrangements; update schedules; respond to operational questions; and manage last-minute changes.

You’ll also track expenses, maintain event documentation, monitor deadlines, and prepare updates so leadership has clear visibility into every active campaign.

In short: you keep events, people, schedules, travel, and logistics organized so campaigns execute smoothly and on time.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate and timely event coordination
  • Consistent schedule coverage across campaigns
  • On-time communication with representatives and stakeholders
  • Minimal scheduling conflicts and operational disruptions
  • Accurate travel and expense tracking
  • Events executed according to timelines and requirements
  • Clean and up-to-date operational documentation
  • Fast and reliable response to operational changes
  • Leadership visibility into event and campaign status

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across event operations and logistics
  • Direct responsibility for multiple active campaigns
  • Exposure to scheduling, travel, budgeting, and field operations
  • Fast-paced environment with measurable operational impact
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Event Operations Management
    • Operations Management
    • Field Operations
    • Project Coordination

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Final Interview with Client
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, thrive in fast-moving environments, and know how to keep events, schedules, travel, logistics, and people coordinated without missing critical details, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of the operational details that help ensure every event campaign runs smoothly from planning through execution.

What You'll Do

This role is on Service CRM team with responsibilities including:

GTM Activation

  • Partner with Sales, Demand Gen, and Field Marketing to make sure messaging actually travels — not just to decks, but to deals

  • Build launch plans and run them. Own the milestones, drive the cross-functional coordination, close out the execution

  • Identify gaps in how the field positions Service CRM and build the content and programs to close them

Sales Enablement

  • Create the tools sellers use every day — pitch decks, talk tracks, battle cards, discovery frameworks, competitive objection handlers

  • Run enablement sessions that actually stick — live training, recorded content, whatever format gets adoption

  • Work closely with sales leadership and frontline reps to understand what's working in market and what's not

Competitive Intelligence

  • Know how ServiceNow stacks up against the competition and the broader field across customer service and field service — and build content that arms sellers to win

  • Track market moves, synthesize what matters, and get it in front of the right people quickly

Content & Programs

  • Build assets across the full funnel — thought leadership, event programs, customer stories, analyst materials

  • Prioritize ruthlessly. You'll have a lot on your plate; knowing what to say no to is as important as knowing what to build

Messaging & Positioning

  • Build the narrative for how ServiceNow wins— from value proposition to competitive frame to category definition

  • Translate product capabilities into customer-facing messaging that lands with customer service and CX leaders, field service and operations executives, and the sellers who take it to market

  • Keep the message current as the product and competitive landscape evolve — this isn't a set-it-and-forget-it job

What We're Looking For

We're not requiring a traditional product marketing background. We care far more about what you've shipped and activated than what your title has been. Strong candidates likely come from one or more of these backgrounds:

  • Product marketing, solutions marketing, or competitive intelligence

  • Sales enablement or revenue enablement leadership

  • Demand generation or field marketing with a strong message ownership component

  • GTM strategy or go-to-market leadership in a B2B SaaS environment

Regardless of background, here's what we need to see:

  • You've owned a GTM motion end-to-end — not contributed to one, owned one. You know what it took to get it across the line.

  • You've built things sellers actually use. If your battle card lives in a drawer, that's a problem.

  • You work well with sales. Not adjacent to sales — with them. You understand how deals get made.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and operate without a fully paved road.

  • You have strong opinions and the judgment to know when to hold them and when to let go.

  • CRM, customer service, field service, or enterprise SaaS domain knowledge is a plus — but raw reps in the market matter more than category fluency.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in product marketing, sales enablement, GTM strategy, demand gen, or a combination

  • Proven track record of building and activating GTM programs that drove measurable outcomes (pipeline, win rate, field adoption — any of these)

  • Experience working in or closely alongside enterprise sales organizations

  • Strong written communication — this role requires a lot of it and it needs to be good

  • Comfortable presenting to and working with senior stakeholders, including sales leadership and executives

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • The field has a clear, consistent narrative — and they're actually using it

  • Product launches hit the market with crisp activation plans and tight cross-functional execution

  • Sellers have the tools they need to win competitive deals, and those tools are built into how they sell

  • You've built strong working relationships with Sales, Product, and Marketing partners across the org

  • You've established a reputation for getting things done, even when it's complicated

Understand it. Simplify it. Make it useful.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Technical expertise and developer enablement

Turn technical complexity into clarity. Help people confidently use technology.

At Quadmark, we create learning and enablement experiences that help enterprise audiences understand complex products, build capability and achieve better outcomes.

As a Technical Content Creator, you'll transform complex technical information into clear, engaging and practical learning content. You'll combine excellent writing, instructional design and hands-on technical expertise to help people understand and apply technology with confidence. You will develop enablement content using AI workflows.

You'll bring proven, hands-on experience with OpenAI Codex, alongside strong knowledge of APIs, cloud platforms and developer workflows. You'll use this expertise to create technically accurate content that explains how technologies work and how they can be applied in real-world situations.

Working with project leads, designers and technical Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), you'll create digital learning and enablement materials supporting technical onboarding, implementation, product adoption and customer success.

You'll take ownership of assigned content from brief through to final approval, contributing immediately to an active delivery team.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS REALLY ABOUT

The Technical Content Creator makes complex technology understandable, accurate and actionable.

You combine technical credibility with learner empathy, strong writing and instructional design to turn detailed product information into content people can confidently use.

Your contribution centres on five outcomes:

  • Technical credibility: You understand OpenAI Codex, APIs, cloud technologies and developer workflows through practical experience and can explain how they work.
  • Clear technical storytelling: You simplify complex concepts without losing important detail or accuracy.
  • Effective learning experiences: You create structured, engaging content that helps audiences build knowledge and apply new skills.
  • Independent content ownership: You manage assigned content deliverables, balancing quality, accuracy and timelines.
  • Quality and continuous improvement: You validate information, collaborate with SMEs and use feedback and AI tools to improve how content is created.

You're expected to work independently, interpret complex briefs, exercise sound judgement and proactively resolve challenges within your expertise.

You own the quality and effectiveness of your content while working within the wider programme direction and agreed client commitments.

WHAT THIS LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE

Technical expertise and developer enablement

You understand the technology and can explain how it works in practice.

  • You have demonstrable, hands-on experience using OpenAI Codex in software development or AI-assisted coding workflows.
  • You confidently explain Codex capabilities, practical applications, limitations and use cases, drawing on your own experience and technical documentation.
  • You understand APIs, authentication, endpoints, requests and responses, data structures, integrations, cloud environments and error handling.
  • You can interpret developer documentation, technical specifications and implementation guides, identifying gaps or inaccuracies and engaging SMEs where further validation is needed.
  • You bring enough technical understanding to challenge assumptions and create credible explanations rather than simply rewriting source material.

Content strategy and narrative development

You turn complex information into clear, purposeful content.

  • You interpret briefs and technical documentation to understand the audience, learning objectives and intended business outcomes.
  • You ask thoughtful questions, identify what matters most and structure information into engaging, logical narratives.
  • You translate technical capabilities into practical examples, use cases and scenarios that reflect how enterprise audiences use technology.
  • You recommend suitable content formats and adapt your writing for different audiences, from business users to developers and implementation specialists.

Instructional design and content development

You create content that helps people put learning into practice.

You apply adult learning and instructional design principles to create relevant, accessible and engaging experiences.

You independently develop content including:

  • OpenAI Codex and AI-assisted development learning resources.
  • API, cloud and developer enablement materials.
  • Technical onboarding and implementation guides.
  • Demo guides, technical walkthroughs and product tutorials.
  • Sales and customer enablement playbooks.
  • E-learning scripts, storyboards and training presentations.
  • Job aids, reference guides, scenarios and knowledge checks.

You structure content around practical application, ensuring learners understand both technical concepts and how to use them.

You collaborate with designers and learning specialists to create a clear, consistent learner experience.

Technical accuracy and quality assurance

You create content people can trust.

  • You take ownership of technical accuracy, clarity and completeness across your assigned work.
  • You validate explanations, workflows, product capabilities and examples against approved documentation and SME input.
  • You identify misleading simplifications, unsupported claims and inconsistent terminology before content is shared.
  • You maintain agreed brand, editorial, accessibility and instructional standards, incorporating feedback accurately and constructively.
  • You recognise that technical precision and learner clarity are equally important.

AI-enabled content creation and innovation

You use AI to strengthen your work without outsourcing judgement.

  • You confidently use approved AI tools to accelerate content structuring, drafting, editing and refinement.
  • You apply your practical Codex experience to create credible technical learning materials and examples.
  • You critically evaluate AI-assisted outputs for technical accuracy, clarity, inclusivity and brand alignment.
  • You follow confidentiality, data protection and client-specific AI-use requirements, identifying opportunities to improve content quality and efficiency.

Collaboration and delivery ownership

You bring clarity, reliability and accountability to delivery.

  • You work effectively with project leads, designers, technical SMEs and stakeholders, building productive relationships and shared understanding.
  • You manage assigned content independently, maintaining clear timelines, documentation and version control using tools such as Google Docs, Slides and Drive.
  • You communicate progress proactively, raise technical uncertainties early and recommend practical solutions.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and adapt when requirements change, maintaining quality and delivery commitments.

YOU WILL THRIVE HERE IF

  • You have proven hands-on experience using OpenAI Codex in real-world development or AI-assisted coding workflows.
  • You understand APIs, cloud technologies, software integrations and developer environments.
  • You can confidently explain technical concepts and workflows to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You have experience creating learning or enablement content for enterprise, B2B, SaaS or developer audiences.
  • You're an excellent writer and editor who can simplify complexity without sacrificing accuracy.
  • You understand instructional design and how to create content that supports practical learning and behaviour change.
  • You're comfortable interpreting technical documentation and validating information with SMEs.
  • You use AI tools confidently while maintaining independent judgement and quality control.
  • You're proactive, organised, collaborative and comfortable owning complex content deliverables.
  • You can integrate quickly into an active team and deliver high-quality work with minimal ramp-up time.

THE ONE THING

Turn complex technical knowledge into accurate, practical learning experiences that help people understand technology and use it with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET

We built the benefits package around what you’ll need to do your best work.

  • Travel Insurance - We believe in the importance of face-to-face time at Quadmark, and we want our approach to allow you to spend time with each other, and with clients, when you need to.
  • Flexible, remote-first working, with offsites too - Life happens and we get that - if you need to flex, we'll always aim to support that. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. Quarterly in-person team days keep the relationships real.
  • Private Medical Insurance - In the UK, we partner with Vitality. Our health and life cover comes with great rewards that help you stay healthy. Because we want you to feel your best.
  • EAP and mental health support - Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Programme and mental health resources.
  • Enhanced leave - Depending on your location, it's enhanced beyond statutory. We offer 25 days leave in the UK specifically. For everyone, we shut down for the holidays too - that’s 3 extra days paid leave at the end of the year.

jobs.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Bookkeeper

Compensation range: AUD 1,500–2,000/month, depending on experience

Engagement type:Full-Time, Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: Approximately 40 hours/week, aligned with Australian business hours (Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:30 PM AEST)

Who We Are:

At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

Our client is an established Australian business with over 30 years of experience in the industry.

Based in South-West Sydney, the company manufactures and supplies roofing and walling products, operates a fabrication and laser-cutting workshop, and works closely with builders and roofing contractors across the region.

Role Overview:

As the Bookkeeper, you’ll be responsible for managing the company’s core bookkeeping operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, reconciliations, and collections.

You’ll receive full training on Harmonic, so while experience with the platform is a bonus, strong bookkeeping fundamentals, Australian accounting experience, and the ability to learn new systems quickly are more important.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who is comfortable taking ownership of financial processes, communicating confidently with suppliers and customers, and proactively identifying discrepancies or issues.

Key Responsibilities:

Accounts Payable

  • Process supplier invoices against purchase orders and goods received
  • Manage accounts payable transactions and prepare bank payment files for approval
  • Maintain accurate supplier records
  • Investigate and resolve pricing, quantity, and invoice discrepancies

Payroll

  • Process payroll for factory and office employees
  • Manage timesheets, leave, superannuation, and PAYG withholding
  • Maintain accurate employee records
  • Keep Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting up to date

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Allocate customer payments and maintain accurate debtor ledgers
  • Monitor outstanding accounts and follow up overdue payments
  • Contact trade customers, including builders and roofers, by phone and email
  • Build professional and friendly relationships while confidently managing collections

Reconciliation & Reporting

  • Complete regular bank reconciliations
  • Perform general ledger allocations
  • Support month-end close
  • Prepare aged debtor and creditor reports
  • Identify discrepancies or anomalies early
  • Suggest improvements to financial processes as the new system is implemented


Admin and Adhoc Tasks
Outside of accounts if requested you may be required to assist with General Administration tasks as part of office duties and assisting/ supporting other team members.

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping experience
  • Experience supporting Australian businesses
  • Hands-on experience with Australian payroll, superannuation, PAYG, and STP
  • Strong accounts payable and accounts receivable experience
  • Comfortable handling collections and customer follow-ups by phone
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Clear, professional communication suitable for conversations with Australian customers and suppliers
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Good judgement and the ability to proactively identify and flag issues
  • Comfortable learning and adapting to new accounting or ERP systems
  • Reliable home office setup with stable internet and backup power

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Harmonic or similar ERP/manufacturing systems
  • Bookkeeping experience within roofing, construction, building supplies, or manufacturing
  • Experience with inventory-linked accounting, including purchase orders, goods receipting, and stock costing
  • Experience with Xero, MYOB, Job Pack, or Micronet

Systems & Security

You’ll work primarily within Harmonic and online banking platforms, with access expanding as trust and familiarity with the systems develop.

Strong security practices are required, including:

  • Two-factor authentication
  • VPN usage
  • Password manager
  • Secure handling of financial and employee information

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Become familiar with Harmonic and the company’s finance processes
  • Accurately process supplier invoices and stock receipting

First 90 Days

  • Independently manage payroll and collections
  • Keep bank reconciliations and financial records up to date

6 Months+

  • Become a trusted owner of the day-to-day finance workflow
  • Proactively identify process improvements
  • Maintain accurate records and help keep debtor days under control

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

The GTM Enablement Program Manager owns readiness and performance for Fullbay's go-to-market teams — Marketing, BDR, and Sales. In a heavy-duty shop, the tech who earns trust isn't the one waiting for instructions on every bolt — it's the one who knows the job, makes smart calls at the bay, and speaks up when there's a better way to get the truck back on the road. That's the mindset this role is built for.

You'll own the GTM enablement portfolio end to end. Strategy and priority are set in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement — how those outcomes get achieved is yours to run. You hold the manager-tier relationships in Sales, BDR, and Marketing directly, source your own scope from those stakeholders, and define success measures for every program you design. Title: Cyber Security Analyst
Location: Canada (Remote)

The Position:

Our client is seeking a Cyber Security Analyst to support the monitoring, investigation, and continuous improvement of alert monitoring, threat detection, investigation, incident response, vulnerability management, and continuous security improvement initiatives.

This role is focused on day-to-day security operations, including threat detection, alert monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and security investigations. You will play an important role in protecting the organization's systems, networks, applications, and information assets while supporting the ongoing enhancement of its overall security posture.

You will bring strong analytical and investigative skills, a proactive mindset, and a passion for cyber security. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external security partners, you will help identify, assess, and mitigate cyber security risks while supporting business objectives and regulatory requirements.

What You'll Do

Security Operations & Technology Management

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts and events across enterprise systems and platforms.
  • Analyze security events and logs to identify suspicious activity, threats, and indicators of compromise.
  • Support the monitoring, configuration, and ongoing effectiveness of enterprise security tools and controls.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of security controls and recommend improvements to reduce organizational risk.
  • Streamline alert management processes to improve operational efficiency and response times.
  • Monitor network, endpoint, server, and infrastructure security controls to maintain visibility across the environment.
  • Analyze server, network, and technology service requirements and recommend improvements aligned with security best practices.

Threat Detection, Incident Response & Risk Management

  • Investigate security incidents and support incident response activities.
  • Conduct threat hunting activities to identify and mitigate emerging risks and hidden threats.
  • Perform vulnerability assessments and assist with remediation efforts.
  • Assess information security risks affecting systems, applications, infrastructure, and services.
  • Identify and document risk mitigation strategies to strengthen organizational security.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance incident response procedures and security playbooks.
  • Support security readiness activities, including the development, documentation, and testing of response procedures.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, attack techniques, and industry trends to proactively defend the organization.

Security Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop, document, and maintain security procedures, standards, and operational practices.
  • Recommend enhancements to cyber security controls, processes, and governance practices.
  • Support security audits, compliance reviews, and risk assessments.
  • Promote awareness of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and cyber security best practices.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's security posture.
  • Provide regular updates regarding security initiatives, investigations, and remediation activities.

Collaboration & Support

  • Collaborate with internal technology teams, business stakeholders, and external security partners.
  • Participate in department, project, and organizational meetings.
  • Provide security-related guidance and support to users and stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support a collaborative team environment focused on operational excellence and security awareness.

Infrastructure & Cloud Security

  • Monitor and assess network, endpoint, server, and cloud security controls.
  • Support Microsoft-based security technologies and enterprise security solutions.
  • Evaluate infrastructure, application, and cloud environments for security risks and vulnerabilities.
  • Recommend security improvements that align with organizational requirements and industry best practices.
  • Assist with securing Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Windows Enterprise, and hybrid technology environments.

Mandatories

  • Diploma, degree, or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience within Information Technology, Cyber Security, Security Operations, or a related technical environment.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience monitoring, investigating, and responding to security alerts and incidents.
  • Experience working with enterprise security controls and technologies.
  • Knowledge of technical infrastructure, networks, applications, and operating systems.
  • Understanding of cyber security operations, threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management.
  • Strong understanding of adversary tactics and techniques, including familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Assets

  • Experience within financial services, banking, credit union, or highly regulated environments.
  • Microsoft security certifications.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Security and Microsoft Azure Security.
  • Knowledge of CIS Controls, CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK, ITIL, and COBIT frameworks.
  • Experience with threat intelligence, security auditing, and compliance programs.
  • Experience working within Windows Enterprise environments.
  • Security+, SC-200, SC-300, AZ-500, GSEC, or other recognized cyber security certifications.
  • Experience with incident response playbooks, vulnerability management programs, and threat hunting activities.

Working Environment

jobs.description:
Stitch is the global leader in helping brands drive CRM performance through Braze and Databricks. We work with Fortune 1000 brands to design and execute martech-driven solutions and lifecycle marketing strategies that drive meaningful outcomes—producing award-winning work for brands like Taco Bell and e.l.f. cosmetics. Our fast-growing team spans the US, UK, and Canada.

We’re actively building the best customer relationship marketing (CRM) consultancy in the world. Not the biggest—the best. We’re looking for teammates who are energized by this challenge.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you’re motivated by impact. To be the best CRM consultancy in the world, we have to be motivated by performance—both in how our work drives outcomes for our customers, and for how our work drives outcomes for Stitch.

This means you’re not content with the status quo. You’re always looking towards what’s next and seeking opportunities to grow yourself, grow our customers, and grow Stitch. You have relentless standards and uphold them unapologetically. You move nimbly, take ownership, drive things forward, and make the people around you better. If this sounds like you, you will thrive here.

About This Role

At Stitch, we believe the next generation of marketing won’t be powered by more campaigns — it will be powered by better thinking, smarter systems, and teams that know how to turn complexity into clarity.

The Content Marketing Specialist – Sales & Solutions will play a critical role in bringing that vision to life.

This person is responsible for transforming Stitch’s expertise — from real customer work to emerging solutions and new ways of operating — into clear, compelling narratives that drive market understanding, build trust, and accelerate pipeline. They won’t just create content; they’ll help define how Stitch shows up in the market.

Working across marketing, sales, and delivery, this role sits at the intersection of insight and execution — translating complex ideas into content that’s not only engaging, but usable. Content that sales teams can act on. Content that customers learn from. Content that moves deals forward.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to do more than “write content.” You’ll shape how our solutions are understood, how our POV shows up in the world, and how we scale what we know across every channel.

The ideal candidate is a fast learner with strong instincts, someone who asks sharp questions, connects dots quickly, and thrives in ambiguity. They are equal parts storyteller and operator — able to zoom out to shape a narrative, and zoom in to ship high-quality work quickly.

This role is part of the Stitch marketing team and reports to the Solution Marketing Lead.

What You’ll Do

Work closely with SMEs to turn real insights and experience into branded content

  • Partner with delivery, solutions, sales, and alliances teams to identify strong customer stories, proof points, and emerging themes
  • Translate technical concepts and implementation details into clear, engaging storytelling for marketers, partners, and business stakeholders
  • Package customer success into reusable assets across the website, campaigns, sales collateral, and partner channels

Create multi-media content across channels

  • Produce content across multiple formats, including written, visual, and video — such as blog posts, customer stories, solution overviews, sales enablement assets, presentations, short-form videos, tutorials, and partner-facing materials
  • Support video content creation end-to-end, including ideation, scripting, light editing, clipping, and repurposing for different channels
  • Adapt content for different audiences and stages of the funnel, ensuring it’s both compelling and usable

Support solution marketing and sales enablement

  • Collaborate with the Solution Marketing Lead and sales to develop content that supports active sales cycles, including solution overviews, competitive insights, and pitch-ready materials
  • Work alongside sales operations to ensure enablement content is organized, accessible, and easy to activate
  • Help evolve solution marketing assets as offerings mature and new solutions are introduced

Manage content projects and workflows

  • Own and manage your content workload from intake through execution — balancing speed, quality, and priorities
  • Coordinate with internal subject matter experts to gather input, manage timelines, and move content projects forward efficiently
  • Support the marketing content calendar by executing against priority themes and business needs
  • Proactively identify gaps, blockers, or opportunities to improve content processes and output

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills across multiple content formats — this role goes beyond writing and includes video and visual content
  • Comfort learning and translating technical concepts into clear, audience-friendly messaging
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders at once
  • A proactive, collaborative mindset — willing to jump in, ask questions, and help wherever needed
  • Creative thinking paired with executional discipline

Who Your Team Will Be

Stitchers come with diverse backgrounds and experiences—but we are tied together by our Common Threads. These are the values that define our Stitchers:

  • Form Lasting Bonds — We’re a people business. We consistently show up for our team, our partners, and our clients in ways that build trust and champion others.
  • Seek Solutions — We aren’t order takers. We’re solution designers. We solve problems, move fast, deliver excellence, and drive results. We always have a point of view.
  • Don’t Settle — We don’t accept the way things have always been done. We think bigger, pursue growth, and find motivation in the discomfort that scares most people away.
  • Take the Lead — We forge our own path without waiting for permission. We push boundaries, lead our team and customers, and find the answer when one doesn’t exist yet.

Requirements

  • Experience in B2B content marketing, solution/product marketing, enablement, consulting, or professional services environments
  • Experience repurposing content across owned, earned, and partner channels
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace (Docs, Slides, Sheets)
  • Familiarity with video editing tools and basic motion or visual content workflows
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field — or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years in a content marketing, solution/product marketing, enablement, or client-facing role (B2B preferred)

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with or understanding of earned media, PR, or media relations, including pitching stories or supporting thought leadership

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Monthly tech stipend
  • Paid parental leave
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • In-person onboarding experience at our HQ in Indianapolis, Indiana
  • Free mental wellness resources
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 401k with company match

Highrise combines bare-metal performance with full-stack orchestration, API-driven access, and hardware-enforced isolation to support training, fine-tuning, and production-scale deployment of AI models. These capabilities extend beyond Highrise-owned fleets: through managed services, Highrise also operates third-party GPU hardware on behalf of customers and partners, applying the same operational standards to infrastructure it does not own.

Highrise is a subsidiary of Hut 8 Corp., an energy infrastructure platform. Hut 8 integrates power, digital infrastructure, and compute at scale. Highrise serves as the compute and operations layer—designing, deploying, and operating next-generation GPU clusters from commissioning through production.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a principal-level, hands-on AI Network Engineer to bring large-scale GPU cluster networks from physical installation and cabling to fully configured, validated, and commercially ready operation. Working alongside senior compute, storage, and infrastructure engineers, this person will lead network fabric bring-up, advanced configuration, performance tuning, and technical acceptance across AI training and supporting infrastructure networks.

Following deployment, the engineer will serve as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex production networking issues, driving root cause analysis, reliability improvements, and ongoing optimization of high-performance AI clusters.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Network Fabric Bring-Up and Integration

  • Lead network commissioning of materially complete AI clusters, including switch initialization, configuration validation, host connectivity, and readiness for production workloads.
  • Configure and integrate high-speed Ethernet and/or InfiniBand compute fabrics, including RDMA/RoCE, alongside storage, management, and out-of-band networks.
  • Validate topology, routing, redundancy, addressing, port mappings, optics, cabling, and interoperability across switches, NICs, and supporting systems.
  • Implement and refine network automation, configuration management, firmware/OS baselines, and repeatable fabric deployment procedures.
  • Partner with compute and storage engineers to resolve host-to-fabric integration issues and ensure end-to-end cluster readiness.

Performance Optimization and Acceptance

  • Execute fabric qualification and acceptance testing for link health, error rates, bandwidth, latency, congestion, resilience, and scaling behavior.
  • Troubleshoot and tune RDMA transport, congestion control, QoS, PFC/ECN, routing, and switch/NIC settings as appropriate to the deployed fabric.
  • Analyze NCCL and distributed workload results with compute engineers to isolate communication bottlenecks and improve multi-node performance.
  • Use telemetry, switch counters, fabric management platforms, and diagnostic tools to identify degraded links, optical issues, packet loss, or unexpected congestion.
  • Own networking acceptance evidence, defect remediation, configuration sign-off, and readiness recommendations for commercial service.

Tier 3 Operations and Network Reliability

  • Provide senior technical escalation for production incidents involving fabric instability, host connectivity, network performance, routing, or persistent hardware faults.
  • Lead deep troubleshooting and root cause analysis across switches, NICs, optics, cabling, and network operating systems; coordinate vendor engineering escalations.
  • Support network upgrades, expansions, failover testing, controlled configuration changes, and post-maintenance validation.
  • Develop diagnostic automation, monitoring standards, runbooks, and operational handoffs for NOC, SRE, and on-site technicians.

Cross-Functional Engineering and Delivery

  • Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, OEMs, networking vendors, site operations, and customer-facing teams to meet deployment and service milestones.
  • Provide concise technical reporting on fabric health, acceptance results, outstanding defects, operational risks, and recommended improvements.

ABOUT YOU

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, networking, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of hands-on data center or high-performance networking experience, including deep troubleshooting and technical leadership.
  • Demonstrated success deploying and operating large-scale, low-latency networks for AI, HPC, cloud, or similarly demanding distributed systems.
  • Strong expertise in Ethernet and/or InfiniBand fabrics, RDMA/RoCE, routing and switching, and multi-tier data center network architectures.
  • Experience with high-speed 200/400/800G networking, NICs, optical interconnects, performance testing, and network telemetry.
  • Proficiency with Linux networking and network automation using Python, Ansible, or equivalent tooling; familiarity with NVIDIA networking and fabric-management tools is highly desirable.

Core Competencies

  • Expert-level problem solving across physical, link, transport, and application-facing network performance layers.
  • Strong ownership of deployment outcomes, acceptance criteria, operational reliability, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to make independent technical decisions while collaborating effectively with senior compute, storage, and systems engineers.
  • Clear communication with engineering leadership, customers, site teams, OEMs, and external network vendors.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This is a full-time, engineering role supporting large-scale AI compute infrastructure across multiple sites. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Flexibility to assist with critical incidents or maintenance activities outside regular business hours is expected. This role is hybrid or remote depending on location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WHAT MAKES HIGHRISE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

At Highrise, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and production readiness of large-scale AI clusters, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and help define the technical standards for a growing global AI infrastructure platform.

At Highrise, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting
  • Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government
  • Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team
  • Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure
