jobs.excerpt: Our client owns a fast-scaling beauty brand.  The channels are set: Shopee, TikTok Shop, Meta.
jobs.description:
Our client owns a fast-scaling beauty brand. The channels are set: Shopee, TikTok Shop, Meta. The team is built: 14 people across strategy, content, creative, product, and influencer. The missing piece is the person who turns that machine into market share.

This role used to be called Group Brand Manager. It's now Brand Director – Digital because the job outgrew the title. You own the brand's voice, face, and P&L contribution online. Offline exists, but it doesn't drive the calendar.

What You'll Actually Do

Run the in-house studio like a newsroom.

Content doesn't get approved. It gets shipped, measured, and iterated daily. You decide what gets made and what gets killed. Production is internal. If you've only ever briefed agencies, this isn't your seat.

Make brand and performance speak the same language.

Media buying and data sit in a central Growth team. You don't manage them. You out-think with them. If a creator concept can't survive a ROAS conversation, it doesn't go live. If a top-converting ad can't be explained to a customer, it doesn't scale.

Lead humans, not headcount.

14 people. All under you. Brand, product marketing, content, creative, influencer. Your job is to make them faster than any external shop and smarter than any freelancer. That means you're in the docs, in the edits, and in the 9pm this isn't working calls — at least for the first two quarters.

Who Wins Here

You've run an internal creative team inside a brand. Not worked with. Run.

You've launched on Shopee or TikTok Shop and can talk to the drop-off between view-3s and ATC.

You read dashboards before decks, and you write briefs that a 22-year-old editor can execute without a call.

You've worked at a startup or mid-size company where you were the fallback. If you're coming from Unilever or L'Oréal, the muscle memory is wrong.

You're fluent in English because half your partners aren't in Vietnam.

You have brand fundamentals — positioning, RTB, architecture — but you don't hide behind them when the number is red.

How Our Client Thinks

Two filters decide everything: Do you own it? and Do you learn faster than the platform changes?

If yes, they'll bet on you. If you need committee cover or a 3-month onboarding, they won't.

Process

Round 1: CMO — Bring 2 campaigns you killed and 1 you saved. We'll talk about why.

Round 2: CEO — No slides. We test judgment, not polish.

The Real Reason This Role Exists

The brand is working. The channels are working. The team is hired. Now it needs a brain that can keep all three compounding when CPMs double and trends die in 6 days.

If you've been the person executing someone else's plan at a big brand and want to be the person whose plan everyone executes, talk to us.

DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a Customer Success Project Management and Strategy Manager to help our Customer Success organization plan, prioritize and deliver its most important initiatives. You will lead both CS specific and cross-functional projects from start to finish and drive the strategic analysis that shapes the transformation of the team from a customer service focus to a commercial focus.

The role combines two skill sets. You will bring the discipline of a strong project manager: clear plans, tracked risks, and reliable status reporting. You will also bring the problem-solving of a strategy consultant: structuring ambiguous questions, analyzing data and turning insight into recommendations. You will work closely with senior leadership and partner with Sales, Product, Customer Excellence, Finance and Data teams to improve the key levers of NRR growth and customer outcomes.

What You'll Do

Project Management

  • Lead multiple cross-functional Customer Success projects, such as delivering actionable upsell and cross-sell leads at scale to CSMs, automating the order form completion process, implementing new org designs based on revised customer segmentation. Lead projects from requirements through delivery.

  • Own and drive the delivery of specific Customer Success annual OKRs.

  • Build and own project plans that define scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, budget and risks, and adjust them as conditions change.

  • Keep a single view of active initiatives, with a simple intake and prioritization process so the cross-functional team focuses on the work that matters most.

  • Establish and own practical, lightweight standards (templates, status cadences, RAID logs) that project owners across the team can adopt.

  • Prepare regular status updates and dashboards for leadership, flagging risks early with clear options.

Strategy and Analysis

  • Support SVP of Customer Success in shaping strategy, including coverage models, customer segmentation and scaled engagement approaches.

  • Own resolution of strategic problems. Break down ambiguous problems into hypothesis-driven analyses, drawing on customer, market and internal data to produce clear recommendations.

  • Build and own business cases and financial models in support of new initiatives to drive NRR growth or deliver CS’s OKRs.

  • Define and track key CSM productivity metrics.

  • Contribute to annual and quarterly planning, including OKRs and capacity planning.

Process Improvement and Change Management

  • Identify friction in Customer Success workflows and drive improvements that raise efficiency and customer experience.

  • Partner with CS Operations and Data teams to keep the CS tech stack (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight) and reporting aligned with strategy.

  • Drive and own change management for new processes and tools, including communications, training and adoption tracking.

  • Turn customer and frontline feedback into recommendations for process, product and strategy.

  • Collaboration and Influence

  • Act as a trusted partner to senior leaders, translating complex data and project status into clear decisions.

  • Lead cross-functional working groups without direct authority, resolving conflicts and building consensus.

  • Coach team members on planning, structured problem-solving and communication.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 8+ years of experience in project or program management, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or customer success operations, including leading complex cross-functional projects.

  • Ownership mentality. Ability to drive cross-functional projects to completion and hold people accountable to deliver results.

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills (advanced Excel or Sheets; comfort with SQL or BI tools such as Tableau or Looker is a plus).

  • Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems and present recommendations clearly in writing and in person.

  • Working knowledge of customer success concepts: onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, expansion and health scoring.

  • Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com) and CRM or CS platforms.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, management, engineering or a related field.

Preferred

  • Experience at a strategy consulting firm or in a corporate strategy team with track-record managing projects from design to delivery.

  • PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile certification (CSM, SAFe).

  • MBA or other advanced degree.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or a subscription business.

  • Experience with change management or distributed teams.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Benefits

  • STAY HEALTHY: We offer comprehensive market competitive medical, dental, and vision plans. A variety of supplemental plans are also provided to meet your individual needs including access to telehealth for all participants.

  • CARE FOR YOURSELF: Take advantage of our free virtual counselling resources through our global Employee Assistance Program. Your mental health is as important as your physical health.

  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Plan for your future with our Roth and Pre-tax 401(k) options including an employer match for all participants.

  • TAKE A BREAK: Enjoy a generous paid time off program. We value balance and understand that performance at work requires time to rest at home and/or rejuvenate on vacation.

  • PUT FAMILY FIRST: We know that families can be built in a variety of ways; therefore, we offer paid parental leave and family planning support.

  • WORK WHEREVER: Our flexible remote work offerings allow you to work wherever you are the most productive and successful. It is what you do, not where you work, that matters.

  • MAKE AN IMPACT: Support betterment in your community and beyond by taking paid time off to support a volunteer program of your choice.

  • TREAT YOURSELF: We offer discounts on retail, entertainment and more through our Reward+ program.

The annual starting salary for this position is between $152,000 - $190,000. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

This role will be accepting applications until October 21, 2026 at a minimum. Please note that the application timeline may be flexible to accommodate a comprehensive candidate evaluation process.

Location: 100% Remote | Department: Billing | Schedule: Full-Time (Non-Exempt)

Why Work With Us

AT&C is a leading Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) partner serving Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs) nationwide. We’re dedicated to accuracy, compliance, and exceptional service — and we’re looking for an Insurance Verification Specialist to help ensure patients receive care with confidence and clarity about their coverage.

What You’ll Do

As a Self-Pay Collection/ Insurance Verification Specialist, you’ll be on the front line of the revenue cycle — confirming coverage, preventing denials, and setting patients up for a smooth billing experience.

Your Core Responsibilities:

  • Patient Collections: Proactively contact patients for self-pay balances. Negotiate payment arrangements. Follow up on unpaid accounts. Prepare third party collections list monthly.
  • Patient Communication: Provide exceptional customer service. Provide exceptional customer service by addressing patient inquiries and concerns regarding their accounts and balances. Explain billing statements, payment options, and financial assistance programs to patients in a clear and empathetic manner.
    Educate patients on account balances, co-pays, deductibles, and financial responsibilities.
  • Payment Posting and Documentation: Accurately apply payments received from patients to the appropriate accounts. Maintain detailed notes about collection efforts, payment arrangements and pt communication. Ensure all payment arrangements are compliant with company policy and procedures.
  • Communicate with Payers: Contact insurance companies to clarify benefits, resolve discrepancies, and document verification details. Verify patients' insurance coverage, benefits, and eligibility before services are rendered, ensuring the accuracy of the information. Confirm details such as co-pays, deductibles, and out-of-pocket costs for specific procedures or treatments.
  • Support Patients: Explain coverage and out-of-pocket costs clearly, answer questions, and build trust. Address patient questions or concerns related to their insurance benefits.
  • Pre-Authorization and Referrals: Obtain prior authorizations from insurance companies for procedures, surgeries, or treatments that require approval.
  • Prevent Denials: Flag coverage issues before services to reduce claim denials and ensure proper billing. Work closely with the billing and coding departments to ensure accurate information is provided for claims submissions, reducing the risk of claim denials.
  • Document Accurately: Enter insurance details, authorization numbers, and verification results into the PM/EHR system.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with scheduling, billing, and clinical staff to ensure services are compliant and authorized.

A Typical Day

  • Follow the process outlined in the Self-Pay Process Policy and Procedure.
  • Proactively contact patients with outstanding balances to arrange timely payments.
  • Verifies all commercial insurance coverage, workers’ compensation insurance, accident insurance, and state programs and determines patient’s responsibility (copayments, deductibles) if applicable
  • Determines patient qualification for coverage and informs patient of status
  • Respond to patient inquiries regarding balances, payments, and billing issues in a professional and
    compassionate manner.
  • Accurately apply payments, set up payment plans, and document collection activity in the system.
  • Monitor aged accounts and follow up consistently on past-due balances according the Self-Pay Process.
  • Research and resolve discrepancies in self-pay accounts, including billing errors and misapplied payments.
  • Review Payer Contract to appropriately calculate patient responsibility.
  • Obtains precertification number from Payers and/or physician’s office where applies
  • Maintains current list of facility insurance contracts and payment schedules
  • Documents insurance verification details in Client's PM System before date of scheduled admission
  • Maintains current information on correct and lawful practices for billing government and private payers for ambulatory surgery care
  • Provide financial counseling to patients regarding payment options and financial assistance programs.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient account notes to ensure smooth resolution of balances.

What We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a detail-driven communicator who thrives on accuracy and can make complex insurance details understandable. This role is responsible for managing and resolving outstanding patient balances by contacting patients, negotiating payment arrangements, and ensuring timely collections.

Key Skills:

  • Ability to identify discrepancies and resolve coverage issues quickly
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to identify and resolve account discrepancies with accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Proficiency with insurance portals, EHRs, payer contracts, and billing software
  • Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of HIPAA and applicable state and federal regulations regarding
    collections and patient confidentiality.

Why You’ll Love It Here

This is a remote role with standard hours (8 a.m.–5 p.m. CST). You’ll need a distraction-free workspace, reliable internet.

Manager, Indigenous Centre for Teaching and Learning

Position Type: Full-Time / Contract (one year)

Position Status: New Position

Location: Remote

Reports To: Director, Quality Assurance

Hourly Rate: $36.81, plus 4% vacation pay

About FNTI (First Nations Technical Institute)

Established in 1985, First Nations Technical Institute (FNTI) is an Indigenous-owned and governed post-secondary institution accredited by the Indigenous Advanced Education and Skills Council (IAESC). Operating from Tyendinaga on the Bay of Quinte and virtually, FNTI delivers community-driven programs grounded in Indigenous knowledge, connecting learners to their communities while pursuing meaningful education.

Position Summary

The Manager, Indigenous Centre for Teaching and Learning provides strategic and operational leadership to strengthen teaching excellence, Indigenous pedagogies, and continuous quality improvement across FNTI. Reporting to the Director, Quality Assurance, the Manager fosters collaborative Communities of Practice among faculty, staff, Elders, and Knowledge Keepers to advance innovative, culturally grounded teaching and learning practices that support FNTI's strategic priorities.

Hiring Posting Note: As the inaugural Manager, the Manager will be responsible for the creation of the Indigenous Centre for Teaching and Learning, as well as map out a 3-year plan for staggered growth and development for leadership review.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership and Strategic Development

  • Provide operational and educational leadership for the Indigenous Centre for Teaching and Learning in alignment with the director of quality assurance
  • Collaborate with leadership to establish priorities and goals aligned with institutional plans
  • Lead initiatives promoting excellence in Indigenous teaching, learning, and curriculum development
  • Identify emerging trends and innovative practices in Indigenous and post-secondary education
  • Support organizational capacity building through educational leadership and continuous improvement.

Communities of Practice and Faculty Development

  • Develop, facilitate, and sustain communities of practice that foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and reflective practice among faculty and staff
  • Create opportunities for instructors, knowledge holders, and academic leaders to engage in dialogue around teaching effectiveness and Indigenous pedagogies
  • Design, coordinate, deliver, and evaluate faculty development, onboarding, mentoring, workshops, and center programming
  • Support academic teams in faculty onboarding, mentoring, and ongoing development
  • Foster a culture of inquiry, peer learning, and continuous improvement across academic programs

Indigenous Teaching and Learning Excellence

  • Promote and support Indigenous teaching and learning approaches grounded in worldviews, cultural knowledge, and community-based learning
  • Collaborate with faculty and academic leaders to strengthen curriculum design, implementation, and renewal
  • Develop and curate educational resources supporting effective teaching and meaningful learning experiences
  • Support land-based, experiential, and culturally responsive learning opportunities
  • Respect Indigenous knowledge protocols, community relationships, and appropriate knowledge sharing processes
  • Encourage innovative and evidence-informed approaches to teaching and learning
  • Support faculty in the effective pedagogical use of digital environments, educational technologies, and hybrid teaching
  • Provide guidance on emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and learning analytics, aligned with institutional educational values
  • Collaborate with IT and other institutional areas to strengthen technology enhanced teaching and learning

Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement

  • Support academic quality assurance processes including program review, curriculum renewal, and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate with academic teams to assess and enhance teaching and learning outcomes
  • Collect and analyze center data and feedback to evaluate faculty development and initiatives, reporting findings to leadership
  • Contribute to institutional quality assurance reporting and accreditation requirements
  • Assist in developing policies, procedures, frameworks, and tools supporting academic excellence and quality assurance

Community and Partnership Engagement

  • Build and maintain respectful relationships with First Nations communities, Elders, Knowledge Keepers, partner institutions, and external stakeholders.
  • Support community-informed approaches to teaching and learning.
  • Facilitate opportunities for community participation in educational programming and curriculum development.
  • Represent FNTI in external networks, committees, and educational partnerships related to Indigenous teaching and learning.

Operational and People Leadership

  • Provide supervision, mentorship, and support to Centre staff and project teams.
  • Manage Centre budgets, resources, projects, and operational activities.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, work plans, and funding proposals as required.
  • Ensure Centre activities align with institutional policies, strategic priorities, and quality assurance processes.
  • Champion a culturally safe, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

Qualifications

Education

  • Master's degree in Education, Indigenous Studies, Adult Education, Curriculum Studies, Educational Leadership, or a related field.
  • A combination of education, Indigenous knowledge, lived experience, and demonstrated
    expertise may be considered.

Experience

  • Minimum five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in Indigenous education, teaching and learning, curriculum development, faculty development, or academic quality assurance.
  • Experience leading projects, initiatives, or teams within a post-secondary, Indigenous, or community-based educational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating professional learning and Communities of Practice.
  • Experience working collaboratively with First Nations communities, Elders, Knowledge Holders, and Indigenous organizations.
  • Experience with program review, quality assurance, curriculum development, or continuous improvement processes is considered an asset.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Deep understanding of Indigenous ways of knowing, learning transmission, instructional design, and adult learning principles.
  • Strong knowledge of Indigenous post-secondary environments and quality assurance frameworks.
  • Excellent facilitation, coaching, project management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work respectfully within cultural protocols, demonstrating a commitment to relational accountability and reciprocity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lived experience as an Indigenous person and/or experience within Indigenous-controlled educational environments.
  • Knowledge of Indigenous research methodologies, community-based education, and Ontario post-secondary quality assurance standards.
  • Experience facilitating hybrid learning communities.

Core Competencies

  • Indigenous educational leadership and capacity buildingFacilitation and adult learning (communities of practice)Strategic thinking, collaboration and knowledge mobilization
  • Curriculum, program development and quality assurance
  • Relationship building and community engagement

Conditions of Employment

  • Willing and able to travel occasionally and work overtime as required.
  • Successful candidates must provide a satisfactory
    Criminal Record Check.
  • Must be legally entitled to work in Ontario, Canada.

Equity, Inclusion & Accessibility

FNTI is an inclusive employer. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code (OHRC), applicants may request accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process.

To request accommodation during the application process, please contact with the job title and accommodation details.

FNTI provides preference to qualified applicants of Indigenous ancestry who self-identify.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting:

  • A cover letter outlining interest and qualifications
  • A current resume

Applications must be submitted online through the FNTI Careers site by November 1, 2026.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Contract to cash

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

This position is responsible for the design, build, and integration of MSD’s Siemens Teamcenter X Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) platform. The position owns the technical architecture for server-side customization (ITK, SOA, custom handlers), codeful BMIDE extensions, Active Workspace Client (AWC) customization, and integrations connecting Teamcenter with JD Edwards ERP, CAD systems, manufacturing systems, and downstream consumers across MSD’s digital thread.

The Principal Developer establishes engineering standards and reusable patterns for the broader PLM team, mentors senior and junior developers, and serves as the principal technical partner to the Sr. Teamcenter Functional Analyst, Teamcenter administrators, infrastructure engineers, and Siemens or systems-integrator partners.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the technical architecture for Teamcenter X customizations, integrations, and extensions across server-side, AWC, and integration layers; set engineering standards, reusable patterns, and reference designs for the PLM team.
  • Lead the design, development, and unit-testing of Teamcenter X server-side customizations using ITK (C/C++), including custom handlers, user exits, BMIDE extensions, and SOA service implementations, personally taking on the most complex builds.
  • Lead migration from Aras to Teamcenter X. Set technical standards, lead architectural decisions, and ensure all customizations are well-architected, supportable, and validated within a regulated (21 CFR Part 11 / GxP) and ISO 27001-controlled environment.
  • Architect and review Teamcenter X codeful BMIDE extensions (custom business objects, properties, methods, deep-copy rules, GRM rules); determine where codeful customization is justified versus codeless configuration.
  • Drive Active Workspace Client (AWC) customization strategy: declarative UI (JSON view-model definitions), custom commands, client-side event handlers, and toolbar/context-menu integration; establish front-end engineering standards.
  • Define workflow handler patterns (action, rule, condition) and EPM handlers supporting engineering change, document control, and product release processes.
  • Architect integrations between Teamcenter X and downstream/upstream systems (JD Edwards ERP, MES, CAD, quality systems, middleware) using T4S, T4EA, SOA, REST, and message-based patterns; own end-to-end integration design across the MSD digital thread.
  • Establish standards for technical design specifications, code reviews, unit-test results, deployment runbooks, and validation-supporting documentation (IQ/OQ/PQ artifacts) consistent with MSD’s GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and ISO 27001 standards.
  • Own the configuration management strategy for Teamcenter customization assets under source control (Git), code-review practices, CI/CD pipelines for Teamcenter deliverables, and secure-coding standards.
  • Partner with Teamcenter administrators on environment promotion, BMIDE template deployment, dispatcher configuration, AWC indexer/full-text search, and upgrade or patch impact analysis; lead technical impact analysis for platform upgrades.
  • Serve as the escalation point for technical issues on production Teamcenter incidents, performance, and integration failures; lead root-cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
  • Mentor senior and junior developers, lead technical reviews, contribute to architectural decisions on the Teamcenter and broader digital-thread roadmap, and represent Teamcenter engineering in cross-functional architecture forums.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline; Master’s preferred. Equivalent combination of education and experience considered.
  • Minimum 7 years of hands-on Siemens Teamcenter development experience (Teamcenter Unified, Teamcenter 11/12/13/14 or later, or Teamcenter X), including 5+ years on AWC customization.
  • Extensive codeful BMIDE customization experience: extending the data model, building custom properties and methods, and packaging templates for deployment across multi-environment landscapes.
  • Extensive experience leading Active Workspace Client (AWC) customization: declarative UI (view-models in JSON), custom commands, client-side handlers, REST/SOA service consumption, and stylesheet extensions.
  • Experience setting technical standards and mentoring senior engineers on a PLM or comparable enterprise platform team.
  • Experience operating in regulated environments (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, ISO 9001, or comparable) and owning validation-supporting artifacts; familiarity with computer-system validation (CSV) lifecycle.
  • Experience in medical device, life sciences, aerospace, defense, or other regulated manufacturing industries strongly preferred.
  • Siemens Teamcenter X certifications (ITK, BMIDE, AWC) preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Expertise with Teamcenter ITK (C/C++): custom handlers, user exits, server extensions, and SOA service development on enterprise-scale deployments.
  • Proven track record architecting Teamcenter integration patterns: T4S (SAP), T4EA (Enterprise Application), Dispatcher services, SOA, REST, SOAP, and message-driven patterns; experience integrating Teamcenter with JD Edwards or comparable ERP required.
  • Strong working knowledge of relational databases (Oracle or SQL Server) for diagnostics, schema design, and integration; able to read execution plans and tune queries.
  • Proficiency with Git, code-review tooling, and CI/CD pipelines; experience with secure-coding practices and remediation of static-analysis and software-composition-analysis findings.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, design patterns, modular architecture, debugging, performance analysis, and disciplined testing.
  • Expert proficiency in C/C++ for ITK development; strong working proficiency in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, and JSON for AWC and integration development.
  • Proven ability to translate functional specifications and solution designs into clean, well-documented, supportable, and validated code, and to set patterns others can follow.
  • Disciplined approach to configuration management, versioning, branching, and release engineering for Teamcenter customizations across multi-environment landscapes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and to author audit-ready design and validation documentation.
  • Demonstrated security mindset: applies secure-coding practices, considers data-protection and access-control implications, and partners effectively with cybersecurity on findings remediation.
  • Demonstrated propensity to be creative, collaborative, proactive, and self-motivated in the execution and completion of assigned accountabilities.
  • Ability to provide day to day guidance/mentoring to others in a consistently supportive and collaborative approach.
  • Continuous-learning mindset; tracks Siemens Teamcenter X release content, AWC evolution, emerging integration patterns (event-driven, API-led), and AI-assisted development tooling relevant to MSD’s roadmap.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills; sound judgment in handling complex, ambiguous technical situations.
  • Ability to influence at all levels of the organization and drive consensus on technical direction.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This position requires the ability to communicate and exchange information, utilize equipment necessary to perform the job, and move about the office and facilities.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This position is performed in a traditional office environment, or a hybrid model.

COMPENSATION SUMMARY

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $116,600.00 to $177,800.00. This salary range represents a general guideline as MSD considers other factors when presenting an offer of employment, such as scope and responsibilities of the position, external market factors, and the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities, education and experience. Employees may qualify for a discretionary or non-discretionary bonus in addition to their base salary. These annual bonuses are intended to recognize individual performance and enable employees to benefit from the Company's overall success.

At MSD, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees' well-being and financial security. We provide a 401(k) plan with company matching, flexible spending accounts, and company-paid short- and long-term disability insurance as well as group life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance. Karoo deploys a value-based approach which combines a blend of traditional, guideline-based medicine and state of the art digital tools to accomplish this important mission by enabling the conversion to, and success in, value-based care arrangements for cardiovascular networks, health systems and payers. Karoo is backed by leading venture capitalists, including First Trust Capital Partners and BIP Ventures, and has near and medium-term plans for further rounds.

Senior Data Scientist

Job Description

Overview

Location:Pittsburgh preferred, or remote, U.S.-based

Type:Full-time technical role

An Industry Defining Company

Karoo is a venture-backed startup, prior to Series A, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care. Our platform is designed to empower large provider groups and health systems to succeed in value-based care contracts with payers by improving patient outcomes and reducing cost of care through better coordination, analytics, and disease management. While our initial focus is cardiology, we are building a scalable operating system for managing complex conditions across the healthcare spectrum.

This is a rare opportunity to join a mission-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare technology, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in America today.

The Role

Karoo Health is seeking a skilled and dedicated developer to join our Engineering team. As a data scientist at Karoo Health, you show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life. You are energized by the idea of building something new and want to work on problems that matter.

In order to do this job well, you must be a curious and eager problem solver with a hunger for building well-designed, high-quality solutions. You have a passion for great work and strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems. Knowing there are always multiple answers to a problem, you know how to engage in a constructive dialogue to find the best path forward.

What You'll Do

  • Design and Architect Data Systems: Lead the design, construction, installation, and optimization of highly reliable, scalable, and secure data architecture.
  • Design Core Healthcare Data Models: Own the design and evolution of foundational data models and schemas from the ground up, leveraging industry standards such as TUVA, OMOP and FHIR to translate clinical, operational, product, and reporting needs into scalable table structures, entities, and relationships.
  • Develop Data Pipelines: Build and maintain complex, production-grade data pipelines that ingest, process, enrich and normalize large volumes of healthcare data ensuring consistency, usability, and data integrity across downstream applications.
  • Data Quality and Governance: Establish and enforce data quality standards, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data used for analytics.
  • Performance Optimization: Implement query tuning, indexing, and partitioning strategies to maximize the performance and efficiency of data processing systems and data retrieval.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Design and deploy scalable, secure, cloud infrastructure leveraging infrastructure-as-code best practices.
  • Safeguard Data: Ensure strict compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and implement data security best practices.
  • Build and Maintain EMR Integrations: Develop direct, bi-directional integrations with electronic medical record platforms.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep, hands-on experience working with healthcare data, including healthcare data standards and common data models such as TUVA, OMOP, or FHIR.
  • Demonstrated experience designing core data models and schemas from scratch, including translating business, clinical, product, or user requirements into scalable data structures.
  • Experience mapping raw healthcare data into standardized healthcare data models, including resolving data quality, normalization, terminology, and structural inconsistencies.
  • Hands-on experience integrating directly with EMR/EHR platforms, ideally including eClinicalWorks, AthenaOne, Epic, or comparable systems.
  • Experience with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and data formats (e.g. FHIR)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 8 years of dedicated professional experience in a Data Scientist or Data Engineering role, preferably within a startup or fast-paced healthcare technology environment.
  • Expert proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language used for data processing (Python or Scala).
  • Deep experience designing and managing Data Warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift) and experience with Data Lake technologies (e.g., S3, Delta Lake).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Big Data processing frameworks like Apache Spark or Dask.
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native development, including services like S3, Lambda, and RDS.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or AWS Step Functions for managing data pipelines.
  • Expert knowledge of system architecture, scalability, and performance optimization for data systems.
  • Experience with test automation, CI/CD, and DevOps best practices for data deployments.
  • Ability to work independently and make high-impact technical decisions.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to define the technical solution from the ground up
  • Possibly fully remote work environment with flexible hours

  • A collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership

When you're on call

You'll be doing one week in three initially (one in four as we grow), Monday-Friday, on a 12-hour shift with secondary backup support. Rotas: 12 PM–12 AM UTC

  • Be first line for platform alerts and incidents: restore service, escalate or help fix product bugs, and lead post-incident reviews.
  • Act as second line for our Customer Success team, on requests that come directly from customers.
  • Handle ad hoc requests from other teams across the organisation regarding Tyk Cloud.

Requirements

What you'll need:

  • 3+ years in SRE, platform or infrastructure roles, across more than one company or production platform.
  • Experience owning on-call and leading incidents yourself.
  • Hands-on experience running production Kubernetes at scale, ideally EKS: operating, upgrading and debugging large, multi-tenant clusters.
  • Experience designing and operating infrastructure on AWS, with Terraform or similar.
  • The ability to write, test and ship Go tooling or services.
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana, and with logging systems.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, load balancing).
  • Clear communication across time zones and teams.

Our stack

EKS, Terraform/Terragrunt, Helm, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, MongoDB, Redis, Prometheus and Grafana.

Benefits

Here’s why you should join us:

  • Everyone has unlimited paid holiday.

Our values tell the story of Tyk – here’s how:

Instead of focusing solely on prospecting activity, you’ll own the entire sales motion—from pipeline generation and discovery through presentations, negotiations, closing, and account development—while coaching your team to consistently improve performance.

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

    • Managed IT Services
    • Cybersecurity
    • Cloud Solutions
    • Professional Services
  • Experience building high-performing remote sales teams.
  • Familiarity with modern CRM platforms and sales analytics tools.
  • Experience implementing AI-driven sales enablement strategies.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Proven full-cycle B2B sales leader.
  • Strong consultative selling mindset.
  • Excellent coach who develops people through structured feedback.
  • Process-oriented while remaining adaptable.
  • Comfortable balancing live coaching with asynchronous development.
  • Curious, technology-driven, and enthusiastic about AI.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review pipeline health and forecast opportunities.
  • Conduct live coaching sessions with sales representatives.
  • Join discovery calls and deal strategy discussions.

  • Analyze sales metrics and identify coaching opportunities.

In short: You build high-performing sales professionals by coaching every stage of the sales cycle while continuously improving the team’s processes, tools, and performance.

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently.

Project Details:

  • Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotator
  • Location: Remote in India/Philippines﻿/Egypt/Mexico
  • Employment type: Freelance
  • Pay Rate: US$3.5/hour

What You'll Do

1. Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras).

2. Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment.

3. Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment:

- Atomic motion (a few seconds) — a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle")

- Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) — a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge")

- Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) — the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container")

4. Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels — no gaps, including idle or pause moments.

5. Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful.

6. Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details.

7. Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes.

8. Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples.

What We're Looking For

Required:

1. Strong written English — you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases.

2. Sharp attention to detail — able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched).

3. Comfort following a detailed, structured style guide and applying it consistently, even in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.

4. Basic comfort with spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, naming object parts like handles, lids, or edges).

5. Reliable, self-directed work habits — this is often heads-down work with periodic check-ins rather than close supervision.

Nice to Have:

1. Prior experience with video annotation, data labeling, transcription, or QA work.

2. Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation) — helpful but not necessary, as the style guide is self-contained.

3. Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.excerpt: Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation and Certified B Corp on a mission to create open-source software for data science, scientific research, and technical communication — and we’re building a company designed to thrive for 100 years.
jobs.description:
Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation and Certified B Corp on a mission to create open-source software for data science, scientific research, and technical communication — and we’re building a company designed to thrive for 100 years.

Our Accounting team keeps the company’s books accurate, timely, and audit-ready, and partners with Finance, Payroll, and the business to turn financial data into decisions. We value sound judgment, clear communication, and continuous improvement, and we invest in automation so our people spend their time on analysis and problem solving rather than manual work. We’re looking for a Senior Accountant to join the team, reporting to an Accounting Manager and working closely with FP&A, Tax, Payroll, AP/AR, Engineering/IT, and our external auditors.

YOUR IMPACT

Why this role exists: to keep Posit’s books accurate, timely, and audit-ready — and to raise the standard for how the Accounting team works. You are singularly responsible for:

  • Prepare accurate, timely financial statements, reconciliation schedules, and supporting analysis (flux, variance, and trend) for your assigned areas. Serve as the subject matter expert for those areas, including researching and documenting the technical accounting positions behind complex or non-routine transactions.
  • Lead accounting projects and system changes from plan through delivery.
  • Identify and implement improvements to accounting practices, including automation that delivers data faster and reduces risk across teams.
  • Own internal controls for your areas; identify process or control deficiencies, design and implement solutions, and raise the standard for how the team works.
  • Collaborate well with others, stay positive under pressure, welcome feedback, and contribute to the department’s shared goals.

HOW YOU’LL COLLABORATE

You’ll be the senior voice for the areas you own, working across Posit to keep the close on schedule and the controls strong:

  • Partner with FP&A, Payroll, Tax, AP/AR, and Engineering/IT on data flows, system changes, internal controls, and month-end close dependencies.
  • Support internal and external audits and the testing of people, process, and system controls.
  • Mentor less experienced teammates with their questions by reviewing their work and explaining your thinking, and present regularly to the team and stakeholders.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Has independently run month-end close and prepared financial statements for multiple areas, including complex or non-routine transactions, with limited review.
  • Hands-on NetSuite experience (or a related ERP): journal entries, reconciliations, saved searches, and running the close in the system.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas (lookups, nested logic, pivots, and array formulas) for reconciliations and analysis.
  • Day-to-day experience using an AI tool for analysis, automation, or documentation, with sound judgment in validating its output.
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and the ability to explain accounting decisions clearly, with the reasoning behind them.
  • Understanding of people, process, and system controls, and a track record of leading a project or process improvement.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Extending NetSuite and our AI tooling (e.g., saved searches, workflows, scripting) to provide data faster and mitigate risk.
  • Experience with new functional areas and technologies adjacent to accounting (e.g., revenue, billing, or subledger systems).
  • Familiarity with our entity structure, close calendar, policies, and the systems that connect Accounting to the rest of the business — or the curiosity to learn them quickly.
  • Large-project planning: creating major project plans, estimating well, and explaining your confidence in delivery.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

Within 1 month, you’ll…

  • Complete onboarding to our close calendar, chart of accounts, policies, and our NetSuite and Numeric (month-end close software) setup, and shadow one full month-end close.
  • Take over the reconciliations and journal entries for your assigned accounts and complete them on the close calendar with reviewer sign-off.
  • Document the people, process, and system controls for your assigned areas and share a list of risks and questions with your manager.
  • Meet 1:1 with key partners (FP&A, Tax, AP/AR, and audit contacts) to learn their needs and agree on how you will work together.

Within 3 months, you’ll…

  • Prepare your assigned financial statements and flux analysis independently for two consecutive closes, with minimal review comments.
  • Present a variance analysis to the team that is clearly structured and explains the drivers behind the numbers.
  • Contribute your assigned inputs to the budget schedule on time, with supporting detail and clearly stated assumptions.
  • Identify at least two process improvements, rank them by impact and effort, and implement one end to end.
  • Research and document the technical accounting position for one non-routine transaction or policy area, and walk the Accounting Managers through it.

Within 6 months, you’ll…

  • Enhance or redesign reconciliations to show substantial backup and clear explanation of work.
  • Lead one project or system change end to end: write the project plan, estimate the work, state your confidence in the timeline, and deliver on it.
  • Design and ship an automation (using NetSuite, Excel, and/or AI tools) that reduces manual effort in the close or reporting process and gets data to stakeholders faster.
  • Present to the team on a regular cadence (e.g., monthly) and take on additional accounting responsibilities.

Within 12 months, you’ll…

  • Be the recognized subject matter expert for your areas, the person others consult on complex accounting questions, while owning an expanded set of areas and meeting close deadlines.
  • Drive process improvements that change how the team operates, with measurable results (e.g., close days saved, hours of manual work removed).

Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States.

Hiring Range
$112,500—$148,500 USD

Working at Posit:

  • We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms.
  • We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously.
  • We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit.
  • We operate under a unique sustainable business model: We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now.
  • Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here.

Notable:

We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only.

  • 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums are covered for employees and their families! Fertility and gender-affirming healthcare is included in all of our plans.
  • Supplemental mental health and wellness benefits are available via Ginger even if you don’t opt in to our insurance plans, including Ginger for teen family members.
  • Posit's gender-neutral paid parental leave policy covers all new parents, including foster and adoptive parents.
  • All full-time employees are eligible for 401k enrollment starting on day one.
    • After six months of employment, Posit provides a substantial yearly match to employee 401K contributions.
  • An annual profit-sharing bonus for employees recognizes our team’s contributions to company performance across the year.
  • We are a 100% distributed team. You are also welcome to come into our Boston office.
    • We offer a $400 monthly reimbursement for coworking space rental if you prefer to work away from home.
  • Our Lifestyle Savings Account offers an initial deposit of $1800 and then an additional quarterly stipend of $375 to cover the costs of professional development, wellness, financial health, charitable giving, and remote work support.
  • We provide a flexible environment with a generous vacation policy that encourages a minimum of four weeks PTO per year plus 15 paid company holidays.

Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you!

Posit is committed to being a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applicants of different backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed.

jobs.excerpt: About the role:The cybersecurity team at FYUL is deliberately small and execution-focused.
jobs.description:
About the role:

The cybersecurity team at FYUL is deliberately small and execution-focused. Its engineering branch runs the company's security operations backbone: a large-scale telemetry and detection platform covering endpoints, network traffic, cloud workloads, and SaaS — a modern SIEM at its core, extended with substantial custom machine learning and AI agents that this team designs and builds itself. This senior engineer role, reporting directly to the Information Security Engineering Manager, owns significant parts of that platform: detection engineering, vulnerability discovery, cloud and endpoint security, data loss prevention, and the automation of security operations.

This is an individual-contributor position where professional growth comes from depth of expertise and ownership of outcomes. The security program is mature, with governance and compliance handled by a dedicated GRC function — so this role is about building and running security engineering, full-time.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Detection engineering. Design, implement, and tune detections across our security telemetry — SIEM rules as well as custom ML models for anomaly and risk detection. Triage alerts, investigate real incidents, and drive them to closure — including technical incident response and post-incident improvement.

  • Cloud and platform security. Harden and monitor our AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) environments: workload security, IAM, container runtime defense, and configuration standards. Collaborate with engineering teams so security lands as enablement, not friction.

  • Endpoint security. Own the health and hardening of the endpoint agent fleet across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

  • Data loss prevention. Operate and extend DLP coverage across removable media, email, and SaaS channels: telemetry-driven detection of data exfiltration, tuned to keep false positives low.

  • Security automation. Automate recurring operations and detection-to-response workflows — including AI-based agents and pipelines, which are already a working part of this program. Prefer integrating established tooling over bespoke development where it delivers the same outcome.

  • Vulnerability discovery and management. Find infrastructure vulnerabilities yourself — through scanning, configuration review, and targeted penetration testing of our environments — then prioritize and drive remediation to closure. This is not an application security role: a dedicated sub-team covers appsec.

Your qualifications:

  • 5+ years in security engineering or SecOps roles with hands-on responsibility for detections and incidents in production — not solely policy or advisory work.

  • Real detection engineering experience on a modern SIEM/security platform (Elastic Security preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, or comparable count), and the appetite to go beyond built-in rules into custom ML-based detection.

  • Deep, hands-on mastery of Linux, macOS, and Windows: internals, hardening, and investigation on all three. You have personally hunted or hardened systems on each of them, not just one favorite.

  • Strong networking expertise: TCP/IP, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and packet-level analysis — you can reconstruct what happened from a packet capture and reason about how traffic actually flows through our environments.

  • Strong cloud security foundation in AWS, including Kubernetes; you have personally secured and monitored production cloud workloads.

  • Hands-on LLM experience. You have built or operated LLM-powered tooling — agents, pipelines, or detection/automation workflows — not merely used a chat assistant. Our security program already runs AI agents in production; you will extend that work.

  • A certification in practical infrastructure hacking or hardening — e.g., OSCP, OSEP, or a comparable hands-on offensive credential. This matters more to us than knowledge-exam certifications.

  • Demonstrated automation capability: scripts, integrations, pipelines, or AI-assisted workflows you can show. Software engineering background is not required; a track record of building practical automation is.

  • Self-directed working style with strong ownership: the ability to take ambiguous problems through to completed outcomes with minimal supervision.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Further certifications (e.g., CISSP, GIAC/GCFA/GCIH, AWS Security) are an advantage, but the hands-on hacking/hardening credential above is the one we screen for. Hands-on experience always outweighs certification.


Our tech stack:

  • Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Atlantis

  • Engineering Tools:Postman, Git, GitHub Copilot, PhpStorm, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus.

  • Remote work Tools:Jira, Miro, Google Workspace, Slack.

  • Development Practices:Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Continuous Integration/Deployment.

What we offer:

  • Monthly salary EUR €4,000 - €6,000/monthgross, depending on work experience, education, and skills

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

You will run Caliza’s hiring from first outreach to first day. We are hiring across engineering, compliance, sales and customer success in the US, Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia, and you will build the process that brings those people in and sets them up to succeed. You will partner with every leader on the team and lay the foundation for people operations as we grow.

What you’ll do

Own full-cycle recruiting across every team: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, references and closing.

Run Lever: job postings, pipelines, scorecards, reporting and hiring manager workflows.

Partner with hiring managers to define each role, build structured interview loops and hold a consistent hiring bar.

Source directly for hard-to-fill roles, including regulated compliance and licensing roles and regional sales roles in new markets.

Manage offers within approved compensation bands, working with Finance on approvals.

Coordinate onboarding and offboarding: documentation, equipment, system access and first-week plans.

Work with Risk and Compliance on employment agreements, contractor classification, background checks and hiring across jurisdictions, including through employer-of-record providers.

Build the basics of people operations as we scale: HR systems, policies, onboarding playbooks and employee records.

Report weekly to the leadership team on pipeline health and progress against the hiring plan.

What you’ll bring

4+ years of in-house recruiting at a high-growth startup. Fintech, payments or other regulated industries are a plus.

A track record of hiring across several countries, including Latin America.

Experience closing senior and technical candidates.

Hands-on experience with an applicant tracking system, Lever preferred.

The organization to run 10+ open roles at once while keeping every candidate informed.

Professional working fluency in English. Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus.

Ability to work hours that overlap with US Eastern and Brazil time zones.

Nice to have

Experience setting up people operations at an early-stage company.

Familiarity with employer-of-record providers such as Deel, Remote or Oyster.

Experience recruiting in Africa or Asia.

Experience using AI tools for sourcing, screening or interview scheduling.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

Recruitment fraud. Caliza will never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency during the hiring process. Official communications come only from Caliza email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, please report it to our team.

General Responsibilities

Portfolio Management and Fundraising:

  • Develop and implement individualized qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies for assigned constituents.

  • Build a consistent pipeline of prospective donors through qualification, discovery, engagement, and solicitation.
  • Identify individuals with major and planned gift potential and partner with senior development colleagues to develop appropriate next-step strategies and transitions.
  • Meet or exceed established annual goals for fundraising revenue, donor visits, qualifications, solicitations, renewals, upgrades, and other key performance indicators.
  • Use prospect research, data analysis, and portfolio management tools to evaluate, prioritize, and strategically manage assigned relationships.

Donor Engagement and Relationship Building:

  • that deepen their connection to Bennington College and strengthen their understanding of the
  • College’s priorities and impact.
  • Serve as a visible and knowledgeable representative of Bennington College within the Western United States.
  • Listen closely to donor interests and motivations and connect those interests with appropriate opportunities to support the College.

The College

Bennington College is a small residential liberal arts college in southern Vermont, long distinguished for its progressive approach to higher education. The College was founded in 1932 on the principle of active engagement in learning, which is manifest in individualized plans of study developed by students together with faculty. We serve a diverse student population, and our faculty and staff also reflect diverse backgrounds and identities. Our aim is to educate students towards self-fulfillment and constructive social purposes, and we believe that equity, diversity, and inclusivity--in community and in curriculum--are vital to achieving those aims.

Nestled at the foot of the Green Mountains in Vermont, the campus consists of approximately 370 acres. The College was named one of ten with the best architecture by Architectural Digest. From campus, it is a short drive to the cultural offerings of the northern Berkshires in Massachusetts, Albany, New York, and many of Vermont’s top recreational centers. New York City, Boston, and Burlington, Vermont are all within three and a half hours by car.

Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. What We’re Looking For

The Director of Product Science ensures the scientific credibility and rigor of Datavant Life Sciences’ real-world evidence and data discovery agents. The (Sr.) Director of Product Science works closely with product and engineering stakeholders and is accountable to ensure agent conceptualization, development, and evaluation meet the needs of Datavant’s internal and external scientific customers and the scientific standards of the Datavant science team. Specifically, the (Sr.) Director works across and within product zones (e.g. evidence generation, data discovery) and product pods (e.g. algorithm builder, explore assistant) on the following:

  • Scientific agent conceptualization (e.g. why is the agent needed? and for whom?)
  • Scientific problem statement
  • Agent task and bounds
  • Scientific workflow design & SME review/decision points
  • Scientific reference set and agent context
  • Scientific evaluation design and application
  • Scientific internal testing requirements and execution

The scope of this role includes application of domain knowledge and RWE expertise in the development of agents and agent systems intended to complete scientific tasks. As the senior scientific leader working within the product pods and zones, the Director is accountable for scientific submissions for product/roadmap governance review, including eval sets, agent performance metrics, etc. The role also serves as the SME on the non-agentic scientific workflows relevant to the agent/agent system.

In addition to working within the product pods, the Director serves as the science lead for customer delivery of agent co-build/co-development/co-design scientific partnerships with Datavant’s pharma and data ecosystem customers. In this role, the Director is responsible and accountable for the scientific quality of the contracted and delivered scientific work, which may include the design of customer-specific agentic RWE workflows, application of those workflows to customer SOPs, design and development of customer-specific agents for RWE tasks across the workflow, and evaluation of those agents.

The Director contributes to agentic AI scientific thought leadership activities at the discretion of the Head of Product Science and the Chief Science Officer (CSO). This may include contributions to blogs, webinars, and/or live presentations at scientific meetings.

The Director contributes to scientific support of GTM teams on translating customer and competitor intelligence and identifying market signals.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Doctorate or master’s degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, or a related field
  • Professional research experience in real-world evidence (RWE), pharmacoepidemiology, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), or a closely related field: at least 3 years after a doctorate or 6 years after a master’s degree for Director; at least 5 years after a doctorate or 8 years after a master’s degree for Senior Director
  • Strong command of observational study design, healthcare data, and analytic methods, with the ability to assess methodological choices and interpret findings in light of study limitations.
  • Ability to drive progress across cross-functional product teams, manage competing priorities, resolve scientific and product delivery challenges, and negotiate scope and timelines.
  • Experience managing or providing matrix leadership to colleagues, including coaching and substantive feedback: at least 1 year for Director or 2 years for Senior Director.
  • Bring rigorous scientific judgment to RWE product development, challenging assumptions, critically evaluating proposed features and analytic outputs, and recommending changes that strengthen scientific validity and usefulness for researchers
  • Excellent scientific writing and communication skills, including the ability to present findings to both scientific and non-scientific audiences
  • Extensive experience with multiple types of healthcare data used in RWE research and familiarity with analytic tools or evidence generation platforms (e.g. R, Python, Substantiate)

What Helps You Stand Out

  • Experience in roles requiring scientific judgment, strategic problem-solving, and leadership of complex initiatives across scientific, technical, commercial, and operations functions
  • Experience developing scientific standards, study templates, quality processes, or methodological guidance used across teams.
  • Experience representing an organization as a subject matter expert in workshops, webinars, and professional forums
  • A record of peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or other external scientific contributions; for Senior Director candidates, a track record of high-impact work
  • Experience leveraging AI tools (agents or LLMs) for scientific work products and fluency in basic AI terminology
