Role purpose

The BambooHR Systems Specialist will undertake a comprehensive review of GoGlobal’s existing BambooHR configuration, assess system effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve functionality, reporting, workflows, data integrity and automation. Working under the strategic direction of the Fractional Head of People, and closely with the HR Process & Operations Consultant, the specialist will translate agreed business requirements and future-state HR processes into practical system solutions. This is a hands-on role responsible for configuring, testing and implementing improvements—not simply providing recommendations.

Reporting / Key stakeholders

Working under the strategic direction of the Fractional Head of People, in close partnership with the HR Process & Operations Consultant and the wider People & Talent leadership team. The specialist will engage process owners and relevant IT/data stakeholders as required. No direct reports are anticipated.

Key responsibilities

System audit and recommendations

  • Review current BambooHR setup, modules, permissions, employee data structures, fields, approval routes and integrations.
  • Identify configuration gaps, duplicated processes, manual workarounds, security or data-quality risks, and opportunities to simplify.
  • Produce a prioritised improvement plan with quick wins, dependencies, effort estimates and longer-term recommendations.

Reporting, analytics and data

  • Assess existing reporting capabilities and requirements across People, Talent, Reward and leadership.
  • Build and optimise accurate, repeatable standard and custom reports and dashboards, including headcount, turnover, absence, onboarding and other agreed KPIs.

Workflows, automation and employee lifecycle

  • · Assess existing workflows, notifications, approvals, forms and self-service across full employee life cycle, including onboarding, employee changes, leave and offboarding; partner with the HR Process & Operations Consultant to translate agreed future-state processes into BambooHR configurations.

  • · Test solutions with process owners and document exceptions, ownership and controls.

Operating model and role boundaries

  • The HR Process & Operations Consultant leads current-state process mapping, benchmarking, future-state process redesign, ownership, SOPs and process rollout. The BambooHR Systems Specialist leads system assessment, technical solution design, configuration, reporting, testing and system handover. Both work collaboratively under the Fractional Head of People. The systems specialist does not independently redesign HR processes, but should constructively challenge designs where BambooHR limitations or better technical options need consideration.

Implementation and ongoing support

  • Implement agreed configuration changes in BambooHR, coordinating testing, rollout and change communications.
  • Provide practical guidance on system capabilities, limitations, integrations and sensible alternatives where needed.
  • Train HR administrators and relevant managers; create concise configuration and process documentation.
  • Support a sustainable operating model, including system ownership, change control and future optimisation.

Experience and capabilities

  • Essential: demonstrable hands-on expertise auditing, administering, configuring and optimising BambooHR, including reporting, workflows, permissions, data management and automation, ideally in a growing or international organisation.

  • Experience with HRIS audits, process mapping, testing, documentation and stakeholder training.

Expected deliverables

Initially a focused consultancy engagement, with scope and duration to be agreed following discovery. We are looking for someone who can both advise and execute, not solely provide strategic recommendations.

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.

    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.

Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.

Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Media & Growth | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing Manager to plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven digital campaigns that generate leads, customers, and measurable revenue.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who understands how to turn advertising budgets into business results. You’ll manage paid campaigns, analyze performance, improve conversion efficiency, and continuously test audiences, creatives, messaging, and channels.

You’ll be accountable for metrics such as CPL, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and revenue impact — not just clicks and impressions.

What You’ll Own

Paid Media & Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns
  • Manage paid media across platforms such as:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Other relevant performance marketing channels
  • Monitor campaign budgets, pacing, and overall performance
  • Adjust targeting, bids, budgets, and campaign structures based on results
  • Ensure campaigns remain aligned with lead generation and revenue goals

Performance Analysis & Optimization

  • Track and analyze key performance metrics, including:
    • Cost per Lead (CPL)
    • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Conversion Rate
    • Cost per Acquisition (CPA)
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and diagnose potential causes
  • Make data-driven decisions to improve campaign efficiency
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance trends

Audience, Keyword & Market Research

  • Conduct audience and customer research to improve targeting
  • Perform keyword research for paid search campaigns
  • Identify new audience segments and targeting opportunities
  • Monitor competitor activity and relevant market trends
  • Translate research into actionable campaign opportunities

Creative & Landing Page Collaboration

  • Collaborate on campaign messaging, offers, and creative direction
  • Work with designers, copywriters, or internal stakeholders on advertising assets
  • Support landing page optimization to improve conversion rates
  • Provide performance insights that help improve:
    • Ad copy
    • Creative concepts
    • Calls to action
    • Offers
    • Landing pages

Conversion Tracking & Attribution

  • Monitor conversion tracking across campaigns and digital channels
  • Work with analytics and tracking tools to understand the customer journey
  • Ensure campaign performance is measured accurately
  • Analyze attribution and identify which campaigns, channels, and audiences drive results
  • Troubleshoot tracking inconsistencies when required

Testing & Growth

  • Build structured testing plans across:
    • Audiences
    • Creatives
    • Messaging
    • Offers
    • Landing pages
    • Channels
  • Run A/B tests and analyze results
  • Scale winning campaigns while reducing inefficient spend
  • Identify new opportunities to improve acquisition performance

Reporting & Insights

  • Create regular campaign performance reports
  • Communicate results clearly to leadership and stakeholders
  • Highlight performance trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Translate campaign data into clear recommendations and next steps
  • Maintain visibility into advertising spend and business impact

Requirements

  • 2+ years of digital marketing or performance marketing experience
  • Hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns
  • Experience with one or more platforms such as:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Similar paid acquisition platforms
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, CAC, CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rates
  • Experience managing advertising budgets
  • Comfortable analyzing campaign data and making optimization decisions
  • Strong understanding of audience targeting and campaign testing
  • Strong communication and reporting skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Analytics and digital tracking tools
  • Experience with conversion tracking and attribution
  • Experience optimizing landing pages and conversion funnels
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms
  • Experience managing campaigns across multiple paid channels
  • B2B, SaaS, e-commerce, agency, or lead-generation marketing experience

Tools & Platforms

Google Ads | Meta Ads | LinkedIn Ads | Google Analytics | Conversion Tracking & Attribution Tools | CRM & Marketing Platforms | Google Sheets / Excel

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Think in terms of revenue and acquisition efficiency, not vanity metrics
  • Are comfortable owning campaign performance
  • Enjoy analyzing data and turning it into action
  • Know how to balance creative experimentation with performance analysis
  • Proactively identify ways to improve CPL, CAC, ROAS, and conversion rates
  • Test systematically instead of relying on assumptions
  • Can clearly explain campaign performance to stakeholders

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing campaign spend, CPL, CAC, ROAS, and conversion performance across active channels.

You’ll optimize campaigns, research new audiences or keywords, review creative performance, collaborate on landing pages and messaging, verify conversion tracking, and launch new tests.

You’ll also prepare performance reports and identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns or improve underperforming ones.

In short: you turn paid media budgets into measurable leads, customers, and revenue through continuous testing and optimization.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Cost per Lead (CPL)
  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Cost per Acquisition (CPA)
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Lead and customer conversion rates
  • Advertising budget efficiency
  • Qualified leads and customers generated
  • Revenue attributed to marketing campaigns
  • Performance improvement from ongoing testing

  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Performance Marketing / Campaign Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.

As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. Lead and Develop Your Team

Collaborate Across Ascend

  • Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale

  • Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset
  • 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines

  • A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership
  • Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

What Makes You Stand Out

We are especially interested in candidates who:

  • Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove
  • Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them
  • Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client
  • Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path

The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain

We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

Work-Life Balance

Learn While You Lead

Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

  • Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?

  • Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?
  • Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

Why You'll Love This Role

This is perfect for someone who:

  • Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders
  • Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership
  • Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow
  • Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, and Benefits

Ascend is a remote-first, global team. This role is structured as a direct independent contractor engagement, with compensation being stated in USD and be paid in your local currency

As this is an independent contractor engagement, the compensation will not follow a traditional local payroll structure or salary breakup. This means statutory deductions or components or other local payroll-linked benefits are not applicable unless specifically required under the terms of engagement or communicated in writing by Ascend. Contractors are responsible for managing any applicable taxes, filings, and compliance requirements in their own location.

This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends, or public holidays depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.

The consolidated monthly compensation is designed to account for the nature of the role, including rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime, or additional hours are not applicable unless specifically communicated otherwise for a particular role.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

At Salesloft, our Senior Commercial Account Managers are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:

  • Full-Cycle Account Ownership: Serving as the primary point of contact and ultimate owner of the account relationship, managing all commercial transactions including upsells, cross-sells, and the end-to-end renewal process.
  • Driving Net-New Revenue: Actively prospecting within your assigned territory to identify, qualify, and close new ACV opportunities within your install base to expand your total book of business. Actively hunt for opportunities to introduce additional products or seat expansions to existing customers, maximizing the lifetime value (LTV) of your portfolio.
  • Account Planning: Developing and executing success plans for high-value accounts to ensure long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.
  • Proactive Retention Management: Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.
  • Executive Relationship Building: Cultivating ties with VPs, C-suite executives and key stakeholders to move beyond a vendor relationship and become a trusted business advisor.
  • Forecasting & Pipeline Accuracy: Provide leadership with accurate monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts for both net new bookings and churn.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence: Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex client issues and ensure seamless post-sale transitions.
  • Segmented Renewal Strategy: Partnering with Renewal Account Managers to streamline the execution of long-tail, lower-spend accounts, while simultaneously identifying and "cherry-picking" growth potential within that book to migrate into higher-value tiers.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Senior Commercial Account Manager. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.

Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.

If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!

Our Salesloft Senior Commercial Sales team is comprised of motivated sales professionals with a strong desire to win.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The Senior Commercial Account Management team consists of results-oriented SaaS sales professionals with a strong desire to win. The AMs on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about evangelizing the future of sales innovation.

  • 4+ years of proven relationship building and closing experience in a sales environment.
  • Experience establishing strategic C-level relationships
  • Ability to run a full sales lifecycle, start to finish, within the SMB segment
  • Experience executing detailed product presentations and web demonstrations of our software capabilities to C-level executives, directors, and sales managers
  • Adept at identifying and utilizing internal resources (Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Support etc.) to build Salesloft brand awareness, assist in sales cycles, and close deals.
  • Collaborative mentality by prioritizing 'we' and not focusing on 'me.'
  • Superb listening skills; you must understand objections and defeat them by turning sceptics into ecstatic new customers
  • High level of empathy - it's important for our AM's to be a good person to peers and prospects.
  • Experience managing, expanding, and renewing customer relationships.
  • Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.excerpt: Exterro is seeking a proactive and resourceful Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team.
jobs.description:
Exterro is seeking a proactive and resourceful Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team. This is a remote-first position. Starting out, much of your time will be spent managing a broad portfolio of commercial, vendor, partner, and consulting contracts, with the remaining time dedicated to building skills across privacy, compliance, product counseling, and other areas. This role demands a deep understanding of technology and SaaS contracts, the ability to engage with stakeholders across the business, and the instinct to anticipate legal issues and develop proactive solutions before they become problems. This is a ground-floor opportunity for a lawyer who wants to grow into a senior in-house leader, with a clear path to expand your scope as you develop.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Security, Compliance, and Product teams to mitigate legal risk while facilitating revenue growth and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in technology transactions (specifically SaaS), a genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging legal technology tools, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Negotiation & Drafting

  • Draft, review, and negotiate SaaS subscription agreements, enterprise license agreements, order forms, partner and reseller agreements, SOWs, and amendments.

  • Negotiate customer and vendor contracts, including MSAs, DPAs, BAAs, NDAs, and professional services agreements.

  • Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and clause libraries to improve speed and consistency.

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to close deals efficiently while managing risk.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • As you grow in the role, take on increasing responsibility across privacy and data protection (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA), product counseling, compliance, commercial dispute resolution, and marketing with go-to-market support.

  • Assist with global privacy compliance initiatives (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, emerging U.S. state privacy laws, and AI regulations such as the EU AI Act).

  • Assist with dispute resolutions. Provide guidance on contract interpretations, operational compliance, and pre-litigation commercial disputes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & General Support

  • Act as a strategic legal partner to internal business teams, providing timely, practical legal advice that moves deals and projects forward.

  • Collaborate with IT/Security, Compliance, and Finance teams to ensure commercial and vendor agreements align with corporate risk tolerances and budget requirements.

  • Conduct legal research and stay current on legislation, regulatory developments, and case law affecting privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, AI regulation, open source licensing, and SaaS industry contracting practices.

  • Collaborate with external legal counsel when necessary.

  • Develop and implement internal policies and procedures to manage the company's legal and operational risk.

  • Provide training and guidance to internal teams on legal topics relevant to Exterro's business, including contract processes, data privacy, and compliance requirements.

  • Support incident response efforts, including data breach notification obligations and coordination with Security and Compliance teams.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Education & Credentials

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.

  • Active member in good standing of at least one State Bar.

Experience

  • 3–6 years of experience practicing law, with a primary focus on commercial contracts and technology transactions.

  • Proven experience in a corporate in-house legal department or a law firm tech/commercial practice group.

  • Deep familiarity with SaaS business models, software licensing, and cloud computing legal issues.

  • Working knowledge of global data privacy, AI and security frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2).

  • Enthusiasm for AI, legal technology, and using new tools to work smarter. You stay current on how technology is changing legal practice and look for ways to apply it.

Skills & Competencies

  • Commercial Pragmatism:Ability to balance legal risk with business objectives. You find solutions, not just problems, and you take initiative to drive them to completion without being asked.

  • Communication:Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.

  • Ownership and Problem-Solving: You dig into the details, get comfortable in the weeds, and take full ownership of your work. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of contracts simultaneously under tight deadlines.

  • Interpersonal Savvy:Cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across international teams and support cross-border commercial agreements (US, EMEA, APAC).

Why Exterro?

  • Impact: Play a key role in a company at the forefront of data risk management, helping businesses safeguard their data in an increasingly complex digital world.

  • Growth Opportunity: Join a rapidly growing organization where there is room for learning, development and upward mobility.

  • Culture: Work in an innovative, inclusive, and collaborative environment, where your contributions are valued, and your professional development is supported.

Exterro participates in E-Verify and is a drug-free workplace. All employment offers are contingent upon the successful passing of a background check.

We believe in the importance of pay transparency and strive to create a fair and equitable workplace for all employees. As a remote first organization, our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The salary range for this remote position is $143,000-$165,000 per year, based on skills, experience and qualifications. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate. Exterro is a total compensation company, and this role may be eligible for variable pay, equity, bonus and/or other forms of compensation as part of the package. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, retirement plans, flexible paid time off and more.

Candidates are encouraged to discuss their salary expectations during the interview process. We are committed to ensuring that compensation aligns with market standards and is commensurate with the responsibilities of the role.

All employees are responsible for understanding and adhering to the organization’s security and privacy policies, procedures, and standards. As part of your role, you are expected to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and systems within your scope of responsibility. Additionally, you are required to participate in mandatory security and privacy training and ensure that best practices are applied in all work activities.

Position type: Full-Time

  • Clinical or administrative experience in orthopedic or family medicine settings highly preferred.
  • Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) or other EMR/EHR systems is preferred but not required.
  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology and clinical documentation standards.
  • Ability to collect patient medical histories, review medications, and assist with medical questionnaires.
  • Familiarity with Nudge AI or other AI-powered medical scribing and documentation tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, organizational abilities, and attention to detail.

Basic Requirements

jobs.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for an experienced Transportation Logistics Specialist to manage the full scope of IT
hardware logistics across Europe and beyond — including racks, servers, and other data center
equipment. The role covers domestic European transport between our warehouses and data center
sites, inbound international freight from suppliers in Taiwan and other origins into Europe, outbound
shipments from Europe as required, and logistics to and from Israel. You will also be responsible for
RMA/RMS shipments and ensuring smooth, timely delivery of hardware across all lanes. This is a hands-
on, operationally focused role requiring strong attention to detail, excellent vendor management skills,
and the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Logistics Operations

• Manage end-to-end transport of IT hardware — rack systems, servers, and other data center
equipment — across all lanes: domestic European moves, inbound international shipments
(primarily from Taiwan-based suppliers), outbound from Europe as required, and shipments to

and from Israel.

• Coordinate inbound freight scheduling for both domestic and international shipments, including
air freight from Taiwan and other origins, managing carrier and freight forwarder
selection and delivery execution to ensure on-time, damage-free arrival at European sites.
• Handle all RMA and RMS shipments, including coordination with vendors, carriers, and internal
teams to ensure accurate and timely processing.
• Manage equipment transfers between company warehouses and data center facilities across
Europe, optimising routes and minimising handling risk.
• Maintain full visibility over active shipments across all lanes and proactively resolve transit
issues, delays, or exceptions.
• Develop contingency plans and alternative routing strategies to ensure business continuity.
• Manage time-critical air freight shipments where required, including carrier selection, booking,
and end-to-end tracking to ensure expedited delivery of hardware.
Coordination & Documentation
• Coordinate closely with data center operations teams to support staging, buffering, and just-in-
time hardware deployment.
• Maintain accurate in-transit inventory records and ensure proper chain-of-custody
documentation for all shipments.
• Manage all shipment-related documentation in relevant systems (Jira, TMS, or equivalent),
ensuring records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
• Manage customs documentation and clearance processes for all cross-border shipments,
including inbound from Taiwan, transfers within Europe, and shipments to and from Israel.
• Process and reconcile logistics invoices; manage payments for transportation operations,
including ZIP payments to the appropriate vendors and partners.
• Work with the security team to establish and maintain secure shipment protocols and ensure
compliance with physical security requirements.
Compliance & Quality
• Ensure all shipments comply with applicable regulations — including EU transport and customs
requirements for domestic European moves, EU import/export regulations for international
freight, and relevant cross-border trade compliance requirements for shipments involving Israel.
• Manage VAT, duties, and customs declarations for inbound and outbound international
shipments in line with EU regulations.
• Maintain audit-ready documentation for all logistics activities, supporting internal (SOX) and
external compliance requirements.
• Establish and enforce SLAs and KPIs with freight carriers, forwarders, and 3PL partners; drive
accountability through regular performance reviews.
• Identify and escalate compliance gaps or process deviations, implementing corrective actions as
needed.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner with hardware engineering, procurement, finance, and data center operations to align
logistics execution with deployment timelines and business priorities.
• Collaborate with OEM suppliers (e.g., Giga, ASUS), primarily based in Taiwan, to coordinate
international shipping windows, batch tracking, customs documentation, and inbound
scheduling into European facilities.
• Coordinate with teams and partners in Israel to manage inbound and outbound shipments,
ensuring compliance with applicable import/export requirements.
• Act as the primary escalation point for European transport-related issues across internal teams
and external partners.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives through KPI tracking, root cause analysis, and process
standardisation.
Planning & Cost Management
• Forecast transportation demand based on data center expansion plans, hardware deployment
schedules, and capacity needs across European and international lanes.
• Identify cost optimisation opportunities through carrier consolidation, routing improvements,
and smarter scheduling.
• Track and report on logistics costs across all lanes, flagging variances and recommending
corrective actions.
• Support data-driven decision-making through regular reporting, dashboards, and operational

analytics.

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience in transportation, freight, or logistics management — ideally within
technology, data center, or hardware supply chain environments.
• Proven experience managing both domestic European and international freight operations,
including LTL/FTL, and air freight shipments, carrier and forwarder relationships,

and 3PL coordination.

• Solid understanding of EU customs regulations, import/export procedures, and cross-border
trade compliance within Europe and with non-EU countries.
• Experience managing shipments to or from Israel is an advantage; familiarity with relevant
customs and trade compliance requirements is a plus.
• Hands-on experience with RMA/RMS shipment processes and reverse logistics flows.
• Familiarity with TMS platforms, Jira, or similar systems used for shipment tracking and
documentation.
• Experience managing large, heavy, or high-value freight (server racks, IT infrastructure
equipment) is strongly preferred.
• Excellent organisational and documentation skills with a high standard for accuracy and
completeness.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to work cross-functionally
across technical and non-technical teams in an international environment.
• Self-starter mindset with the ability to operate independently in a remote environment.
• Based in Europe; Amsterdam preferred, other EU locations considered. Must be eligible to work
in the EU.
• Fluency in English required; additional European languages are an advantage.
Nice to Have
• Experience in a hyperscaler, cloud provider, or large-scale data center build-out environment.
• Experience with Asia-Pacific supply chains, particularly Taiwan-to-Europe freight lanes, including
familiarity with customs brokerage, import duties, and trade compliance.
• Background in supply chain analytics, reporting, or continuous improvement methodologies.
• Familiarity with physical security protocols for high-value hardware shipments.
• Experience working in or with logistics operations in the Netherlands, Germany, or other major

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

More than 700,000 users across 41 countries use our applications.

We are looking for a VMware Virtualization Engineer to strengthen our Virtualization and Network Infrastructure team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and develop production virtualization infrastructure based on VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter).
  • Support high-availability virtualization clusters and participate in incident resolution.
  • Analyze and resolve technical issues related to hypervisor performance, network infrastructure, and storage systems.
  • Work with storage systems using Fibre Channel and iSCSI.
  • Collaborate with the network infrastructure team to ensure the proper operation of the virtualization environment.
  • Participate in the installation, connection, and commissioning of server hardware.
  • Operate server remote management systems (iDRAC and similar tools).
  • Take part in infrastructure modernization, migration, and testing projects.

Requirements

  • Experience administering VMware vSphere in a production environment.
  • Understanding of VMware architecture, including the ESXi scheduler, NUMA architecture, memory management, and storage subsystem.
  • Experience working with storage systems: Fibre Channel zoning, multipathing, latency, and performance analysis.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Support Service Delivery Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: In 1931, electrical draftsman Harry Beck looked at London’s Underground map and saw a system that had become too complicated to understand.
jobs.description:
In 1931, electrical draftsman Harry Beck looked at London’s Underground map and saw a system that had become too complicated to understand.

The maps at the time tried to represent the city geographically. Beck realized that wasn’t what riders actually needed. What mattered was how the system connected: which lines went where, where you could transfer, and the simplest way to get from one place to another. So he redrew the network around those relationships instead. His design became the foundation for the modern Tube map and changed how people navigated London.

Mercury’s Customer Experience organization has its own increasingly complex network.

As Mercury grows, the right place for support work will keep changing. Some new or complex work may benefit from starting in an incubation team before we know how it should scale. From there, it might move into Core Support, remain specialized, transition to an outsourced partner, or become increasingly supported by AI-powered tooling. The challenge is knowing where work belongs at each stage of its lifecycle, when it’s ready to move, and how to make those transitions without compromising the customer experience.

For the first 9–12 months, a significant majority of your work will focus on our growing BPO partnership. You’ll identify opportunities to expand the work we deliver through that partnership, build the operational and financial case for doing so, align CX leadership around those recommendations, and lead approved transitions from initial scoping through stabilization.

Over time, the scope will broaden. You’ll apply the same thinking across our wider service delivery ecosystem, helping us evaluate when work should enter an incubation model, when it is ready to graduate, and whether its next home should be Core Support, a specialized team, an outsourced partner, AI-powered tooling, or another model as our capabilities evolve.

You won’t be the sole decision-maker on where work lives. Your role is to develop the recommendation: bring together the data, customer impact, operational realities, and tradeoffs; build a compelling case; and help CX leadership reach a well-informed decision. Once a direction is approved, you’ll own the program that turns it into reality.

This is a role for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. You should be equally energized by building a strong argument for how our service delivery model should evolve and by working through the operational details required to make that change succeed.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead high-impact programs that evolve how CX delivers support, with the first 9–12 months heavily focused on expanding and optimizing our BPO partnership.
  • Identify opportunities to move work to a different service delivery model and build the case for change using customer, operational, and financial data. This could include recommending that emerging or complex work move into incubation, as well as determining when incubated work is mature enough to transition into Core Support, a specialized team, or our BPO partnership.
  • Help define what makes work ready to move. Develop clear criteria for when a workflow needs incubation, when it has reached sufficient maturity and stability to graduate, and which delivery model is best positioned to own it next.
  • Evaluate where AI-powered tooling could take on, augment, or reshape support work, and partner with the right teams to build a clear case for when automation creates a better customer and business outcome.
  • Lead approved service delivery transitions end to end, whether work is moving into incubation, graduating from incubation, transitioning between internal teams, or moving to an outsourced partner. Own the program from initial scoping and business case through readiness, migration, ramp, stabilization, and handoff into long-term operations.
  • Partner across Workforce Management, Enablement, QA, Support, and other teams to build transition plans that account for capacity, training, knowledge transfer, quality, tooling, and operational readiness.
  • Define success before a transition begins and measure whether the change actually delivered the intended customer, quality, capacity, and cost outcomes.
  • Establish clear readiness and stabilization criteria so transitions are judged by whether they work, not simply whether they launched on time.
  • Bring structure to complex, ambiguous service delivery questions, identifying the right analysis, stakeholders, dependencies, and tradeoffs required to move from uncertainty to a clear recommendation.
  • Build repeatable frameworks and approaches that make future service delivery decisions faster, clearer, and more consistent.
  • Use what we learn from each transition to continuously improve how Support evaluates where work should live and how changes should be executed.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has 6+ years of experience in strategic program management, customer experience operations, service delivery, outsourcing, support operations, or a related field.
  • Has deep experience with outsourced service delivery and has personally led significant transitions of operational work into a BPO or similar partner environment.
  • Understands the operational machinery behind successful BPO transitions, including workforce planning, forecasting, training, knowledge transfer, quality management, ramp planning, and stabilization.
  • Can build a strong recommendation without needing to own the final decision. You know how to gather the right evidence, frame tradeoffs clearly, anticipate objections, and create alignment among senior stakeholders.
  • Thinks in systems. You naturally look beyond the performance of an individual team to understand how the broader service delivery model works and where changing it could produce a better outcome.
  • Is analytically rigorous and commercially minded. You’re comfortable working with operational and financial data, testing assumptions, building business cases, and making recommendations when the answer isn’t obvious.
  • Exercises strong judgment in ambiguous environments. You can take a question like “Is this still the right place for this work?” and determine what evidence, tradeoffs, and perspectives are needed to answer it well.
  • Can move seamlessly from recommendation to execution. You’re as comfortable developing the case for a service delivery change as you are working through the details required to make it successful.
  • Influences effectively without relying on formal authority. You know how to align teams with different priorities and constraints around a shared outcome.
  • Communicates complex decisions with clarity. You can explain the customer impact, operational implications, economics, and tradeoffs behind a recommendation without burying the decision in the analysis.
  • Holds a high bar for outcomes, not just completion. You care whether a transition delivered what we expected and are willing to revisit assumptions when the data tells us otherwise.

The ideal candidate may also have:

  • Experience designing or evolving a multi-tier customer support service delivery model.
  • Experience with BPO expansions, outsourced operations, vendor launches, or team and site stand-ups.
  • Experience moving work between different internal delivery models, such as from incubation to Core Support or between specialized and scaled support teams.
  • Experience evaluating how automation and AI-assisted support change the economics, complexity, or appropriate placement of customer support work.
  • Experience with incubation or pilot operating models, including determining when new or complex work should be isolated for learning and when it is ready to graduate into a scaled delivery environment.
  • Experience using SQL, Google Sheets, or business intelligence tools to evaluate operational performance and build business cases.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment where risk and operational complexity influence how work can be delivered.

Kodland is a fast-growing international digital school on a mission to help kids and teens unlock their creativity through coding, design, and digital skills. Thousands of students worldwide have already built their first websites, games, and digital projects with our support — and now we’re looking for passionate tutors to join us.

About the Role

Are you a programmer who loves coding and gaming? At Kodland, you’ll have the opportunity to turn your passion into impact by inspiring the next generation of creators. You’ll teach kids and teens how to design their own Roblox games, guiding them step by step as they bring their ideas to life. No prior experience with Roblox Studio? No problem — we’ll provide full training to help you succeed. This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere, as long as you’re available during UK teaching hours (afternoons/evenings on weekdays and mornings on weekends).

Responsibilities

  • Deliver fun, interactive Roblox Game Design lessons using our ready-to-teach materials.

  • Inspire students to create their first Roblox games and digital projects while building confidence in coding.

  • Track student progress, celebrate achievements, and provide guidance throughout their learning journey.

  • Share lesson feedback and contribute creative ideas to improve the learning experience.

  • Develop your teaching skills with support from experienced Kodland mentors.

  • Participate in mock lessons, training, and community events to enhance your skills and connect with other tutors.

Why Join Kodland?

Global Community – Connect with tutors worldwide through Slack, share experiences, and grow your network.

Motivation & Bonuses – Earn extra through our performance-based bonus system.

Professional Growth – Get regular feedback from education experts and access additional resources to improve your teaching.

Career Development – Many of our tutors have grown into new roles at Kodland thanks to our culture of continuous growth.

Flexibility & Freedom – As a freelance tutor, your income depends on your availability and the number of classes you teach. There’s no fixed cap — the more active you are, the more opportunities you can take on.

Real Impact – See your students go from beginners to creators, and know you’ve made a difference.

👉 Join our team today and inspire the next generation of game creators with Kodland! 💙

Requirements

Requirements

  • Programming knowledge (Python preferred).

  • STEM degree

  • Passion for teaching children and teenagers.

  • Fluent English (C1).

  • Availability for at least 10 hours per week during:

    • Weekdays: 4 pm - 10 pm ( Sdyney or Singapore time )

    • Weekends: 10 am– 8 pm (Sdyney or Singapore time )

  • Tech setup: stable internet (min 20 Mbps), webcam, headset, and quiet workspace.

  • A willingness to learn — we’ll provide Roblox Studio training and full onboarding.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Project Manager, Marketing Operations (Senior)

Location: Remote – Chile
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Independent Contractor
Industry: Technology / Marketing Operations Compensation: $2,167–$2,667 USD/month
Experience: Minimum 7 Years in Project Management

Schedule: 40 Hours/Week Preferred

Minimum 30 Hours for Exceptional Candidates

English Proficiency: Strong Professional Written and Verbal English Required

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Project Manager, Marketing Operations (Senior) to support the operational rhythm of a marketing team focused on customer acquisition across multiple business segments.

This position serves as the operational backbone of the team, ensuring recurring meetings, project timelines, status updates, action items, and cross-functional initiatives remain organized and on track.

You will work closely with senior marketing leadership and regional campaign teams, providing structure, visibility, and consistent follow-through across multiple workstreams.

The ideal candidate has at least 7 years of project management experience, preferably within Marketing Operations, and can contribute immediately with minimal supervision.

Exceptional communication skills are essential. You must be able to translate discussions into clear action plans, communicate progress proactively, and maintain consistent responsiveness.

This is an operational project management position, not a marketing strategy or hands-on campaign execution role.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Collaborate directly with senior marketing leadership and cross-functional teams.

  • Take ownership of high-visibility project coordination and operational processes.

  • Improve workflows, reporting, accountability, and team communication.

  • Work with modern collaboration, project management, and AI tools.

  • Contribute to an evolving operational environment with meaningful autonomy.

What You'll Do

Project Management & Meeting Coordination

  • Coordinate recurring meetings, including senior leadership revenue reviews, cross-functional alignment sessions, and weekly status updates.

  • Prepare agendas, document key decisions, identify action owners, and track commitments through completion.

  • Maintain project plans, timelines, trackers, and status reports.

  • Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and outstanding priorities clearly and consistently.

  • Ensure deadlines and deliverables are followed through without requiring constant reminders.

Marketing Operations & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate multiple parallel workstreams supporting customer acquisition initiatives.

  • Consolidate updates from regional marketing teams and campaign leads.

  • Identify duplicated efforts, operational delays, dependencies, and workflow gaps.

  • Track campaign progress at an operational level without directly managing campaign strategy or execution.

  • Coordinate with marketing, sales, and other stakeholders to resolve handoff issues.

  • Maintain clear visibility into priorities, progress, and outstanding action items.

Tools, Processes & Operational Improvement

  • Use project management and collaboration tools to organize workflows, documentation, and reporting.

  • Work within an environment using Google Workspace, Slack, Claude, Smartsheet, and Quickbase.

  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements to operational processes.

  • Help distinguish immediate operational solutions from longer-term workflow improvements.

  • Maintain organized documentation and reliable project tracking systems.

  • Proactively establish structure and accountability across evolving processes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of professional project management experience, preferably supporting marketing operations or cross-functional business teams.

  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects, stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and actionable updates.

  • Experience preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and managing follow-ups.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, accountability, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Experience using digital project management and collaboration platforms.

  • Ability to quickly learn new tools and adapt to established workflows.

  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently and contribute immediately with minimal supervision.

  • Consistent responsiveness, proactive communication, and reliable follow-through.

  • Strong professional English proficiency.

  • Availability for 40 hours per week preferred, with flexibility for exceptional candidates available for at least 30 hours per week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in Marketing Operations, particularly supporting customer acquisition teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Google Workspace, Slack, Claude, and Smartsheet.

  • Hands-on Quickbase experience — a significant advantage.

  • Experience coordinating regional or distributed marketing teams.

  • Experience improving project management processes, reporting, and operational workflows.

  • Familiarity with marketing campaign operations and sales handoff processes.

  • Availability aligned with U.S. Central Time business hours.

Note: Hands-on CRM administration, marketing automation expertise, and campaign execution experience are not required.

How Success Is Measured

  • Recurring meetings are well-organized, documented, and followed through consistently.

  • Project deliverables, deadlines, and action items are accurately tracked.

  • Stakeholders receive clear, timely, and proactive communication.

  • Multiple workstreams progress without unnecessary delays or confusion.

  • Operational bottlenecks and duplicated efforts are identified and addressed early.

  • Leadership has reliable visibility into project progress and outstanding priorities.

  • Operational workflows become more efficient, structured, and consistent.

Why Join Us?

  • $2,167–$2,667 USD/month compensation.

  • Fully remote opportunity from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile.

  • Preferred 40-hour workweek, with flexibility for exceptional candidates.

  • Direct collaboration with senior marketing leadership and cross-functional teams.

  • Opportunity to improve operational processes and project management systems.

  • Meaningful autonomy and ownership over daily execution.

Important Notes

This is a project management and marketing operations role, not a marketing strategy, paid media, or campaign execution position.

A minimum of 7 years of project management experience is required. Candidates should be comfortable taking ownership of operational responsibilities from the beginning.

Clear, reliable communication is non-negotiable. Candidates must demonstrate consistent responsiveness, structured updates, and strong follow-through.

Quickbase experience is a major advantage, but not mandatory. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Claude, and Smartsheet is highly valued.

The preferred schedule is 40 hours per week, with flexibility for exceptional candidates who can commit to at least 30 hours per week. U.S. Central Time alignment is preferred, but other time zones may be considered.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise database solutions supporting high-volume transactional systems, financial applications, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical business operations. This role focuses on building scalable PL/SQL applications, optimizing complex SQL queries, developing database objects, and ensuring high availability and performance across large Oracle environments.
You will work closely with application developers, database administrators, data architects, QA engineers, and business analysts to build efficient database solutions that support enterprise applications, cloud modernization initiatives, and data integration platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Oracle Database technologies, advanced PL/SQL programming, query optimization, and performance tuning while maintaining high standards for data integrity, security, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects supporting enterprise applications.
  • Develop highly optimized SQL queries for large transactional and analytical databases.
  • Design scalable database schemas, indexing strategies, partitioning models, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Build ETL processes and database integration components for enterprise data movement and synchronization.
  • Develop batch processing jobs and automated database workflows supporting business-critical operations.
  • Analyze execution plans, identify SQL bottlenecks, and optimize database performance for high-volume systems.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to design efficient database access patterns and API integrations.
  • Implement database security, auditing, role-based access controls, and data encryption standards.

  • Participate in Agile development activities, architecture reviews, and production support rotations.

  • Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL including packages, stored procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, collections, exceptions, and dynamic SQL.

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL*Plus, or similar Oracle development tools.
  • Experience developing ETL processes and integrating Oracle databases with external systems.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, RMAN, and database migration methodologies.
  • Experience working with Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ), Scheduler, and database jobs.
  • Experience integrating Oracle databases with Java, .NET, Python, or REST-based enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of database normalization, data modeling, and relational database design principles.
  • Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines for database deployment automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Database Services or Autonomous Database.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Exadata, RAC (Real Application Clusters), and Data Guard environments.
  • Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Oracle SOA Suite.

jobs.description:
Team: Growth, part of the Revenue organization · Reports to: Director of Growth · Location: Remote

Who we are

Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organizations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

About the role

We're looking for a Growth Product Manager to drive product-led growth across the customer lifecycle: acquisition, conversion, retention and expansion. You'll sit in our Revenue organization and own the product levers behind our self-serve motion, with an impact that reaches across the wider customer base.

This is a product management role with a growth focus. You'll work with the leadership team to set measurable goals, build and run the growth roadmap, and work closely with engineering, design and data to ship experiments and product changes that move revenue metrics.

What you'll do

  • Partner with the Director of Growth and Chief Revenue Officer to shape the growth strategy, and translate it into clear priorities and plans.

  • Own the growth roadmap and the metrics it is meant to move, from conversion through to retention and expansion.

  • Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using product data, funnel analysis and user insight.

  • Design, run and analyze A/B tests and other experiments, and turn the results into clear decisions.

  • Use LLMs and AI tools to prototype and demo ideas quickly, then write clear product requirements and partner with engineering and design to take initiatives from discovery through launch and post-release optimization.

  • Define, track and report on growth KPIs, explaining what is driving movement and what it means for priorities.

  • Bring a point of view on the biggest opportunities across the customer lifecycle, from conversion through to retention and expansion, and make the case for larger bets backed by evidence.

  • Collaborate across product, engineering, design, data, marketing and customer-facing teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What success looks like

  • Clear ownership of growth metrics. Core KPIs across conversion, retention and expansion have agreed definitions and a regular reporting rhythm, and you can explain not just how they moved but why.

  • A disciplined experimentation program. Experiments run on a steady cadence, each with a clear hypothesis, success criteria and a documented readout that leads to a decision.

  • Reliable delivery. You consistently ship what you commit to and keep stakeholders aligned along the way.

  • Evidence-backed bets. You make the case for larger bets, take them through to delivery, and measure their impact against what was predicted, including the misses.

  • Measurable business impact. Improvements in conversion, retention and expansion can be traced to the work you led.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a focus on growth.

  • A proven track record in a product-led growth or self-serve organization, owning KPIs such as trial-to-paid conversion, retention and expansion.

  • Hands-on experience designing A/B tests and iterating based on what you learn.

  • Strong analytical skills: you can define KPIs, analyze funnels, and turn data into a clear recommendation.

  • Experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar.

  • Clear written communication, from product requirements to stakeholder updates.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and designers, and leading cross-functional work through influence.

  • Fluency with AI tools and LLMs, including using them to prototype and demo ideas quickly, and a habit of using them in day-to-day product work: research, analysis, specs and delivery.


Our values

Time Doctor is fully remote and async-first. Three values shape how we work, and they matter even more in a role that sits across so many teams.

  • Remote Rockstar. You thrive in a remote setting. You communicate clearly in writing, keep your work visible, and stay focused and productive without an office around you, so the team stays aligned across time zones.

  • Self-guided Missile. In a remote team, work only keeps moving when people can drive it themselves. You set direction, make decisions with the information you have, and push initiatives forward without waiting to be told.

  • Teamwork Titan. Growth depends on product, engineering, design, data and revenue teams pulling together. You build strong partnerships, share context and credit, and bring people along to deliver results as one team.


Why this role

  • You own the product levers behind our self-serve motion, with a direct line from your work to revenue.

  • You shape the growth strategy with the Director of Growth and the Chief Revenue Officer, not just execute it.

  • You work AI-first, on a team where prototyping, analysis and specs with LLMs are already part of how product work gets done.

  • We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate.

  • Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries.


Our hiring approach

Because experimentation and AI are core to this role, our process asks you to show us real work rather than describe it. Expect to walk us through a growth experiment you designed, what you learned and the decision it led to, and how you have used AI tools to prototype, analyze or ship product work faster.

This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.

We hire globally. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through the details during your first conversation.

jobs.excerpt: ​​ Job Description – Software Engineering Manager Reports To - Director of EngineeringSummaryAxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Software Engineering Manager to build and lead high-performing engineering teams and to help us reimagine how software teams work in the age of AI.
jobs.description:
​

​

Job Description – Software Engineering Manager

Reports To - Director of Engineering

Summary

AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Software Engineering Manager to build and lead high-performing engineering teams and to help us reimagine how software teams work in the age of AI.

You've been a software engineer, so you know what it takes to build software. But your true calling is creating the environment where engineers thrive, succeed, and grow.

That job is changing fast. We're no longer coding everything by hand. We're building the systems that let us bring great ideas to life and solve real customer problems quicker than ever before. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.)

There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and you'll be building and leading the teams that do it.

We're looking for a manager who's already internalized this shift. Someone who pushes their team to use AI tools aggressively, but who also has the judgment to know when the AI is producing confident-sounding garbage, and who's building that same judgment in their engineers. Someone who helps their team develop taste and discipline, not just speed.

What You'll Do

Own the day-to-day health of your teams. Help engineers develop great daily habits, strong communication, and reach the next level, including helping them grow from engineers who only write code into engineers who direct AI effectively.

Partner with product and design counterparts to quickly get from "important customer problem" to "working software," favoring rapid iteration over upfront resolution of every ambiguity. Partner with staff engineers on technical direction, code design, and systems thinking.

Set a high standard of excellence and lead by example, including in how you and your team adopt AI tools and rethink your workflows. If you're asking your engineers to embrace this shift, you'd better be living it yourself. Stay hands-on by running spikes, prototyping, and exploring ideas your team hasn't had time to chase, without taking on critical-path work.

Coach engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build: when to trust the output, when to throw it out, and how to maintain code quality when the machine is doing the typing. Teach them to fish rather than doing it for them.

Challenge your team's assumptions about how software gets made. Question old habits inherited from the era of scarce coding time (exhaustive PRDs, excessive backlog refinement, premature mockup fidelity, story-point ceremony) and encourage cheaper, faster paths to working software.

Create an environment where engineers think about the whole problem, not just the code: understanding customer needs, system dynamics, and what it takes to run software reliably in production. AI makes it dangerously easy to build the wrong thing quickly, so clear thinking about what to build matters more than ever.

What We're Looking For

An AI power user with substance and good judgment. You drive agents, have opinions about where today's models break down drawn from real experience, and you're actively rethinking what engineering management looks like when writing code is no longer the bottleneck. You help your team move fast with these tools without becoming dependent on them for the thinking. You know the difference between leveraging AI and outsourcing your brain to it.

A systems thinker. You look beyond the element at hand to the broader dynamics at play.

A strong writer and compelling storyteller. Remote work demands clear writing, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI. But clarity alone doesn't motivate people. You know how to tell the story of why the work matters, where the team is headed, and what winning looks like.

A humble, always-a-student approach to management itself. You treat management as a craft you're actively learning, and you treat the changing nature of product development with the same curiosity.

Technical enough to lead engineers credibly. You don't need to be the best engineer on the team, but you need to earn their respect, ask sharp questions in code reviews and design discussions, and provide real guidance.

Experience required:

  • Track record managing software engineers on teams building full stack web applications
  • Demonstrated, substantive use of AI development tools in your own work, not just encouraging your team to use them
  • Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones
  • Qualified to work in the United States

What We'd Be Excited to Find

  • Familiarity building and maintaining HIPAA-compliant software
  • A track record of leading teams through significant shifts in tooling or process. You've helped people navigate real ambiguity and come out stronger.
  • Concrete examples of how you've changed your team's workflows around AI. Not just "we adopted Copilot." What did you actually do differently, and what happened?

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.

Compensation and Equipment

  • Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level)
  • Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment

How to Apply

Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter.

We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line.

Prompt: How has AI changed the way you think about engineering management? Not just the tools your team uses, but how you lead, what you prioritize, and what you've stopped doing. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find.

Written: No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop.

Video: 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate.

We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it's what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We're eager to support you so that you and your team can ship work you're proud of.

Candidates only. No recruiters, please.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user-friendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

The Executive Director drives operational excellence through strong standards, processes, talent development, and resource management, ensuring that scientific and regulatory documentation is accurate, compliant, and strategically aligned to support regulatory interactions and informed decision-making across the product lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

Medical Writing Leadership and Development

Document Strategy and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Clinical study protocols and amendments
  • Investigator's brochures
  • Clinical study reports
  • Regulatory briefing documents
  • IND, NDA, MAA submission components
  • Clinical summaries and overviews
  • Responses to health authority queries,
  • Ensure consistency of scientific messaging across programs and submissions.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance, Pharmacovigilance, and other key stakeholders.
  • Align teams on document strategy, timelines, data interpretation, and key messages.
  • Influence decision-making and resolve complex issues through effective collaboration and stakeholder engagement.

Quality, Compliance, and Innovation

  • Establish and maintain standards, processes, templates, and tools supporting efficient document development.
  • Ensure deliverables comply with regulatory requirements, industry standards, company policies, and SOPs.
  • Maintain inspection readiness and support adherence to GCP and applicable regulatory guidance.
  • Monitor evolving regulatory expectations and industry best practices and incorporate them into departmental operations.
  • Drive initiatives that improve the effectiveness, quality, and scalability of medical writing processes.
  • Lead implementation of new technologies, systems, and innovative approaches that enhance medical writing capabilities.
  • Champion the adoption of structured content, automation, AI-enabled solutions, and industry best practices where appropriate.

Resource Management

  • Develop resource forecasts to support portfolio needs and organizational growth.
  • Ensure appropriate allocation of internal and external resources across programs and priorities

Qualifications:

  • Advanced scientific degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent).
  • 15+ years of experience in medical writing within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry, including leadership experience. 8+ years of progressive leadership experience managing medical writing teams and complex development programs.
  • Demonstrated success leading the preparation and delivery of major regulatory submissions, including INDs, NDAs, MAAs, and responses to health authority inquiries.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
