Celcuity is a commercial biotechnology company pursuing development of targeted therapies for treatment of multiple solid tumor indications. The company's first FDA-approved product is REVTORPYK (gedatolisib), a potent, pan-PI3K and mTORC1/2 inhibitor that comprehensively blockades the PAM pathway. REVTORPYK is approved to treat adults with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer that progressed on prior endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting.

jobs.description:
Fuse is an AI-first energy company on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior or Lead Security Engineer (Detection & Response) to build out the next generation of detection systems.

You'll sit within the team responsible for security across our IT and cloud environment, spanning AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS and data center infrastructure. You'll own security monitoring and detection end-to-end: anticipating how our systems could be compromised, ensuring we have the right telemetry to see it, and building the detections and response workflows to act on it.

Think of it like SRE for security. We want someone who can answer questions like: Has this account been compromised? Is someone accessing AWS who shouldn't be? Has an attacker moved laterally through our network? How would we know?

You'll also lead investigations and incident response, automate repetitive security work, and work with IT and Engineering to fix the underlying problems you uncover.

Responsibilities

  • Own security monitoring and detection across AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS, networks and data center environments
  • Build and maintain the telemetry and logging pipelines needed to detect security incidents, and continuously test and improve detection coverage
  • Lead security investigations and incident response from detection through containment, recovery and post-mortem
  • Proactively hunt for threats and identify gaps in our visibility, controls and detection coverage
  • Build automation to improve detection, investigation and response, making effective use of AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency and capabilities.
  • Work closely with IT and Engineering to turn security findings into preventative controls and better system design
  • Develop and test incident response playbooks and continuously improve our response capability
  • Implement and enhance internal AI agents and security bots that assist with monitoring, investigations, reporting, and other security operation tasks.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience in detection engineering, security engineering, incident response, threat hunting or a similar technical role
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, ideally AWS, and how to monitor them for unauthorised or suspicious activity
  • Strong networking fundamentals and an understanding of how attackers move through networks and systems
  • Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft and the ability to turn it into useful, high-signal detections
  • Experience investigating real security incidents and taking ownership through to resolution
  • Strong scripting or programming skills, ideally Python, and a habit of automating repetitive work
  • Experience with security monitoring and response tooling such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR or equivalent
  • Strong systems thinking and a natural instinct for asking “how would we know if this was compromised?”
  • Comfortable working autonomously and closely with IT and Engineering teams
  • Curious about emerging AI capabilities and proactive in experimenting with AI-assisted development, automation and security workflows.

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • AWS security telemetry including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs and IAM
  • Detection-as-code, Sigma, Git-based detections and automated testing
  • CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender or another EDR
  • Network security monitoring, PCAP, NetFlow/sFlow or firewall telemetry
  • Digital forensics, threat intelligence, purple teaming or security validation
  • Data centre or colocation security, including OOB networks and BMC/IPMI
  • Security automation, AI-assisted development or applying AI/LLMs to security engineering and operations.
  • Energy, trading, fintech, critical infrastructure or other high-value-target environments

Benefits

  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs

AI Automation & Marketing - E-Commerce Specialist

Location: Remote – Latin America
Schedule: Full-Time 08:00 am - 05:00pm PST
Industry: E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & AI Automation

About the Role
We are looking for a results-driven E-Commerce Marketing & AI Automation Specialist to help optimize our online sales channels by combining digital marketing knowledge, data analysis, and artificial intelligence.

This role goes beyond traditional marketplace management. We are looking for someone who can leverage AI tools, develop automated workflows, and build systems that continuously monitor marketplace performance, identify issues, analyze competitors, and generate actionable insights.
The ideal candidate combines a technical mindset with an understanding of e-commerce and marketing. Rather than manually reviewing every listing or marketplace, you will develop smarter ways to collect, analyze, and interpret data, helping the company make faster, more informed decisions and improve overall performance.

You will work with platforms such as Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, eBay, Newegg, and other relevant sales channels.

Key Responsibilities:

  • AI Automation & Workflow Development: Build and optimize AI-powered workflows using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms to automate repetitive tasks, monitor marketplace performance, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Marketplace Monitoring: Develop systems to identify listing issues, missing information, suppressed listings, performance gaps, and other opportunities across multiple e-commerce platforms.
  • Data Collection & Analysis: Automate the collection and analysis of marketplace data, competitor activity, product performance, keywords, and sales-related metrics.
  • SEO & Listing Optimization: Apply e-commerce SEO principles to improve product titles, descriptions, bullet points, keyword targeting, and organic visibility.
  • Competitor Intelligence: Create automated processes to track competitors, evaluate their positioning, identify market opportunities, and generate actionable reports.
  • Performance Reporting: Build automated dashboards, reports, and monitoring systems that provide regular insights into marketplace performance and areas requiring attention.
  • Technical Problem-Solving: Use scripting, APIs, AI agents, and other technical solutions where appropriate to connect data sources, streamline processes, and solve operational challenges.
  • Cross-Platform Optimization: Apply scalable strategies across multiple sales channels instead of relying on manual, platform-by-platform management.
  • Continuous Improvement: Research emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, data analysis, and e-commerce operations.

Requirements

  • Experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, marketing analytics, automation, or a related field
  • Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, eBay, or Newegg.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to develop workflows, automate tasks, or analyze data.
  • Basic programming or scripting knowledge, with the ability to build or adapt practical automation solutions.
  • Experience working with APIs, data integrations, spreadsheets, or automated reporting.
  • Understanding of e-commerce SEO, keyword research, product listings, competitor analysis, and organic marketplace performance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and develop scalable solutions.
  • Ability to research unfamiliar platforms, learn independently, and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • A proactive, resourceful mindset focused on improving efficiency and measurable business results.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI agents, workflow automation platforms, and low-code/no-code tools.
  • Experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar scripting languages.
  • Knowledge of Google SEO, analytics platforms, and data visualization tools.
  • Experience creating automated dashboards, scheduled reports, or systems for continuous marketplace monitoring.
  • Experience in B2B e-commerce, manufacturing, or technical product marketing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Automated systems that identify marketplace issues and opportunities faster than manual reviews.
  • Reduced time spent on repetitive research, reporting, and monitoring tasks.
  • Reliable, actionable reports that help the team prioritize and resolve performance issues.
  • Improved organic visibility and product listing quality across multiple sales channels.
  • Scalable AI-powered workflows that increase efficiency and support the company's e-commerce growth.

Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a technically minded marketing professional who understands how to use AI as a practical business tool. The ideal candidate can combine analytical thinking, marketing strategy, and automation skills to build systems that identify problems, deliver insights, and help the team take action.

This is not a traditional marketplace account management role. We need someone who can build smarter systems to monitor, analyze, and improve e-commerce performance, rather than relying primarily on manual marketplace management.

Demand and Supply Planning

Procurement and Purchase Orders

Supplier and Factory Management

  • Manage production timelines from PO to ex-factory and chase delays before they become stock-outs
  • Work with suppliers on quality standards, specs, and pre-shipment checks

Inbound Logistics and Import

Reporting and Financial Visibility

  • Report to Finance on inventory spend including committed POs, deposits and balances due, freight and duty, against budget

Nice to Have

How to Apply

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a hands-on supply chain manager who can own procurement, logistics, and inventory planning end to end for a fast-scaling consumer brand across two markets, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Process Engineer to join our engineering team.

Position Description

Process Engineers at Oklo are responsible for the design, engineering analyses, systems engineering, specifications development, and operations of the fluids and power process systems used in Oklo’s power plants.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Design fluid and process systems including: piping, valves, compressors, pumps, and heat exchangers
  • Define process equipment architecture, specifications, operational modes, and performance criteria
  • Design, assemble, and operate prototypes to use for iterative design refinement
  • Generate documentation guiding the system layout, fabrication, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of process equipment
  • Serve as process system owner through multiple lifecycle stages
  • Generate technical documentation to be included in regulatory filings
  • Work with external vendors on process equipment analysis, procurement, and testing
  • Document work using modern tools and techniques, and compose well-written, thoughtful technical reports

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Engineering education, potentially Mechanical, Chemical, Petroleum, or Aerospace
  • Experience performing design or modification engineering on process equipment, such as that used in the petroleum, nuclear, petrochemical, or pharmaceutical industries
  • Broad familiarity with engineering principles, and having strong systems engineering and operations intuition

Competencies

We are looking for a Process Engineer that is:

  • Experienced in fluids/process system design, power generation, heat transfer equipment, and/or systems engineering
  • Experience with compressible gas system designs including: air and inert gases
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

This position is expected to travel up to 50% to support vendors and integration. Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $80,000-$155,000

Salary may fall outside of the range provided and will be dependent on applicant experience.

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, competitive pay, 401k, health insurance, FSA, flexible work hours, and other benefits.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

ROLE: Business Systems Administrator

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Business Systems Administrators keep the internal systems that run the company secure, reliable, and well-administered. You will own the configuration, access, and health of the business-critical applications our teams depend on every day — making sure they work, stay secure, and scale with the business.

This is a hands-on systems and administration role with real ownership. You will administer core business applications, manage access and permissions with a security-first mindset, and build the automation and process that keep those systems reliable. Working within our Security organization, you will treat access and configuration as security controls, not just IT tasks.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Administer and configure core business systems and SaaS applications, keeping them reliable, secure, and well-governed.
  • Manage user access, roles, and permissions with a security-first approach — enforcing least privilege and clean provisioning and deprovisioning.
  • Automate administration, access reviews, and routine tasks to reduce manual effort and error.
  • Integrate business systems and maintain the data flows between them.
  • Partner with Security, IT, and business teams to support audits, access reviews, and compliance requirements.
  • Document configurations and build repeatable processes that keep systems maintainable as the company grows.

This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a detail-oriented systems administrator who takes ownership of the applications they manage and brings a security-first mindset to access and configuration. You are organized, reliable, and comfortable automating your way out of repetitive work.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you work methodically, verify configurations against policy, and surface issues honestly. You are process-minded and build systems administration that scales.

This is the right role if you want to own the internal systems that keep a category-defining company running securely.

THE TEAM

The Salesloft Security organization protects the platform, the company, and the sensitive data our customers and employees entrust to us. Business Systems Administration sits within this remit because access and configuration are core security controls. The team works closely with IT, Security Engineering, and the business teams who rely on these systems.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The team Moves as One — systems administration, security, and IT share ownership of secure, reliable internal systems and coordinate directly. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: our customers' success is the only scorecard that matters, and well-governed systems and disciplined access management are part of how we keep the company and its data secure.

THE SKILL SET

  • Experience administering business systems or SaaS applications, including access and configuration management.
  • Strong understanding of access management fundamentals — roles, permissions, least privilege, and provisioning lifecycle.
  • Comfort automating administrative tasks and access reviews (scripting or built-in automation tools).
  • A security-first, detail-oriented approach to systems administration.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience administering systems such as Salesforce, identity providers (Okta, Entra), or other core enterprise SaaS.
  • Familiarity with SSO, SCIM, and identity/access governance tooling.
  • Experience supporting audits or compliance access reviews (e.g., SOC 2).

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page ().

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. Hours: Full-Time 37.5 hours per week

A note about recruitment at Vestd

We recognise how challenging the job market can be for candidates, and at Vestd we strive to provide a positive candidate experience. If you are interested in this opportunity, we kindly request that your application and all communication go through official application channels. Apply via our website careers page, other job site or LinkedIn, as opposed to sending the team individual emails or LinkedIn direct messages. We want each candidate to be considered fairly, and for everyone who applies to receives a consistent experience.

Contacting Vestd employees via email, personal social media, or other informal routes is not appropriate. We also have a zero-tolerance approach to any form of harassment or abuse directed at our team. Candidates who do not respect these boundaries may be disqualified from the recruitment process and, in serious cases, barred from applying in future.

About Vestd

Vestd is a leading sharetech platform for equity management - shares schemes, fund raising, company secretarial and much more.

Our regulated platform makes light work of all of the most popular and tax-efficient share scheme types, empowering businesses to attract and retain their talent. Our powerful software also helps investors, and founders seeking investment.

Vestd was founded by Ifty Nasir, who lives and breathes our mission. Vestd’s big moonshot aim is to see one billion people worldwide invested in the companies they work hard to grow by 2030. We are all about inclusion and fairness for our customers and our team.

Vestd is also a B Corp-certified company, which means we’re committed to balancing profit with purpose. We care about our people, our customers, and the wider world – and we hold ourselves to the highest social and environmental standards.

If you’d like to learn more about Vestd, check out this short video from our founder, Ifty.

Requirements

The role

We are looking for individuals who are not only passionate about our mission but also comfortable and confident using cutting-edge technologies and AI tools, to streamline processes, drive innovation, and contribute to the growth of Vestd.

We are hiring an experienced Equity Consultant to grow new business with UK companies employing 51-200 people. You will create and convert opportunities, own consultative sales from discovery to close, and build credibility with CFOs and senior People leaders. We value proactive prospecting, strong judgement and pipeline discipline, without expecting you to generate every meeting yourself.

What success looks like in year one

In your first 90 days, you will learn Vestd's proposition and the employee equity landscape, establish strong consultative discovery and pipeline habits, build effective working relationships and progress early opportunities. Over the year, we will assess Closed Won ARR, qualified-deal conversion, average deal value, pipeline progression and contributions from reactivation, referrals and self-generated opportunities.

What you’ll own

  • Own opportunities from discovery and commercial development through to Closed Won, converting proactively generated business as well as relevant inbound interest.
  • Uncover customer problems, quantify their commercial significance, establish urgency and position Vestd accurately against alternatives.
  • Build trust with Heads of People, CFOs and other senior stakeholders; identify champions, buying processes and appropriate next steps.
  • Develop opportunities through referrals, re-engagement of previously lost prospects, networking and selective self-prospecting.
  • Maintain clear pipeline ownership, prioritise opportunities effectively and use commercial data to improve results and forecast quality.

What we’re looking for

Essential elements of this role

We cannot provide an exhaustive list of duties; additional duties may arise, but these will be core elements of this role:

  • Proven ownership of quota-carrying B2B new business sales, including personally closing opportunities generated or developed through proactive engagement.
  • Strong consultative discovery and commercial judgement, able to develop buyer interest where there is not yet an active purchasing project.
  • Credible engagement with senior Finance and People stakeholders, including identifying champions and navigating multi-stakeholder decisions.
  • Proactive pipeline management and disciplined follow-through, with demonstrable individual contribution and commercial results.
  • An analytical approach to sales decisions, able to explain target attainment, conversion, deal value and the reasons deals are won or lost.
  • Ability to learn complex information, acknowledge knowledge gaps, act with honesty and apply coaching to improve quickly.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • You must be comfortable with working in a remote-first environment

Nice to have

These will help you stand out from the pack:

  • Startup/scaleup experience
  • Knowledge of shares and share schemes
  • Experience working in a remote team

Culture fit

What makes Vestd folk collaborative, adaptable, and eager to grow?

  • Thrives in a startup environment, ready to tackle diverse challenges with enthusiasm
  • Adaptable - open to taking on responsibilities beyond the defined role as needed
  • Passionate about contributing to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Embraces technology to improve processes and drive efficiency

While the above describes the core responsibilities, this role may from time to time involve tasks beyond this list — as needed to respond to evolving business needs.

Benefits

What you can expect

Our culture is our backbone (BreatheHR named us one of the ‘Top 3 Companies in the UK for Company Culture’), and we take team happiness seriously.

Vestd strives to be as principled as possible. We’re all about Goal 8 of the United Nations ‘Sustainable Development Goals. This goal is about ‘Decent work and economic growth,’ and we consider it both with our external activities and internal workings.

We’ll do everything we can to help you grow in your role. In return, you’ll want to learn all about our industry and do all you can to help us continue leading it.

Vestd is remote-first, so in return for your commitment, diligence, and productivity, you’ll have a lot of autonomy during your working day. Some roles demand office hours (to fit our customers’ schedules), but we are committed to offering flexibility where possible.

Happy employees make for happy customers, as demonstrated in our five-star reviews. Vestd’s excellence has also been recognised by The Europas, The Fintech Awards London, The Hustle Awards, TechRound, and BusinessCloud’s Fintech50. See more about our awards here.

This could be the perfect opportunity if you’re an autonomous, self-driven individual passionate about contributing to a meaningful mission and value being part of a supportive, close-knit team.

Why work at Vestd?

Vestd is a great place to work. Don’t just take our word for it - take a look at the award-winning suite of benefits that you can look forward to as one of our folk:

  • This job remote-first, although attendance is required twice yearly at our in-person get-togethers
  • A flexible environment to help you achieve the best work/life balance
  • Equity, of course! (After the qualifying period)
  • Monthly recognition scheme, where we celebrate our folk
  • Support with home working equipment*
  • A personal training and development budget to keep your career and professional growth on track
  • Private medical insurance (after the qualifying period)
  • Team retreats are held twice a year. They can include an overnight stay and focus on fun and team cohesion
  • Great team ethos, connect through regular team and company socials.
  • 25 days annual leave plus one extra day per year of service (up to five days)
  • Employer contribution pension scheme (after the qualifying period)

We’re looking for somebody with initiative who can focus on the business and their personal growth path. This is a great time to join our team, and it would be a superb role for the right person.

*At Vestd we provide our folk with the hardware and software required to support them in their role. As a remote-first business, we expect anyone applying for a job to have a suitable, quiet working space. You must have an appropriate desk/table and chair, with a reliable internet connection.

Equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) at Vestd

At Vestd, we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and diverse team. Trust is one of our core values; with that comes a commitment to fairness and transparency. We want to be open about our EDI efforts.

We wish to recruit people who are passionate about working in a diverse environment and who will support us to ensure that all colleagues are supported and included while working with us.

Research shows that while men are likely to apply when they meet 60% of a job’s requirements, women and individuals from underrepresented groups often apply only when they meet every criterion.

We understand the value of transferable skills and the unique perspectives that diversity brings. That’s why we encourage applications from candidates with unique strengths and experiences.


Our application process

We are accepting rolling applications for this role with no fixed end date - if you are interested in joining the Vestd folk, please apply when you can. We will respond to every applicant, but we may only screen some candidates depending on the number of applications received.

Our recruitment pipeline has a few stages, giving you plenty of opportunities to learn about Vestd as we take the time to find someone who is the best fit for the role. We aim to complete the selection process as efficiently as possible, and we are committed to making our candidate experience as inclusive as we can, so please get in touch with us if you require any information or support during the application process or need to ask for any adjustments.

A typical selection process might be:

  • Apply online
  • 20-minute screening call
  • 45-minute interview with the hiring manager and team member
  • Task-based assignment
  • 45-minute team cultural interview
  • 30-minute interview with the CEO

Please note that we record our interviews. These recordings are only viewed by the hiring team and no later than once a role is filled, all recordings are deleted. We do not share any candidate information with anyone outside of Vestd at any time.

If you need any adjustments or support with your application, please let us know.

We are excited to receive your application.

When a role is filled, we will contact all other applicants to let them know.

This job is remote-first within the UK. You must be primarily UK-based and eligible to work in the country.

About Advanced Energy United

Advanced Energy United is a national industry association representing businesses that provide the full range of advanced energy and transportation solutions. Our team works to educate, advocate, and activate in decisionmaker venues across the country.

We advocate for public policies that enable competition and work alongside our member companies to create economic opportunity, lower consumer costs, and bolster energy reliability and resilience across the country. We work with decision makers at every level of government as well as regulators of energy markets to build progress toward an economy built on advanced energy.

If you’re an entrepreneurial, innovative, analytical and thoughtful person looking to make an impact in the clean energy space, United might be the perfect place for you to share your talents. Team members at United are given the trust and responsibility to make big things happen, and myriad opportunities to learn new skills, explore new issue areas, and work with a broad cross section of the clean energy community. Being a team member at United also means working with a talented and diverse group of people, some who bring decades of experience spanning advocacy, philanthropy, clean tech, government and more—and our collaborative approach means we get to learn from each other, expert and novice, every day. And while our organization is fully remote, we are proud of the people-focused culture we have built and the connectedness of our team.

We work on serious issues, take our mission seriously, but never take ourselves too seriously.

Position Description

Advanced Energy United is currently seeking a well-rounded early-career candidate with interest and/or experience in policy and political advocacy for a position focused on gas transition, building electrification, and electric affordability issues. This Principal will work collaboratively to support existing state and regional teams to accelerate electrification of the building stock in legislative, administrative, regulatory, and political venues in states across the country. In the near term, this work will focus on long-term gas infrastructure planning and non-pipeline alternatives, clean heat and electrification programs, electric rate design, and electric ratemaking.

Reporting to our Managing Director of Programs and Strategy, this Principal will join a team of subject matter experts to provide insight, strategy, and experience to our on-the-ground policy teams that are engaged on state legislation, in public utility commission dockets, and with governors. The transition to clean buildings will require use of all of the tools in the toolbox, including reforming utility business models, closing the “spark gap,” and reimagining utility resource and infrastructure planning. The work includes educating decisionmakers on financial and economic risks of the status quo, storytelling around the vision of clean, affordable, and resilient homes for all, coalition building, and developing advocacy strategies on some of the most complex issues in utility regulation of our day.

The ideal candidate will have 3-6 years of relevant experience in state energy legislation or regulation and some exposure to, or experience with, utility planning and ratemaking issues. They will have a good understanding of the utility business model and public utility commission proceedings. They should be a creative, flexible, and opportunistic self-starter with strong organization and prioritization skills, be able to support day-to-day execution of strategic plans, and have an appetite to get into the weeds while still seeing the bigger picture. Excellent writing and communications skills are a must. Candidates must be able to travel to meet with members, stakeholders, and decisionmakers.

  • Develop and maintain excellent working relationships with Advanced Energy United staff, member companies, allies, as well as key legislative, regulatory, and administrative staff.
  • Work with Advanced Energy United's communications team to identify opportunities to seek earned media coverage, including op-eds, editorial board meetings, etc., in key media outlets.
  • Coordinate efforts with coalition allies in support of aligned goals; represent United and its members on coalition calls.
  • Help support and organize education sessions, coalition meetings, decisionmaker meetings and stakeholder outreach.
  • Travel on an as needed basis (up to 25%) to targeted states for staff trainings, advocacy days, meetings with key allies and stakeholders, communications outreach, and industry events. This includes representing United on panels, in meetings, and with media.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience;
  • 4 to 6 years of professional experience, with at least two focused in clean energy and utility policy;
  • A baseline understanding of utility regulation and state energy decision-making environments;
  • An ability to think strategically and politically, even in technical venues;
  • Experience participating in coalitions and engaging with state legislative or regulatory processes;
  • Entrepreneurial approach, flexible attitude, and ability to operate in a remote environment;
  • Ability to handle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment;
  • Excellent communications skills, both written and verbal, including an ability to digest highly technical information and translate it for audiences of different backgrounds;

We are hiring a Senior Project Manager to own delivery execution across our client’s Canadian engagements. You will sit between their customers and their Brazil based engineering team, and you will make sure every engagement reaches production on time, within scope, and within budget. In a fixed fee model, scope discipline is the job.
This is a high ownership role in a small company.

Requirements

  • Manage multiple projects from kickoff to handoff with minimal supervision

  • Build project plans covering scope, milestones, resources, and budget, aligned to SOW deliverables

  • Protect fixed fee scope: identify changes early, negotiate discrepancies with customers, and drive prioritization decisions

  • Coordinate delivery across time zones between customers and their engineering team in Brazil and Canada

  • Own project governance, including status reporting, sprint reviews, and risk and issue management. Know the difference between a risk and an issue, and when to escalate

  • Facilitate backlog creation with clear definitions, acceptance criteria, and estimates, and manage work in Jira

  • Track milestones and documentation for AWS funded engagements

  • Build customer trust through reliable delivery and consistent communication, including the difficult conversations

  • Deliver against the customer’s business outcome, not just the letter of the SOW, and bring follow on opportunities to the commercial team

  • Help build the client’s delivery practice: templates, processes, and how they use AI in project management

What You Bring

  • +5 years of professional experience working with North American customers, including at least 3 in a client facing Project Manager role

  • +2 years in a consulting or professional services environment

  • Experience delivering cloud, data, or AI projects. AWS experience strongly preferred

  • Experience managing distributed teams across time zones

  • Forecasting and budget management on fixed fee or milestone based projects

  • Comfort working across multiple project management methodologies

  • Strong organization across several concurrent projects

  • Clear communication with both business and technical stakeholders

  • Legal authorization to work in Canada. The client cannot sponsor visas or work permits at this time

  • Fluent in English


Nice to Have

  • Portuguese

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent

  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, or willingness to obtain it within 90 days

  • Familiarity with generative AI, Amazon Bedrock, data engineering, or application modernization

  • Experience with AWS partner programs and funded engagements such as MAP

  • Experience in an early stage company

Hiring Details

Base salary range: $120k to $160k CAD per year, based on experience

100% Remote

Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.

Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.

We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.

This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and asynchronous integrations.

Preferred Skills

  • Production support experience.

jobs.title: Territory Manager
jobs.excerpt: Your opportunity By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world.
jobs.description:
Your opportunity By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications. Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – a revolutionary solution designed by our world-class technical team. The Globe System offers strong, unique, and customer-valued advantages over other treatments on the market, and leading physicians are already using it and helping to share our story. We have obtained FDA approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients! The Territory Manager will be responsible for driving sales and market penetration of our Globe Pulsed Field System within a specific geography. You will lead the commercial launch of the Globe PF System within your territory and collaborate with and provide strategic direction to a team of field clinical specialists delivering in-procedure product support. This role requires a strategic and results-driven professional with a strong background in medical device sales and a passion for advancing healthcare through innovative technology. We will consider candidates for remote work located in the USA. Meaningful work you will be a part of

Your responsibilities will be to:

  • Develop and execute territory sales plans to achieve and exceed sales targets for the Globe PF System.
  • Identify and engage with key opinion leaders, physicians, and healthcare facilities within the territory.
  • Conduct product demonstrations, training sessions, and presentations to educate customers on the benefits and applications of the pulsed field catheter system.
  • Provide product and technical assistance to electrophysiologists and clinical staff using the Globe PF System during cardiac ablation procedures
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product development, and regulatory, to ensure successful product launch and market adoption.
  • Monitor and analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform sales strategies.
  • Provide regular sales reports and updates to senior management.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company policies in all sales activities.

What you bring to the team Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about developing cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work in a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. We understand that only by working together can we solve what was thought unsolvable. You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in medical device sales.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrophysiology. A minimum of 3 years supporting cardiac ablation cases in an electrophysiology lab is strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong knowledge of electrophysiology and pulsed field catheter systems.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage a territory effectively.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to travel within the territory as needed.

Compensation Kardium offers a competitive total cash compensation (base salary + 5% 401k contribution + variable compensation based on the achievement of organizational goals and objectives). Pay offered will be determined based on numerous relevant business and candidate factors including, for example, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, and business or organizational needs.

  • As a permanent employee, you will also participate in Kardium’s stock option plan.

Your Benefits & Well-being Total cash – the total cash we’ve listed for this position includes a base salary, plus a contribution to a Retirement Savings plan to help support your financial goals. Comprehensive medical & dental coverage – for all permanent employees – effective as of Day 1, with no waiting period. Work-day flexibility – additionally, we provide 3 personal days per year. Support – for you (and your dependents) overall well-being. Career progression and learning support. Professional membership support. Life at Kardium What makes us a great place to work?

  • Our Purpose
  • Our People
  • Our Culture

At Kardium, we embrace diversity of background, experience, and perspective and we’re committed to inclusion and equity at every level. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of all communities. We collaborate with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), as volunteer-led groups who share a common dimension of diversity and come together to provide support, education, and other opportunities across Kardium. Examples of our ERGs include Women ERG, Pride ERG, Race Ethnicity & Cultural Heritage (REACH) ERG, Truth & Reconciliation ERG, Persian Community ERG, Chinese ERG, Barangay Kardium (Filipino) ERG, Brazilian ERG and Irish ERG. As part of your application, we encourage you to note if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations). There will be an optional section in the application form where you can provide this information to the recruitment team.

Bridgeway is seeking an Associate Platform Engineer who will support the design, development, and maintenance of the infrastructure that supports our software development and deployment. The Associate Platform Engineer will assist in building and maintaining robust, scalable, and efficient platforms that enable other Bridgeway teams to develop, test, and deploy applications seamlessly. This role combines aspects of software engineering, systems architecture, and operations, contributing to efforts that ensure the underlying infrastructure meets the needs of Bridgeway's applications and services.

This is a remote position with preference given to East Coast candidates.   

Responsibilities: 

  • Assist in the maintenance and monitoring of existing cloud infrastructure, helping keep it scalable, resilient, and efficient, with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code (IaC) to provision and manage cloud resources.
  • Support the maintenance and enhancement of CI/CD pipelines, and help automate repetitive tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce the potential for human error.
  • Assist in implementing and maintaining monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions, including system and application log retention and pipeline health.
  • Help perform regular system maintenance, updates, and patches, executing against Security-owned patch schedules and standards.
  • Respond to basic issues and support tickets under guidance from more experienced peers, including Tier 2 escalations and auto-escalated alerts from the Tier 1 support team.
  • Contribute to the product and hosting triage runbooks used by the Tier 1 support team.
  • Assist in root cause analysis and contribute to root-cause-analysis content for infrastructure incidents.
  • Support disaster recovery testing and help verify that backup software and configuration are enabled and healthy across systems.
  • Help identify opportunities to optimize system performance, resource utilization, and cloud/infrastructure costs.
  • Support the implementation of security measures, such as firewalls, access controls, and encryption, in line with security best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to understand their needs and provide platform support.
  • Document procedures and workflows, and maintain records of configurations and changes, following Secure SDLC and SCRUM/Agile methodologies.
  • Participate in code reviews, mentorship, training, and paired programming sessions, and share learnings with peers.
  • Contribute to smaller projects with support from experienced peers.
  • Participate in the Tier 2 on-call rotation, providing timely response to infrastructure incidents outside regular business hours as needed.
  • Leverage generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, improve solution quality, and accelerate delivery of business outcomes.

Requirements:

  • 1+ years of professional engineering or IT operations experience with exposure to cloud infrastructure
  • Basic understanding of cloud platforms
  • Familiarity with scripting languages
  • Basic knowledge of version control systems
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and CI/CD pipeline tools
  • Basic understanding of containerization and orchestration concepts (e.g., ECS, ACA, K8s, Docker)

  • Proficient communication and collaboration skills
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Project Management teams to structure contracts, resolve commercial issues, and mitigate risk.
  • Monitor contract performance, including scope, cost, schedule, and compliance, and independently assess contractual and commercial risks, ensuring timely escalation and resolution in alignment with project governance and business objectives.
  • Develop and implement contract management best practices, standard work, and continuous improvement initiatives in alignment with the Danaher Business System (DBS).

Company:Protos Security
Job Title: Benefits Manager

Company Overview

Protos Security, a subsidiary of Security Services Holdings, is the largest technology enabled Security Officer Management company in the U.S. Headquartered in Norwalk, CT, Protos also has offices in New York, Texas, Virginia, Illinois, California, Tennessee, and Georgia, as well as international locations in Canada and the UK.

We are a game changer in the security and software industry, revolutionizing how security is managed and delivered to make the world a safer place.

Position Summary

The Benefits Manager is responsible for the administration, compliance, and continuous improvement of the Company's employee benefits programs. This role serves as the subject matter expert for benefit plan administration within ADP Workforce Now, ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, accurate payroll deductions, and exceptional employee support.

The Benefits Manager partners closely with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, external brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators to oversee all aspects of benefits administration, leave management, reporting, annual renewals, mergers and acquisitions, and system optimization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Benefits Administration

  • Serve as the primary administrator for the ADP Workforce Now Benefits module, maintaining benefit plan configurations, eligibility rules, workflows, system testing, and ongoing enhancements.
  • Configure, maintain, and administer all employee benefit programs including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, voluntary benefits, FSA/HSA, and retirement plans.
  • Process employee benefit elections, qualifying life events, new hires, transfers, and terminations in accordance with plan documents and eligibility requirements.
  • Monitor, audit, and reconcile benefit deductions with Payroll to ensure accurate premium withholding and timely issue resolution.
  • Audit monthly carrier invoices and reconcile enrollment, deductions, and premium billing to ensure financial accuracy.
  • Coordinate benefit eligibility audits and maintain the integrity of employee benefit data within ADP Workforce Now.
  • Manage relationships with benefit carriers, brokers, third-party administrators, COBRA administrators, and other vendors to ensure high service levels, accurate data exchanges, timely issue resolution, and compliance with service agreements.
  • Lead annual Open Enrollment activities, including system configuration, testing, employee communications, reporting, and post-enrollment audits.
  • Partner with brokers and leadership during annual benefit renewals by supporting plan design evaluations, benchmarking, cost analysis, and implementation of approved changes.
  • Support benefits-related activities associated with mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, benefit comparisons, employee communications, vendor coordination, system integration, compliance reviews, and onboarding of newly acquired employee populations.

Leave Administration

  • Administer and oversee employee leaves of absence, including FMLA, ADA accommodations, short-term disability, long-term disability, workers' compensation coordination, and applicable state leave programs.
  • Coordinate leave administration with employees, managers, Payroll, Human Resources, and third-party administrators to ensure timely communication, benefit continuation, payroll deductions, and regulatory compliance.
  • Monitor leave eligibility, documentation requirements, return-to-work processes, and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and local leave regulations.

Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure compliance with ACA, ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, Section 125, FMLA, and all applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Generate, analyze, and maintain ACA measurement, look-back calculations, affordability reporting, and 1095-C reporting within ADP Workforce Now.
  • Prepare and submit EEO-1 reporting and other required federal, state, and local compliance filings.
  • Coordinate PCORI fee filings and ensure timely submission and payment.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing required documentation and responding to audit requests.
  • Develop recurring dashboards, reports, and executive metrics related to enrollment, participation, leave activity, compliance, utilization, and benefit costs.

Employee Support

  • Serve as the point of contact for employee benefit inquiries, resolving complex issues and escalating concerns when appropriate.
  • Educate employees on benefit programs, enrollment processes, qualifying life events, leave administration, and system navigation.
  • Develop employee communications, benefit guides, FAQs, and educational resources to improve understanding and engagement with company benefit programs.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Five (5) to seven (7) years of progressive experience administering employee benefit programs, preferably in a multi-state environment.
  • CEBS (Certified Employee Benefit Specialist) or CBP (Certified Benefits Professional) Certifications preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as the primary administrator of ADP Workforce Now Benefits or a comparable HRIS platform; ADP Workforce Now strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience supporting benefit integration activities during mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, data validation, employee onboarding, and system implementation.
  • Strong working knowledge of ACA, COBRA, ERISA, HIPAA, FMLA, Section 125, ADA, and applicable federal and state leave regulations.
  • Experience administering disability and leave of absence programs in partnership with third-party administrators.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with experience analyzing large datasets, reconciling benefit information, and producing executive-level reports.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills with the ability to explain complex benefit concepts to employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, carrier billing reconciliations, and benefit compliance reporting.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At Protos Security, we are a community of driven professionals working together to make the world safer through technology and service. Here is what you can expect:

  • Growth Opportunities– Mentorship, cross functional projects, and career development

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

jobs.excerpt: The Product Owner, Universal Gateway, owns the backlog for the single ingress and egress layer that carries DICOM studies and HL7 messages into and out of Intelerad's cloud platform, serving IntelePACS, InteleArchive, InteleShare VNA, InteleViewer, and InteleOrchestrator.
jobs.description:
The Product Owner, Universal Gateway, owns the backlog for the single ingress and egress layer that carries DICOM studies and HL7 messages into and out of Intelerad's cloud platform, serving IntelePACS, InteleArchive, InteleShare VNA, InteleViewer, and InteleOrchestrator. Universal Gateway replaces today's product-specific gateways, relays, and edge servers with one standardized service for DIMSE and DICOMweb traffic, HL7 routing and normalization, authentication, and multi-tenant isolation. This is a hands-on, technically deep role: the Product Owner works day-to-day with platform engineering, SRE, and Hosting teams, and ensures that what gets built is reliable enough for clinical imaging workflows where downtime directly affects patient care.

Acting as the primary connection point between the Product Manager's vision and the development team's execution, the Product Owner combines deep knowledge of DICOM, HL7, and healthcare integration with hands-on agile delivery experience on platform or infrastructure products. Success in this role depends on sound day-to-day judgment: making trade-off decisions that keep delivery aligned to the broader product strategy set by Product Management and business leaders. This is not a generalist Product Owner role. Candidates should bring direct, hands-on experience with medical imaging interoperability, integration engines, or healthcare connectivity infrastructure. In your application, please describe a specific DICOM, HL7, or healthcare integration problem you owned and how you resolved it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog for Universal Gateway, writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria for DICOM DIMSE (C-STORE, C-FIND, C-MOVE, Storage Commitment, MWL), DICOMweb (STOW-RS, QIDO-RS, WADO-RS), HL7 v2 inbound and outbound messaging, and pathology whole slide imaging (WSI) ingestion.
  • Partner daily with engineering and design throughout the development lifecycle — refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives — making timely trade-off decisions on scope, sequencing, and priority, and escalating strategic or financial trade-offs to the Product Manager or Director as needed.
  • Define and validate non-functional requirements, including failover SLA, RTO/RPO, multi-AZ high availability, and throughput and latency targets by modality (CR through large CT, mammography, and WSI), and confirm delivered features meet them along with DICOM PS3.4 conformance and the published DICOM Conformance Statement.
  • Gather and synthesize input from Sales, Customer Success, Support, and customers to inform backlog refinement, and support the Product Manager with market research, competitive analysis, and feature-level requirements.
  • Track and report on sprint and release progress, velocity, and delivery metrics, proactively flagging risks to scope or timeline, and incorporate feedback from user acceptance testing and beta programs into subsequent backlog iterations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, technology, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, or integration or interface engineer, including at least 2 years on platform, infrastructure, or integration products rather than end-user feature applications.
  • Working knowledge of agile/scrum methodologies and hands-on experience with backlog and sprint management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Hands-on working knowledge of DICOM (DIMSE services, DICOMweb, AE title configuration, conformance statements) and HL7 v2 (ADT, ORM, ORU), demonstrated by writing requirements for, configuring, or troubleshooting DICOM or HL7 interfaces in production.
  • Experience partnering directly with engineering teams, with comfort leading technical discussions on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs, including high availability, failover, and multi-region design for Linux-based, containerized services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in requirements definition and quality validation.
  • Working understanding of cloud infrastructure and operations, including AWS or equivalent, containers, infrastructure as-code (such as Terraform and Ansible), networking (load balancers, VPN, TLS and mTLS), and observability tooling.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with medical imaging systems (PACS, VNA, RIS) or integration engines and routers (such as Mirth/NextGen Connect, Rhapsody, Cloverleaf, or DICOM routing products).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than authority.
  • Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of collaboration across engineering, design, and cross-functional business teams.
  • Experience defining SLAs, RTO/RPO, or reliability targets for clinical or other mission-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures, tenant isolation, and healthcare security and privacy obligations (HIPAA, GDPR, or equivalent).
  • Exposure to digital pathology (whole slide imaging) or high-volume modality workflows such as mammography and large CT. This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

The base pay for this position ranges from $71,250 - $95,000/yr CAD within any geographic market in Canada. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.

You'll bring oncology knowledge and a track record in sales to conversations with oncologists, pathology teams and senior decision-makers, helping institutions understand how SOPHiA's genomic solutions fit their testing needs and support treatment decisions.

The value you add

  • Develop new business across Washington, Oregon and Northern California, building a pipeline in a territory that has had limited commercial coverage.
  • Build relationships with oncologists, pathology teams and C-suite stakeholders to understand their clinical and institutional priorities.
  • Explain the value of SOPHiA's genomic solutions in the context of a partner's testing workflows, existing capabilities and needs.
  • Work with subject-matter experts to address technical questions about sequencing, bioinformatics and how testing leads to a report.
  • Convert opportunities into bookings and grow the territory's commercial presence.

Requirements

We know that every background is different, but to be best set for success we see you bringing:

  • A demonstrated sales track record in oncology or molecular diagnostics, with a foundation in oncology biology and the clinical purpose of genomic testing.
  • An understanding of DNA and RNA, relevant biomarkers such as EGFR and KRAS, and why oncologists use testing to inform treatment decisions.
  • The ability to have credible conversations with oncologists and senior institutional decision-makers, as well as laboratory and pathology stakeholders.
  • The ability to connect a genomic solution's capabilities to the needs of the institution buying it.

You don't need to be a sequencing or bioinformatics expert. Experience selling oncology tests from a send-out testing perspective can be relevant, provided you understand the clinical context and can discuss the results with physicians. You can build your knowledge of laboratory workflows and bioinformatics with support from our subject-matter experts. General equipment, consumables or software sales experience alone isn't sufficient for this role.

Benefits

You will be joining an organization with the patient at the heart of every decision and action, driven by purpose as we pursue exponential growth.

For more information about our Benefits, Virtues, The Recruitment Process, our AI guide and stories from our team about what it's like to work at SOPHiA, view the full posting on our careers page.
