jobs.description:
About AirDNA

AirDNA began with a big dream in a balmy California garage in 2015. Since then, the technology startup has grown into the leading provider of data and business intelligence for the billion-dollar travel and vacation rental industry—with offices in Denver and Barcelona.

Our self-serve MarketMinder platform eliminates guesswork and equips Airbnb hosts with smart and competitive insights needed to succeed in the ever-evolving short-term rental landscape.

We also arm enterprise clients with customized reports and in-depth dashboards to ensure they can scale and invest strategically. These customers include hundreds of top financial institutions, real estate companies, vacation rental managers, and destination marketing organizations around the world.

We track the daily performance of over 10 million Airbnb and Vrbo properties across 120,000 global markets. We also collect data from over a million partner properties. This marriage of scraped and source data, enhanced by our proprietary algorithms, makes our solutions the most accurate and comprehensive in the world.

We’re firm believers that data isn’t the destination; it’s the starting point. The launchpad. The bedrock for any future-forward business.

The AirDNA Team

At AirDNA, we’re a team of data nerds on a mission to empower our customers to smartly grow their businesses. And we're looking for people with a broad range of experiences and perspectives, who are excited by our mission, values, and drive to change the short-term rental market. In short: Life is never boring here. And we genuinely live and breathe our company values: Happy, Hungry and Honest. People who are ready to exemplify these values are especially encouraged to apply. We invite you to apply even if you are unsure about whether you meet every single requirement in this posting. We carefully consider every application, not just those that check off all the boxes.

The Role:

Adapt is AirDNA's dynamic pricing engine, and hosts trust it with their income. When something looks off, like a rate that makes no sense or a sync that says it worked but didn't, our frontline Support team and AI tools handle most of it. The hardest problems come to you.

As our Product Support Specialist, you'll be the technical bridge between Support and Engineering: the final line of defense who digs into logs, data, and code to find the real root cause before an issue ever reaches Product or Engineering. Then you'll explain it to the host in a few clear sentences and make sure it never happens again.

This isn't a script-reading job, and it isn't a race to clear a queue. We won't measure you on how fast you close tickets. We'll celebrate you for solving problems for good. And because you're joining a brand-new pod, you'll help write the playbook for everyone who comes after you.

This is a full-time, long-term contractor role. It's fully remote and open to candidates based in Latin America or the Caribbean.

Here's what you'll get to do:

  • Own escalations end to end. Take the technical issues frontline Support can't solve and drive them all the way to resolution, escalating to Engineering only when it truly needs an engineer.
  • Play detective. Diagnose pricing and sync issues by reproducing the problem, forming a hypothesis, and isolating the cause (PMS connection, comp set, host override, or market shift).
  • Dig into the back end. Use SQL, logs, analytics reports, and existing code to pull the data and confirm what actually happened.
  • Make the algorithm make sense. Explain why Adapt did what it did in a few plain sentences, a short screen recording, or a quick call that a host can act on.
  • Turn every repeat ticket into an asset. Write help-center articles, in-app guidance, and content for the Adapt AI agent so the next host never has to ask.
  • Be Product's eyes and ears. Share weekly escalation themes, grouped by host type and portfolio size, and follow fixes all the way to shipped.
  • Protect our hosts. Spot at-risk accounts early and loop in Revenue Management before a frustrated host walks away.
  • Build the playbook. Create the SOPs, macros, and escalation paths that set the quality bar for everyone who joins the pod after you.

Here's what you'll need to be successful:

  • 2+ years in technical support, SaaS product support, or another analytical, customer-facing role. Tier 2 support folks ready to level up, we're looking at you!
  • SQL proficiency. You can write queries against a live database to find what you need.
  • Working knowledge of Python. You're comfortable reading existing code and working with datasets. You don't need to be a developer.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs and log analysis.
  • Strong quantitative reasoning. Percentages, averages, and rates are second nature, and you spot a number that can't possibly be right.
  • Structured problem-solving. You break a vague complaint into a testable hypothesis instead of guessing.
  • A gift for translating tech into plain language. You can explain to a non-technical host why their rates look different than they expected, clearly, warmly, and in just a few sentences.
  • Excellent verbal and written English.
  • Composure with frustrated customers, and the honesty to own a mistake without over-promising a fix.
  • Follow-through. You close loops without being chased.
  • Willingness to work hours that overlap with US Eastern and European business time.
  • Bonus points for: familiarity with webhooks; support tools like Intercom or Zendesk; experience with short-term rental pricing or property management tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond, Guesty, Hostaway); a hospitality or revenue management background; or a knack for using AI to automate your own repetitive work. You don't need to know how a pricing engine works on day one. We'll teach you!

Here's what you can expect from us:

  • Competitive salary
  • Eligible for annual bonus
  • Take time off when you need it
  • Continuing education stipend
  • Individual growth plan to progress in the role
  • Talented international team and a vibrant work environment
  • Language lessons with Yolk Academy (GR-SP-IT-FR)
  • Fully remote work from anywhere in Latin America or the Caribbean
  • A ground-floor seat on a brand-new pod, with real ownership from day one

Hiring Process:

  • First stage: Interview with the People Team at AirDNA (Online - 30 min)
  • Second stage: Technical take-home assessment (SQL exercises against a live database + Python exercises using a sample dataset, completed on your own time)
  • Final stage: Technical panel interview with the Hiring Manager and team (Online - 60 min)

The AirDNA Team

We're a tight-knit group who care about empowering the next generation of shared economy entrepreneurs. Life is never boring here. We're risk takers. We care about each other and lend helping hands all day, every day.

At AirDNA, we believe that a diverse team is a key part of building a great company. If you want to work with us, we want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

AirDNA seeks to attract the best-qualified candidates who support the mission, vision and values of the company and those who respect and promote excellence through diversity. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, physical or mental disability, marital, familial or parental status, genetic information, military status, veteran status or any other legally protected classification. The company complies with all applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment and prohibits unlawful harassment based on any of the aforementioned protected classes at every location in which the company operates. This applies to all terms, conditions and privileges of employment including but not limited to: hiring, assessments, probation, placement, benefits, promotion, demotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, training and development, social and recreational programs, education assistance and retirement.

We are committed to making our application process and workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. Upon request, AirDNA will reasonably accommodate applicants so they can participate in the application process unless doing so would create an undue hardship to AirDNA or a threat to these individuals, others in the workplace or the company as a whole. jobs.title: Director, Information Security
jobs.excerpt: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
jobs.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is looking for a Director, Information Security to lead the security program that protects the highly sensitive fertility and family-building data of members around the world. You will set the security strategy, own both corporate security (GRC, incident response, security awareness, vendor risk) and product security (application, cloud and infrastructure security, secure development lifecycle), and serve as the trusted voice on Carrot's security posture with executives, auditors, and enterprise customers.

Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch.

What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership
  • Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC)
  • Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance
  • Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards
  • Own the compliance portfolio, including SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and HIPAA, and prepare Carrot for additional frameworks such as ISO 27001 as the business requires
  • Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning
  • Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations
  • Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data
  • Build, coach, and grow the security team, balancing hands-on execution with delegation as the team scales
  • Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress
  • Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule
  • A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program
  • A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering
  • A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions
  • A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made
  • Faster, more consistent security reviews for Sales and Customer Success, with fewer escalations from enterprise customers
  • A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional frameworks the business prioritizes, such as ISO 27001

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in technology, including 5+ years in information security and at least 3 years leading security teams
  • A security certification such as CISSP or CISM
  • Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company
  • Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA
  • Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001
  • Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP
  • Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness
  • Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements
  • Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle
  • A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment
  • Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata
  • Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide.

As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $188,000.00 - $245,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to:

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

Über Neolymp

Neolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unser Ziel ist klar: 100 % Wachstum pro Jahr bei starker Profitabilität. In den nächsten drei Jahren wollen wir auf 100 Mio. € Umsatz wachsen und dafür ein starkes Marketplace-Team aufbauen, das du leitest. Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unser Marktplatz-Geschäft und berichtest direkt an unseren Gründer & CEO, entscheidest sehr frei und wirst über Ziele geführt, nicht über Vorgaben.

  • Du verantwortest Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag und Werbebudget aller Marktplätze und steuerst über klare Ziele und KPIs.
  • Du entwickelst Amazon, Otto und Decathlon gezielt weiter und erschließt neue Marktplätze und Länder.
  • Du führst das Marketplace-Team, setzt die Prioritäten im Tagesgeschäft und baust das Team auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. € aus.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Content, Design, Produktentwicklung und Logistik zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Listings, Launches und Bestände zur Strategie passen.
  • Du planst Produkt-Launches und Expansion auf den Marktplätzen mit.
  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Amazon, Otto, Decathlon, Agenturen und Dienstleister und verhandelst Konditionen.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Marketplace-Geschäft, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in leitender Rolle.
  • Du kommst aus einem E-Commerce-Startup oder Scale-up, das bereits mindestens achtstellige Umsätze erzielt, und kannst konkret zeigen, wie du das Marktplatz-Geschäft dort entwickelt hast.

  • Du kennst Otto und Decathlon als Marktplätze und hast idealerweise bereits mit ihnen gearbeitet.

  • Erfahrung im Consumer-Goods-Bereich, gern Sport oder Fitness, ist ein Plus.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und verhandlungssicheres Englisch.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine Marke auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. €: Du gestaltest starkes, profitables Wachstum und baust dabei dein eigenes Team auf.
  • Variable Vergütung: Zusätzlich zum Fixgehalt bist du am Erfolg beteiligt.

  • Startup-Umfeld: regelmäßige Team-Events in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

jobs.title: Contracts Manager/Senior Contracts Manager
jobs.excerpt: Faeth Therapeutics is a clinical-stage oncology company listed on Nasdaq that recently raised $200M in funding.
jobs.description:
Faeth Therapeutics is a clinical-stage oncology company listed on Nasdaq that recently raised $200M in funding. With a strong scientific foundation and a founding team that includes the discoverer of our target pathway, we are advancing PIKTOR, a multi-node PI3K/AKT/mTOR inhibitor program, toward multiple near-term milestones. We are a small, focused team where every person has direct impact — united by a shared commitment to care deeply, create boldly, and never stop learning.

We are looking for a highly self-motivated Contracts Manager / Senior Contracts Manager to join our Legal team as Faeth's first in-house contracts professional. The Contracts Manager will negotiate and manage the company's agreements end to end: drafting, redlining, and negotiating directly with counterparties, then getting each deal approved, signed, filed, and tracked. This position will collaborate with every function in the company, particularly Clinical and CMC, to complete their agreements quickly and well. This is a unique opportunity to join our team and help build a new generation of therapeutic interventions for cancer.

This role spans both sides of contract work. The first is negotiation: understanding which terms matter in a biotech agreement, protecting the company's interests in areas such as intellectual property, confidentiality, and data, and resolving the remaining points efficiently. The second is the operation around it: the process, the Ironclad repository, the playbooks, and the template library, so obtaining a contract at Faeth is simple. We place a premium on judgment and practicality: moving agreements to signature quickly, focusing negotiation on the terms that carry real risk or value, and avoiding unnecessary revisions. A law degree is not required; substantial experience negotiating biotech agreements is. We will level the role as Contracts Manager or Senior Contracts Manager depending on experience.

Reports to: General Counsel

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Responsibilities:

  • Draft, redline, and negotiate the company's agreements directly with counterparties: CDAs, consulting agreements, MSAs and SOWs, vendor and CRO agreements, clinical trial agreements, CMC and supply agreements, MTAs, and others as they arise.
  • Apply our playbooks with judgment: hold firm on intellectual property, confidentiality, data, and other terms that carry real risk; resolve lower stakes points efficiently; escalate to the General Counsel when a position warrants it.
  • Move agreements to signature quickly. Own the timeline on every agreement, keep requesters informed, and remove the friction that slows contracts down.
  • Be the front door for contracts across the company. Triage requests, run with what you can, and route the rest.
  • Build and maintain the contract playbooks: our positions and fallbacks by agreement type, who reviews and approves what, and when a matter goes to the General Counsel or to outside counsel.
  • Route approvals, including Finance, manage signature, file executed agreements in Ironclad with correct metadata, and track renewals, expirations, and obligations.
  • Own the contract repository: every executed agreement in Ironclad, organized, complete, and accessible to the right people.
  • Administer Ironclad: workflows, templates, metadata, permissions, and user training. Keep it easy for employees to find what they need.
  • Rebuild Faeth's contracting process so that anyone who needs a contract knows exactly what to do. Learn our AI-assisted intake tool, test it, and tune it until it works.
  • Maintain the template library, add agreement types as needed, and keep templates and playbooks current with best practice.
  • Coordinate outside counsel and our consultant bench on specialist questions.
  • Use and improve our AI tools and bring ideas for doing this work better.
  • As contract volume allows, take on legal operations work: vendor review, employee training on contracting, and process improvement.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years negotiating and managing contracts at a biotech or pharmaceutical company, or at a law firm or CRO serving them, with most of your career in life sciences.
  • Direct, hands-on experience negotiating the standard biotech agreement set with counterparties, not just routing documents for others to negotiate.
  • Practical judgment: a record of closing agreements quickly, protecting the terms that matter, and resolving lower-stakes points without unnecessary back-and-forth.
  • Experience administering a contract lifecycle management system, not just using one.
  • A track record of owning the administrative side of contracting (signatures, filing, tracking) with the organizational discipline and service mindset that takes.
  • Active, current use of AI tools in your work, and an appetite to go deeper.
  • Preferred: Ironclad Signature or Docusign experience; public-company experience; having built playbooks or a template library or led a CLM implementation; exposure to clinical operations contracting; broader legal operations experience.
  • A paralegal certificate or law degree is welcome but not required.

Compensation Range: $118,000 - $160,000 (actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications and location)

Working at Faeth

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and equity in a well-funded, clinical-stage biotech
  • 100% remote work and flexible schedule
  • Health, dental, and vision for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off
  • Generous parental leave
  • Traditional and Roth 401k
  • Mission oriented, remote first culture

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

All offers of employment are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check and verification of eligibility to work in the United States.

WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast. Ohne diese Erfahrung ist eine Bewerbung leider nicht sinnvoll.

Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, durch digitales Recruiting die besten Mitarbeiter zu finden. Dafür läuft bei uns ein eingespielter Prozess: Wir wissen, welche Werbeanzeigen funktionieren, wie die Texte aufgebaut sind und wie eine Kampagne aussehen muss und welche Handgriffe es in Meta für eine erfolgreiche Kampagne braucht.

Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

Wir wachsen weiter und suchen deshalb Unterstützung bei der Durchführung unserer Projekte.

Deine Aufgaben

Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

Du legst unsere Kunden in BVS an und erstellst die Verknüpfungen, so dass die Bewerber auch an den Kunden weitergeleitet werden.

Betreuen unserer Recruiting-Kampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Projektleiterin, nach unserem bestehenden System

Als Urlaubsvertretung übernimmst du die Gestaltung von Kampagnen in Canva und erstellst die passenden Texte für neue Kampagnen. Du arbeitest mit unseren Vorlagen und setzt daraus ansprechende Anzeigen und Grafiken um.

Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

Das bieten wir

Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

Interessiert? Melde dich bei uns und lass uns sprechen (Lebenslauf und deine Kontaktdaten reichen aus - kein Motivationsschreiben).

Process Analysis & Automation

Workflow Optimization

Documentation

  • Maintain documentation for workflows, integrations, APIs, and automation logic.
  • Create SOPs and reference guides to support automation systems.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience building workflow automation and AI-powered business processes.
  • Hands-on experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, or Power Automate.
  • Experience integrating OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar AI APIs.

Interview Process

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

jobs.excerpt: Cazoo, is the ultimate destination for car enthusiasts and buyers alike!
jobs.description:
Cazoo, is the ultimate destination for car enthusiasts and buyers alike! As a leader in the market, we pride ourselves on providing unparalleled search tools, expert car guides, insightful reviews, and a comprehensive vehicle price guide. Our mission is simple: to empower buyers to find their perfect car efficiently and with confidence, while also helping automotive retailers reach millions of eager buyers.

At Cazoo, you'll be part of a team that's revolutionising the way people buy and sell cars. If you're ready to drive your career forward in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, Cazoo is the place for you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of automotive retail!

We are looking for Principal Platform Engineer

Reports To: Director of Technology

Contract Type: Permanent

Location: Remote, UK based

About the role:

We're looking for a Principal Platform Engineer to help shape the next generation of Cazoo's technology platform.

We're undertaking a significant modernisation of our existing Azure-based architecture, moving towards more scalable, cloud-native and event-driven services. This is an opportunity to influence how our core platform evolves, improve the experience of our engineering teams and build the foundations that support our customer-facing products.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, combining software engineering, architecture and platform strategy. You'll spend around half your time actively contributing to engineering delivery, while also helping set technical direction, mentoring engineers and driving initiatives across teams.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Driving platform modernisation: Lead the design and delivery of cloud-native, event-driven services, including the safe retirement of legacy systems.

  • Shaping technical direction: Own and deliver the roadmap for core platform capabilities, working with Engineering, Product and Commercial stakeholders to align priorities.

  • Remaining hands-on: Write production code, review pull requests, solve complex technical problems and work directly alongside engineering teams.

  • Improving developer experience: Build and evolve shared services, tooling and engineering practices that make it easier for our teams to deliver high-quality software.

  • Championing engineering excellence: Improve scalability, reliability, observability and operational standards across our platform.

  • Leading through collaboration: Work closely with architects, Principal Engineers and cross-functional squads to turn architectural vision into practical solutions.

  • Developing our engineers: Mentor others, share knowledge and help establish consistent engineering standards across teams.

  • Embracing AI-assisted engineering: Help establish effective practices and guardrails for using AI development tools to improve productivity without compromising quality or security.

You'll have genuine ownership and influence, with the opportunity to make meaningful architectural decisions while remaining close to the technology and people delivering them.

What we ideally looking for;
Extensive backend or platform engineering experience, gained building and operating high-traffic, business-critical systems, ideally within a product-led technology business.

  • Strong cloud engineering expertise, preferably Azure, with a solid understanding of cloud-native architecture, managed services and infrastructure as code.

  • Proficiency in a modern backend language, ideally TypeScript/Node.js, although we're open to experienced engineers with strong transferable backgrounds, such as Java.

  • Experience with distributed and event-driven systems, including technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus.

  • Solid understanding of platform technologies, including Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and observability tooling.

  • Experience designing data-intensive services, working with relational and non-relational databases, caching and search technologies.

  • Demonstrable technical leadership, influencing architectural decisions, mentoring engineers and driving complex initiatives across multiple teams.

  • Sound engineering judgement, knowing when to build versus buy, how to balance technical debt against delivery priorities and how to make pragmatic architectural decisions.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development, using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot with an understanding of their benefits and limitations.

Experience in automotive, marketplaces, classifieds or other consumer-facing digital platforms would be advantageous.

We're particularly interested in engineers who combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative, pragmatic approach

Perks & Benefits

Here’s how we back you:

Financials💰

  • We more than match your commitment to your pension, so when you contribute 6% , we put in 9%, taking your total up to 15% of your base salary.

  • Quarterly value-led awards with generous cash prizes.

  • Referral Bonus: Recommend a colleague, get £2,000.

Work-Life 🏖️

  • 25 days (plus bank holidays)

  • Family Enhanced leave after 6 months of service:

  • Maternity/Pregnant Parent Leave: 20 weeks at 100% pay,.

  • Paternity/Non-birth Parent Leave: 12 weeks at 100% pay.

  • Volunteer Days: We offer 2 volunteer days a year so you can help out wherever matters to you.

Health & Peace of Mind 🏩

Comprehensive cover so you (and your favourite people) have the care you need.

  • AXA Private Healthcare: High-level coverage for you, partners, and dependents—including pre-existing conditions.

  • Bupa Dental: Level 2 coverage for cashback on preventative, restorative and emergency care.

  • Private GP: 24/7 digital access via Help@Hand.

  • Income Protection: 13 weeks of sick pay, before going onto Long term Illness cover with Canada Life

  • Life Assurance: 4x basic salary covered by Unum.

  • Specialist Support: Free counseling and menopause/fertility support via Peppy.

Your Growth 🌱

We hired you for your talent, and we’re committed to helping you expand it.

  • Learning budget and continuous development opportunities. Every manager has a dedicated budget for your specific role development.

The Extras 🔍

jobs.excerpt: RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENTFCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
jobs.description:
RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENT

FCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
Classée parmi les cinq plus grandes sociétés de gestion de voyages au monde, FCM dispose d’un réseau d’affaires présent dans plus de 97 pays, avec des sièges sociaux mondiaux à Londres, Brisbane, Singapour et New York. Appuyée par la force mondiale de Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combine une expertise locale et une portée internationale afin d’offrir à ses clients une expérience véritablement personnalisée.
Fondée en juin 2004, FCM a été nommée Meilleure société de gestion de voyages au monde pendant huit années consécutives aux World Travel Awards.

Pour en savoir plus sur FCM, veuillez cliquer ICI


À propos du poste

Joignez-vous à FCM à titre de Responsable de l’implémentation client et jouez un rôle clé dans la prestation d’une expérience d’intégration fluide auprès de clients nationaux et multinationaux. Ce poste est au cœur de la réussite client, veillant à ce que les nouveaux clients soient implantés avec succès, soutenus efficacement et positionnés en vue d’un partenariat à long terme. Vous collaborerez avec les parties prenantes internes et les équipes clientes, gérerez plusieurs projets d’implémentation simultanément et contribuerez à l’atteinte de résultats exceptionnels pour la clientèle. Si vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, coordonner des projets et offrir une expérience client remarquable, cette occasion vous permettra d’avoir un impact concret.

Responsabilités principales

  • Gérer l’implémentation et l’intégration de clients nationaux et multinationaux conformément aux processus d’implémentation établis.
  • Offrir une expérience client d'une qualité supérieure tout au long du cycle de vie de chaque projet.
  • Coordonner et animer les réunions d’implémentation avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Assurer le suivi des échéanciers et veiller au respect des jalons convenus pour chaque implémentation.
  • Identifier, communiquer et escalader les risques liés aux projets en appliquant les méthodologies de gestion des risques en place.
  • Maintenir à jour et avec exactitude la documentation d’implémentation, les énoncés de travaux (SOW) et les dossiers de projet.
  • Recueillir et valider de manière proactive les informations nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet.
  • Soutenir les projets d’implémentation régionaux pour les clients multinationaux ainsi que l’adoption continue des outils en ligne.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des projets et des échéanciers au moyen des outils internes de gestion de projet.
  • Veiller au respect des normes, systèmes, processus et meilleures pratiques liés à l’implémentation.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec les collègues, les gestionnaires et les parties prenantes afin d’atteindre les objectifs d’implémentation.
  • Appuyer les activités de tests d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) et veiller à l’exactitude des implémentations.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue grâce aux revues de projet et aux commentaires des clients.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus dans leur réussite.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche ou responsabilité connexe assignée.
  • Autres tâches et responsabilités assignées
  • Contribuer à un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus afin de s’épanouir

Expérience et compétences

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience au sein de Flight Centre ou 2 ans d’expérience à titre de Gestionnaire de l’implémentation ou dans un poste similaire.
  • Excellente compréhension des processus d’implémentation.
  • Feuille de route démontrée en matière de réussite dans des fonctions antérieures.
  • Solides compétences en coordination de projets et en gestion du temps.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Fort sens des affaires et excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des clients et des parties prenantes à divers niveaux organisationnels.
  • Connaissance des outils de réservation en ligne, un atout.
  • Approche souple et grande capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement d’affaires en constante évolution.
  • Disponibilité pour effectuer des déplacements occasionnels, au besoin.
  • Bilinguisme (français et anglais) requis
  • Une connexion Internet fiable et à haut débit est requise pour assurer les responsabilités essentielles du poste, y compris, sans s’y limiter, la vidéoconférence, l’accès aux systèmes de l’entreprise et le traitement sécurisé des données de l’entreprise.
  • Le bilinguisme français/anglais est requis, en raison de la nature du poste qui consiste à traiter avec des clients et des fournisseurs français et anglais.

Des conditions de travail qui ont de quoi séduire!

FCTG est reconnu dans le monde entier pour ses magnifiques conditions de travail et sa culture entrepreneuriale encore plus exceptionnelle. Nous savons que notre personnel est notre atout le plus précieux. C’est la passion et le dévouement de nos équipes qui maintiennent notre entreprise au sommet de son industrie. C’est également la raison pour laquelle nous offrons des avantages sociaux et des primes hors du commun à notre personnel.

  • Amusez-vous: l’importance d’avoir du plaisir au travail imprègne chacun de nos gestes.
  • Obtenez des récompenses et une reconnaissance: voyez vos succès et ceux des autres être applaudis lors des fameuses soirées Buzz que nous organisons régulièrement, ainsi qu’au rassemblement mondial annuel. Il faut le vivre pour le croire !
  • Puisez dans votre génie : nos collaborateurs se servent de leur vivacité d’esprit, de leur savoir-faire et de leur persévérance pour trouver en tout temps une solution.
  • L’amour du voyage : notre société a été fondée par des personnes qui voulaient voyager et qui souhaitaient que d’autres en fassent autant. Cette passion marque immanquablement tout notre personnel et l’ensemble de nos services.
  • Des liens personnels : le fondement de notre grande entreprise repose sur les relations personnelles.
  • Diversité, équité et inclusion : engagement envers la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion à travers des initiatives telles que la Journée de la diversité (congé payé pour observer un jour férié ou une célébration culturelle de votre choix) Groupes de ressources pour les employés (équité raciale, équité des genres, LGBTQ2IA+, accessibilité, justice environnementale ), les initiatives éducatives du DEI et les pratiques équitables, y compris des évaluations régulières de l'équité et des protocoles de recrutement inclusifs.
  • Une carrière, et non un boulot: nous offrons à tous de véritables possibilités de croissance et d’évolution personnelle.
  • Nous offrons notre soutien tout temps à nos employés : nous nous engageons fermement à soutenir chaque employé dans son développement professionnel et personnel.
  • Redonner en retour : nous nous engageons à faire une différence grâce à notre programme de responsabilité sociale d'entreprise, qui soutient les organismes de bienfaisance désignés via le bénévolat et la collecte de fonds, notre programme environnemental de bureau, des espaces de bureau certifiés LEED® Gold et une journée de bénévolat rémunérée par année civile.

Voici un aperçu des avantages offerts :
Avantages

  • Politique généreuse de congés payés
  • Avantages et rabais liés aux voyages
  • Programmes de santé et de bien-être et services de bien-être financier pour les employés
  • Soirées de reconnaissance et conférences nationales et internationals
  • Avantages sociaux collectifs, incluant l’assurance maladie complémentaire, les soins dentaires et de la vue, les soins d’affirmation de genre et les soins de fertilité
  • Assurances, incluant l’assurance vie, l’assurance décès et mutilation accidentels, l’assurance maladies graves et l’assurance invalidité de longue durée
  • Programme d’aide aux employés
  • REER/RPA avec contribution de l’employeur
  • Programme de remboursement des frais de scolarité
  • Régime d’actionnariat des employés – possibilité d’acheter des actions de la société à la Bourse australienne, avec une contribution partielle de l’employeur, sous réserve des modalités et conditions applicables
  • Possibilités de carrière à l’échelle mondiale au sein d’un réseau de marques et d’entreprises

Emplacement – TÉLÉTRAVAIL, Canada

Si vous pensez que c’est là le poste que vous cherchiez et que vous souhaitez adhérer à notre culture entrepreneuriale primée, POSTULEZ SANS TARDER.

Cette offre d'emploi correspond à un poste vacant que nous cherchons actuellement à pourvoir.

Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, nous pouvons utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir différentes étapes, notamment la présélection et l’évaluation des candidatures. Ces outils nous aident à évaluer les candidats en fonction des qualifications, des compétences et de l’expérience pertinentes pour le poste. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par notre équipe de recrutement et les parties prenantes concernées.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de candidats ayant des expériences variées.

Avant de postuler à un poste interne, vous devez être dans l'entreprise ou dans votre poste actuel depuis au moins 6 à 12 mois et en informer votre responsable avant de postuler.

Vous avez des questions sur cette opportunité? Communiquez avec notre équipe de recrutement à l'adresse

Pour ce poste, nous prévoyons offrir un salaire annuel compris entre 88 000 $ et 90 000 $. Le salaire de base sera établi en fonction de divers facteurs pertinents, notamment l’expérience, l’emplacement géographique et les exigences du poste.

Notre philosophie numéro un? Nos employés. La promesse de Flight Centre Travel Group est de fournir un environnement où prônent le respect, la dignité et des opportunités pour tous nos employés. Nous valorisons un lieu de travail inclusif et solidaire qui reflète véritablement la diversité de notre société.

Nous nous engageons à procurer un environnement où règne l’égalité en matière de respect, de dignité et de possibilités pour tous les membres de notre personnel. Flight Centre Travel Group s’engage à faciliter votre parcours tout au long du processus de sélection. Si vous avez besoin d’un accommodement en raison d’un handicap à une quelconque étape de notre processus d’embauche, veuillez-nous en informer à l’avance en communiquant avec notre équipe de recrutement à .

Pour l'anglais

🏆 Travel Weekly Magellan Awards : Lauréat Argent (2023)
🌟 GBTA WINiT Top 50 : Récipiendaires du prix (2018–2025)
💫 CHHR : Employeur DE&I 5 étoiles (2023, 2024)

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio.

Stripe is expanding its Link Product Sales team, and this role is focused exclusively on bank payments. As an Account Executive, you will help businesses give their customers a fast, trusted way to pay from a bank account using Stripe’s full stack of payments solutions while accelerating the growth of the Link network. Few roles offer such a direct opportunity to shape and grow one of Stripe’s top company priorities.

What you’ll do

As a founding Account Executive for Bank Payments, you will play a central role in shaping and executing Stripe’s go-to-market strategy for this growing product area. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other GTM teams to build deep product and industry expertise, lead complex deals, and guide in-depth conversations with existing and prospective customers. You will bring customer and market insights back to Stripe, helping influence both the product roadmap and how we take bank payments to market.

Bank payments and account connectivity are also an important part of Link’s broader vision for the future of commerce. Where the opportunity intersects with adjacent Link priorities—such as agentic commerce—you will help explore emerging customer use cases and shape how Stripe brings new experiences to market. This gives you the opportunity to build a focused bank payments business while contributing to some of Stripe’s most forward-looking initiatives.

You are an adept sales professional who can lead business and technical conversations at every level of an organization. You know how to establish value in competitive situations and are energized by products that require deep industry expertise and technical fluency. You are equally comfortable working with customers and internal partners, eager to develop and share expertise, and motivated by the opportunity to build in a fast-moving environment. You are an entrepreneurial self-starter, an exceptional communicator, and an analytical thinker with a record of top performance and making the teams around you better.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

Toast is looking for a Senior Director, Customer Care Operational Excellence to own how our customer support organization operates, end to end. This is a build-and-run role: you will design (and continuously redesign) the people, process, systems, and data that determine whether every customer, from our smallest SMB accounts to our largest Enterprise relationships, gets a fast, effortless, high-quality resolution.

This role sits at the center of our AI transformation of Support operations, evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI across chat, voice, and agent-assist workflows, while also owning the fundamentals: workforce planning and capacity, quality and performance measurement, and a closed-loop voice-of-customer program that feeds directly into our product and engineering roadmaps. You will lead a team, and this is a hands-on role: you're expected to get into the details, run point on hard problems personally, and build things yourself when needed.

Support Operating Model: People, Process & Systems

    • Own the end-to-end design of how Support operates: org structure, staffing model, tiering/routing, escalation paths, and channel model (chat, email, phone, self-service, community), and continuously refine it as the business scales.
    • Build and run the operating cadence for the function: performance reviews, root-cause/escalation reviews, leadership readouts, and continuous-improvement rhythms.
    • Segment design so that SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customers each get a service model appropriate to their needs, complexity, and value.
  • AI & Support Technology Transformation
    • Own the roadmap for AI-enabled support, including virtual agents/chatbots, voice AI, agent-assist, and automation, from business case through implementation, measured adoption, and iteration.
    • Partner with Product and Engineering as a co-owner of the tools and systems Support runs on: helpdesk/CRM, contact center (CCaaS), knowledge base, and AI/automation platforms, representing Support's requirements and stress-testing what's shipped.
    • Evaluate, select, and manage the vendor and technology stack (including AI vendors and BPO/outsourcing partners), balancing cost, quality, and customer experience.

Data, Insights & Performance Measurement

    • Define the metrics that matter for Toast’s support operations, including but not limited to TTR/resolution time, CSAT, customer effort (CES), quality/QA scores, cost-to-serve, and AI containment/deflection rate. Partner with Analytics to build the reporting and analytics and associated insights to drive operations across lines of business, segments, channels, and geographies.
    • Build a rigorous quality assurance program (QA scoring, calibration, coaching feedback loops) to ensure consistency as the org scales and as AI takes on more of the work.
    • Use data to diagnose root causes of poor experience and prioritize the highest-leverage fixes across people, process, and systems.
  • Voice of the Customer & Product Feedback
    • Own Product Feedback program in partnership with VOC and other related efforts: capturing, synthesizing, and prioritizing feedback and issues surfaced through Support.
    • Build the formal, closed-loop mechanism that routes customer and product feedback to R&D/Product leadership, ensuring it gets actioned and tracked through to impact on support volume and CSAT.
  • Workforce Planning & Capacity Management
  • Own workforce planning, forecasting, and capacity management (staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, real-time management) across in-house and outsourced/BPO teams.
  • Model the impact of AI automation on headcount and capacity plans, and adjust staffing levels as containment rates change.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnership

    • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership as a genuine design partner on tools, features, and AI capabilities that affect the customer experience or support workload.
    • Represent Support in cross-functional planning (Sales, Success, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Trust & Safety) and ensure Support's operational needs and constraints are reflected in company-wide decisions.
    • Communicate performance, risk, and plans to executive leadership through regular business reviews.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

    • Build, lead, and develop a team of operations and operational excellence managers/leads; build the bench and succession plan for the function.
    • Instill a hands-on, builder culture on the team: this function should be as comfortable running an analysis or drafting a process itself as it is directing others to do so.

  • 12+ years of experience in Customer Support/Service, Customer Experience, or Support Operations, including significant leadership experience at the Director level or above.
  • Track record building and scaling support organizations inside large, high-growth technology companies, ideally B2B/B2B2C, that went through significant scale (multiple X revenue/customer growth) rather than steady-state maintenance.
  • Direct, hands-on experience implementing AI in a support organization (virtual agent/chatbot, voice AI, agent-assist, automation), able to speak to what was built, how it was measured, and what it actually did to cost and experience.
  • Experience supporting multiple customer segments (SMB through Enterprise) with differentiated service models, SLAs, and channels.

  • Experience with workforce management/capacity planning disciplines and tools.

Volunteer: Co-Chief Analytics Officer (2 - 5 hours per week desired commitment)

Location: Remote in the US

Join the WeVote Movement

WeVote has a new executive-level open volunteering position. We are seeking a Co-Chief Analytics Officer (2+ hours per week) who wants to use their existing skills to help strengthen American Democracy, and help lead our successful analytics team. If you are passionate about using data to make a difference in the world, we encourage you to apply!

About Us

WeVote is a remote-first, nonpartisan, get-out-the-vote nonprofit startup and a celebratedFast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. WeVote is a movement of over 150 passionate active volunteers (starting with the founders) who are building open-source mobile technologies that touch and mobilize millions of voters on Election Day. We believe that many voters are busy, distracted, and impatient. We have a goal of providing a complete voting experience in 8 minutes, including the download of our app ("WeVote Ballot Guide, @WeVote"). Please sign up athttps://WeVote.US before applying. See Twitter@WeVote.

What You’ll Do

  • Co-lead our 15+ person team of data scientists and analysts in implementing our analytics strategy
  • Define key analytics indicators, for reporting back to the rest of our team
  • Make reports and regular dashboards available to our strategy team, and other stakeholder teams
  • Find stories about how voters are using WeVote in the data
  • Work with our product team to design and build new features that help voters make informed decisions, based on usage patterns you are seeing.
  • Provide reports about voter activity for specific elections
  • Interview new volunteers interested in joining our team

Who you are: Must haves.

  • At least 2 hours each week during our core team hours M-F 8 a.m. - 6 p.m. (any US time zone)
  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, preferably leading a team for 3+ years
  • Some experience with Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, Google Ads, etc. We have expertise in the existing team but need to improve the dashboards we use to track progress week-to-week
  • You want to work with an established and successful team. You are committed to strengthening American Democracy
  • You are striving for personal excellence
  • A willingness to work with and support other volunteers
  • A stable schedule for the next 6 months, or professional-grade schedule management, since we are building a team that has to rely on each other

Not required, but nice to have.

  • If you have more than 2 hours to volunteer each week, go more deeply into supporting the existing team

What You’ll Gain

You will have the opportunity to touch the lives of millions of Americans and be part of a movement and product that will receive national attention. You’ll gain an opportunity to grow within the WeVote movement and meet other volunteers who are like-minded and interested in building a valuable application to empower voters across the United States. You’ll also expand your personal and professional network.

Requirements

  • You are in agreement with WeVote’s Core Values.

Please share a brief cover letter sharing why you find this opportunity interesting. Thank you!

Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

As a Principal Mobile Engineer (POS-Terminal) at Moniepoint, you will be responsible for designing and leading the architecture of our POS terminal solutions across multiple platforms. You will ensure the scalability, security, performance, and reliability of our POS systems and related applications, including mobile apps for repair scheduling and maintenance. While the majority of our terminals are currently based on Android Native, your expertise in cross-platform solutions (e.g., Flutter, C, JavaScript) will be crucial as we expand and diversify our portfolio.You’ll play a critical role in shaping the direction of our POS-related products, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring the technical vision aligns with the company’s broader strategic goals.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will do:

  • Lead the design and architecture of POS terminal solutions, ensuring security, scalability, performance, and integration with various hardware and payment systems.
  • Develop and maintain architectural documents and diagrams for POS terminal systems, ensuring all platforms are well documented and up to date.
  • Make architectural decisions on POS terminal software, integrating various payment technologies, EMV standards, and ensuring hardware compatibility.
  • Lead the development of POS-related applications
  • Optimize system performance and security, particularly around payment processing and EMV protocols.
  • Participate in planning sessions with product and engineering teams to ensure solutions meet market needs and business goals.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices for mobile and embedded systems development, especially for Android Native development.
  • Define and enforce software engineering best practices across the POS and related teams to improve efficiency and developer productivity.
  • Ensure the stability and reliability of POS terminal products and applications, monitoring system performance and troubleshooting as necessary.
  • Provide technical mentorship to engineering teams, helping them grow their skills and contribute to the broader technical vision.
  • Participate in the hiring process, screening engineers with expertise in POS systems, mobile, and embedded development.

To succeed in this role, we think you should have:

  • At least 8 years of experience in system design, architecture, and development, specifically in the POS terminal domain.
  • Strong expertise in Android Native development (Java/Kotlin), with a deep understanding of Android-based POS terminal solutions.
  • Experience in cross-platform mobile development, such as Flutter, and familiarity with other POS application platforms (e.g., C, JavaScript) is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of EMV (Europay, Mastercard, and Visa) security protocols, including chip-based transactions, encryption, and key management.
  • Experience with hardware integration for POS devices, such as card readers, pin pads, printers, and other peripherals.
  • Deep understanding of payment systems architecture, including integration with payment processors and gateways.
  • Knowledge of software quality assurance principles and their application in financial systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an ability to manage complex system interactions and adapt to changing requirements.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Leadership abilities with a focus on mentoring engineers and driving process improvements within the team.

What we can offer you

  • Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance,annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters
  • A Takehome Hackerrank test.
  • A Technical interview session with our Engineering Team
  • A Technical and Behavioural Interview with our Head of Mobile Engineering
  • A Behavioral and Technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

About the Role

We are looking for a Policy Researcher to support a regional initiative focused on the intersection of education, technology, and AI.

The role will focus on understanding government priorities, policy and regulatory environments, institutional structures, and emerging developments that may influence the adoption of AI and technology within education systems across the MENA region.

This is an applied research role. We are looking for someone who can go beyond collecting information and translate research into clear, practical insights and recommendations for program and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research national policies, strategies, regulations, and government initiatives related to education, AI, digital transformation, and teacher development.
  • Analyze how governments and education authorities are approaching AI adoption and responsible use within education.
  • Identify relevant policy developments, opportunities, constraints, and potential risks.
  • Map key government entities, ministries, education authorities, regulators, universities, and other relevant institutions.
  • Identify key stakeholders, decision-makers, influencers, and potential institutional champions.
  • Map existing government-led and institutional initiatives related to AI, digital education, and educator development.
  • Analyze potential barriers and enablers to institutional adoption.
  • Identify opportunities to align initiatives with national education and AI priorities.
  • Develop recommendations for government and institutional engagement.
  • Prepare concise briefing notes ahead of stakeholder meetings.
  • Track relevant policy and regulatory developments throughout the engagement.
  • Support the team in understanding potential pathways for long-term institutional adoption and sustainability.

Expected Deliverables

The researcher may be responsible for:

  • Country-level policy and landscape briefs.
  • Government and institutional stakeholder maps.
  • National strategy and policy mapping.
  • Mapping of relevant existing initiatives.
  • Opportunity, barrier, and risk analysis.
  • Stakeholder prioritization and engagement recommendations.
  • Briefing notes for government and institutional meetings.
  • Regular updates on relevant policy or regulatory developments.
  • Strategic recommendations based on research findings.

What We are Looking For

  • Experience in public policy, education policy, government affairs, international development, or policy research.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, particularly in interpreting government strategies, policies, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Good understanding of government and institutional ecosystems in the MENA region.
  • Experience in education, technology, AI policy, digital transformation, or workforce development is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate complex research into clear recommendations for non-policy audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder-mapping skills.
  • Excellent written communication and ability to prepare concise executive-level briefs.
  • Ability to work independently and manage research across multiple markets.
  • Professional fluency in English; Arabic is strongly preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working with or researching Ministries of Education, government entities, education authorities, or universities.
  • Experience in AI policy, responsible AI, EdTech, or digital education.

What Success Looks Like

The researcher provides the team with a clear understanding of the policy environment, government priorities, relevant stakeholders, potential barriers, and opportunities in each market.

Research should enable the team to make better decisions, approach the right stakeholders, anticipate policy considerations, and identify realistic pathways for institutional adoption and long-term sustainability.

Mission Inbox is the infrastructure layer for B2B email at scale. We provide dedicated-IP sending infrastructure, automated DNS authentication, pre-send compliance scanning, and reputation management for B2B sales teams, agencies, and SaaS companies that depend on email deliverability as a core business function.

We are at an inflection point. The product is built, revenue is growing, and the customer base is expanding. What we don't have yet is a marketing engine. That's the gap this role is hired to close — from zero.

This is not a "run our marketing" role. There is no existing playbook to execute, no team to manage, and no agency doing the heavy lifting. You will be the first dedicated marketing hire at Mission Inbox. You will build the strategy, own the execution, and eventually manage the team as channels mature and headcount follows performance.

The right person sees this as the defining chapter of their career — a rare chance to build a full marketing function at a technical infrastructure company with real revenue, real customers, and real upside.Our Team is distributed all over the world, we welcome talent, no matter their geography, ethnicity or religion.

What You Will Own

Demand Generation & Paid Media Own paid acquisition across LinkedIn, Google, and relevant niche channels. Build and iterate on audience targeting, creative, and bidding strategy — no agency dependency. Define and hit a monthly pipeline contribution target. Manage budget allocation across channels based on CAC and payback period data.

Organic Content Engine Build a consistent content operation: blog, LinkedIn, newsletter, thought leadership. Develop and execute an SEO strategy targeting deliverability, cold email, and outbound infrastructure keywords. Write or directly manage 80%+ of content output in the first 12 months.

Website & Conversion Optimization Own the Mission Inbox website end-to-end: messaging, structure, and conversion performance. Run continuous CRO experiments across landing pages, CTAs, pricing page, and sign-up flow. Implement and maintain tracking, attribution, and analytics infrastructure.

Product-Led Growth (PLG) Design and execute in-product marketing and activation flows for self-serve users. Build onboarding email sequences that drive feature adoption and time-to-value. Define PQL criteria and build the handoff motion to sales.

Webinars & Events Launch and run a recurring webinar program targeting B2B sales leaders, RevOps, and agency operators. Identify and manage presence at relevant industry events. Build event follow-up nurture workflows that convert attendance to pipeline.

Nurture & Lifecycle Campaigns Design and execute multi-touch nurture programs for MQLs, trial users, and churned accounts. Build behavioral email workflows triggered by product activity and sales signals. Own HubSpot (or equivalent) — setup, segmentation, automation, and reporting.

Your First 60 Days

Days 1–10: Deep-dive into the product, ICP, and existing customers. Audit the website, CRM, current content, and any existing paid spend. Deliver a written State of Marketing assessment and a prioritized plan with proposed KPI targets.

Days 11–30: Launch core infrastructure — Attio setup, website messaging alignment, attribution tracking, first paid test campaigns. Shipping content, launching new ads and setting up new marketing content production engine.

Days 31–60: First webinar live. First nurture sequence running. Paid campaigns optimized with real data. First pipeline attribution report presented to CEO.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with at least 2 years operating as an IC or small-team lead
  • Proven track record building pipeline from scratch — not inheriting a mature funnel
  • You have owned a pipeline or revenue number directly, not just an MQL target
  • Fluent in the full marketing stack: Attio/Hubspot, Google/LinkedIn Ads, SEO tooling (Ahrefs/Semrush), analytics (GA4, Mixpanel or equivalent)

  • Comfortable with technical products: you understand DNS records, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and why deliverability matters to a sales team
  • PLG experience: you have built or contributed to product-led onboarding or activation flows
  • Native or near-native English — written communication is a core output of this role
  • Comfortable being the only marketer for 12+ months before building a team
  • Talks in CAC, payback period, and pipeline velocity — not impressions and follower counts

Benefits

  • Equity: Discussable based on background and demonstrated results
  • Performance Bonus: Yearly bonus tied directly to pipeline and MRR targets
