jobs.excerpt: Company Overviewhermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced crypto-native researcher to join our alpha-generating research team at hermeneutic Investments.

The ideal candidate combines deep on-chain analytical capability with strong market intuition and a demonstrated ability to independently generate trade ideas. This role is focused on identifying actionable opportunities across crypto markets through blockchain analysis, market structure research, real-time event interpretation, and exploratory data analysis.

Candidates should possess strong familiarity with Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and major non-EVM blockchains, alongside the ability to rapidly investigate unfamiliar protocols, entities, and market events. Successful researchers in this role are highly self-sufficient: they are capable of independently sourcing data, navigating APIs and SQL datasets, leveraging modern analytical and LLM tooling, and rapidly validating hypotheses under time pressure.

This role is designed for individuals who enjoy uncovering informational and structural market inefficiencies through deep technical investigation and creative research.

Responsibilities

Alpha Generation & Research

  • Generate differentiated trade ideas through on-chain analysis, market structure understanding, and thematic research.
  • Identify emerging trends, positioning imbalances, capital flows, behavioral patterns, and structural inefficiencies across crypto markets.
  • Rapidly investigate market-moving events and determine whether observed activity represents noise, positioning, or actionable signal.
  • Conduct exploratory research across Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and non-EVM blockchains to identify asymmetric opportunities.
  • Use on-chain activity, market behavior, and historical context to develop actionable trading insights.
  • Continually evaluate new analytical frameworks, datasets, and publicly available research to improve research capabilities and thematic coverage.

Blockchain Analysis

  • Perform detailed entity attribution, wallet clustering, and transaction graph analysis across both account-based and UTXO-based blockchains.
  • Analyze Bitcoin transaction flows, miner activity, ETF and exchange flows, treasury activity, and cross-venue capital movement.
  • Investigate token supply dynamics including genesis distributions, insider activity, vesting, staking, governance, treasury management, and unlock schedules.
  • Monitor consensus mechanisms, validator behavior, bridge activity, and broader blockchain infrastructure dynamics.
  • Evaluate unfamiliar blockchain networks, protocols, and ecosystems when new opportunities arise.

Data & Tooling

  • Independently source, query, and analyze blockchain and market datasets using SQL and API endpoints for internal data platforms.
  • Navigate complex blockchain data schemas to rapidly validate hypotheses and support trading decisions.
  • Leverage LLM and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate exploratory analysis, attribution workflows, summarization, and ad hoc research.
  • Prototype analytical workflows and research tooling prior to involving engineering resources where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve internal analytics frameworks, monitoring systems, datasets, and research tooling.

Real-Time Monitoring & Market Awareness

  • Monitor on-chain activity, market events, and information flows in real time for potential tradeable opportunities.
  • Maintain awareness of major market themes, positioning, unlocks, governance proposals, protocol upgrades, ETF developments, and ecosystem catalysts.
  • Build and maintain high-quality monitoring workflows and alerts for themes and entities of interest.
  • Communicate complex blockchain activity and market developments clearly and concisely to traders and researchers.
  • Operate effectively under time pressure during volatile or fast-moving market conditions.

Requirements

Experience & Knowledge

  • 3+ years of experience in blockchain analysis, crypto research, trading research, or related fields.
  • Demonstrable experience conducting deep on-chain investigations, high quality wallet attribution, entity analysis, or blockchain-based market research.
  • Strong familiarity with Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and major non-EVM blockchains.
  • Deep understanding of how blockchain activity, market structure, and information flows influence price formation in crypto markets.
  • Strong understanding of crypto market history, positioning dynamics, and major historical market events.
  • Crypto-native with strong curiosity and passion for digital asset markets.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong proficiency with SQL/APIs and experience working with large blockchain datasets and warehouse schemas.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics and visualization platforms such as Dune, Flipside, Arkham, Nansen, Etherscan, Solscan, Token Terminal, DefiLlama, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Bitcoin’s UTXO model and associated transaction analysis techniques.
  • Ability to independently conduct ad hoc exploratory analysis using modern research and AI-assisted tooling.
  • Experience using Python, and SQL, or similar languages for research and prototyping.
  • Strong intuition for identifying meaningful signal amid noisy, incomplete, or fast-moving market information.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to rapidly translate research findings into actionable insights.

Operational & Communication Skills

  • Ability to make quick, informed decisions during high-pressure market events.
  • Strong attention to detail while tracking multiple assets, ecosystems, and market themes simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High degree of ownership, self-direction, and intellectual curiosity.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across trading, research, and engineering teams.
  • Flexibility in working hours to align with global crypto market activity when necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience generating alpha from on-chain activity, real-time market events, or structural market dislocations.
  • Prior experience at a trading firm, hedge fund, market intelligence firm, or crypto-native research organization.
  • Experience working with market microstructure, derivatives positioning, or cross-venue flows.
  • Familiarity with real-time monitoring systems, alerting frameworks, or information aggregation tooling.
  • Strong network within the crypto ecosystem and familiarity with key entities, protocols, market participants, and information channels.

Interview Process

1. Initial Interview with Senior Researcher

  • Overview of the opportunity, technical background screening, and cultural fit assessment.
  • Discussion focused on blockchain analysis experience, market intuition, and research process.

2. Technical & Research Interviews

  • Deeper evaluation of attribution methodologies, market reasoning, data analysis workflows, and opportunity identification.
  • Discussion of prior trade ideas, research projects, and investigative workflows.

3. Research Assessment & Presentation

  • Candidates will complete an on-chain research assessment and present findings to the team.
  • Presentation may include market interpretation, attribution analysis, and trade opportunity identification.

4. Additional Team Interviews

  • Additional rounds may be conducted with researchers, traders, engineers, or partners as necessary.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

Position: Podcast Video Editor

Number of hours: Project Based

Schedule: Flexible

About the Project

We're producing a high-quality, YouTube-first legal podcast and looking for a video editor who lives and breathes the Diary of a CEO style — clean cuts, dynamic pacing, strong visual storytelling, and a polished finish that keeps viewers watching. Think tight pacing, purposeful B-roll use, graphic overlays where appropriate, and an eye for social-worthy moments.

What You'll Do

  • Sync and assemble multi-camera footage into a compelling full-length episode (typically 60–90 minutes).

  • Clean and balance dialogue audio.

  • Trim dead air and tighten pacing without losing the natural flow of conversation.

  • Label and rough-cut 4–6 strong social clip moments within the timeline.

  • Build rough timelines for vertical social cutdowns (final polish handled internally).

  • Maintain an organized Premiere project structure that our internal team can easily pick up for final polish, packaging, and distribution.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrable experience editing long-form podcast content in a Diary of a CEO, Huberman Lab, or similar premium YouTube podcast style. (must requirement sample)

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro; experience with Autopod for multi-cam sync is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of dialogue cleanup and audio balancing.

  • Comfortable working within an established workflow and receiving structured, direct feedback.

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.

  • Adequate local storage capacity to manage large 4K media files.

The Engagement

We're starting with a single episode edit — estimated 2–4 hours for an experienced editor. Strong candidates will be considered for ongoing work as the show grows. This is a great opportunity to build a long-term creative partnership from the ground up.

How to Apply?

To apply, please carefully follow the instructions below.

  1. Email Subject Line Format

Use this exact format in your email subject line:

RBS Hire Me! Podcast Video Editor_Full Name_Country

Then send to:

Example:
RBS Hire Me! Podcast Video Editor_Juan Cox_United States

  1. Required Documents & Materials

Please attach and include the following in your email:

  1. Updated CV / Resume

    • Clearly list your previous roles.

    • Include your key responsibilities for each position.

    • Your hourly rate

  2. Updated Portfolio

    • Provide a direct link to your portfolio (Google Drive, personal website, etc.).

    • Ensure all links are accessible for viewing (no restricted access).

    • Include only your best and most relevant editing projects, especially podcast-related work.

  3. Cover Letter
    In your cover letter, briefly explain:

    • Your specific role in each project

    • The tools and software you used (e.g., editing software, plugins, workflow tools)

    • Your editing approach or creative process

  4. Sample Works

    • Please provide links to 2–3 examples of long-form podcast episodes you have edited.

Bonus! Include examples of short-form social media clips you created from longer podcast content.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Only applications that follow all the instructions above will be reviewed.

This is a remote position open to candidates worldwide. Initial engagement is for one episode; strong candidates may be considered for a long-term role.

jobs.excerpt: Big Ass who? We didn’t set out to start a fan company.
jobs.description:
Big Ass who?

We didn’t set out to start a fan company. We set out to solve a problem—workplace discomfort. (Sorry, HR, not your kind.) Facilities become furnaces during the summer, but businesses still expect peak performance and productivity. Without providing the basic human right of comfort, that’s just asinine. Seeing how overhead fans cooled California dairy cows begged a massive question for our founder. “Can a fan be made to revolutionize comfort for people?” he uttered. That’s when the HVLS Fan Company was born—with the first-ever patented high-volume, low-speed fan. But that name? BOR-ing. And customers knew it. We kept getting calls asking, “Are you the guys who make those big ass fans?” Hell yeah we are. And Big Ass Fans was born, complete with our own cheeky donkey mascot, Fanny. Today, we don’t just move air, we transform experiences. Big Ass Fans deliver comfort where it counts. We build every product like lives depend on it. Because, turns out, they do.
Our success is a result of the Big Ass Fans team’s innovation. Are you seeking an opportunity to work with extraordinary people with an entrepreneurial spirit? Do you have something that sets you apart from the rest? With a bias for action, we want you to #livelifebigass and bring the next great BAF product to market. From our customers to our employees, we are passionate about what we can accomplish together. The successful candidate will bring passion, energy, and a “get it done” mentality to BAF and the industrial business and contribute in a meaningful way to realize the company’s full potential in the market.

Opportunity

The Outside Sales Representative (OSR) plays a crucial role in making the world safer, healthier and more productive by ensuring our customers receive the best possible solutions tailored to their needs. Their in-person presence and dedication to customer satisfaction help build trust and long-lasting partnerships, driving the company’s success and growth. Picture this; you arrive at a customer’s facility, sporting BAF’s top swag, and get to provide a solution that provides comfort to their employees, increases their productivity, and their overall health - You are changing the quality of customers' lives! With a passion for making the world safer, healthier, and more productive, this role often requires extensive travel, averaging three days and two nights per week in hotels during busy periods. If you bring an energetic, positive attitude with a technical mindset who likes solving problems and developing lasting relationships, we want to hear from you! Applications are now being accepted for the position expected to begin on November 2, 2026.

Compensation Range

$70,000-$73,000 Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions

Anticipated Start Date:

November 2nd, 2026

What you'll do

  • Serve as the professional face of Big Ass Fans for all current and prospective customers.
  • Perform facility surveys and make customized product recommendations for each customer.
  • Submit all facility information and log all customer interactions in the CRM.
  • Maintain constant communication with customers, the inside sales team, and field services/installers, and management.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction through frequent post-purchase follow-ups and account nurturing.
  • Generate meetings and new opportunities with existing customers and leads.
  • Respond to inside sales requests for visits promptly.
  • Maintain a positive company image.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent training and experience
  • Proven outside sales experience (industrial sales is a bonus)
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships, internally and externally
  • Experience using a CRM (Salesforce preferred) - must be diligent in adding your notes from each visit
  • Experience using CAD is a plus but not required; Familiarity with engineering blueprints and building plans is a plus
  • Effective and efficient time management is a must; Demonstrate a strong follow-through and ability to self-manage multiple projects at once
  • Must be flexible and self-motivated with a strong work ethic
  • Maintain a professional appearance and positive attitude
  • Clean driving record
  • Willing to drive and maintain a BAF-branded company vehicle which may be a sedan, SUV or pickup truck
  • Job is remote and requires a lot of drive time; must be able to be in the car for 3-5+ hours at a time and often 20 hours in a week
  • Must be able to walk and stand continuously for up to 6 hours during large campus site visits, with periodic kneeling required for tasks such as floor-to-ceiling measurements
  • Willingness to make overnight trips frequently
  • Must reside in the designated sales territory

Think you have what it takes, but your background doesn’t perfectly align with this role? No sweat! If this position gets your fan spinning, we encourage you to apply and tell us how you’ll succeed with your unique skills in your application.

First 90 Days

Every Big Ass Fans employee works towards the company’s growth goals, and no goal is successful without a plan. When you kickstart your BAF journey with a strong 90-day plan, you’ll be set up for a great first day, week, month, quarter and beyond! Here’s a snapshot of the first 90 days as a BAF Outside Sales Representative:

Big Ass Fans will be hiring a cohort of new Outside Sales Representatives, expected to start on November 2nd, 2026, who will be onboarded together before they begin independent customer meetings to create and present custom fan solutions in January of 2027.

Days 1-30:

  • Meet your peers and stakeholders you’ll be working with on a daily basis.
  • Ensure a complete understanding of BAF’s products, software, and processes to perform your daily tasks.
  • Ride-alongs: Join Outside Sales professionals in what will be your local territory, and also travel to other teammates' territories to join their visits.
  • Continuous learning on topics such as fan science, fan solution design concepts, fan model details, installation scope of work, electrical panel identification, and control systems.
  • Ensure a complete understanding of BAF's products, software, and processes to perform your daily tasks.

Days 31-60:

  • Additional ride-along trips on the first and third weeks of December.
  • Join BAF's Sales Conference, located at our Headquarters in Lexington, KY from December 7th through 11th.
  • Holiday shutdown from December 24th through January 3rd.

Days 61-90+:

  • Begin conducting independent sales meetings.
  • continue learning BAF technical details relating to products, installation, and design principles.
  • Be able to create high-quality Speclab airflow models for any facility.
  • Primary metrics: Overall Sales & Proactively Generated Opportunities.
  • Provide accurate recommendations while minimizing installation change orders.

The Interview Process

  1. Video Screen:Show us yourcoolskills! This will be a one-way video screen that goes through several questionsfor you to answer, leaving you a certain amount of time to respond. First time doing one of these? Be yourself!Some say it helps to settle your nerves by picturing the camera in its underwear.

In this conversation, you’ll go through all of the in-depthdetails of the position, going over the day-to-day operations, and learn about the role’s KPIs.
  4. Assessment:You'll complete an online assessment to help us better understand your sales strengths and potential.
  5. In-Person interview:If you are in an area where one of our Outside Sales Reps or Supervisors are nearby, wemay be able to set up an in-person meeting with you for a more casual conversation and iron out any details orlingering questions you have of the position.

How do you live life Big Ass?

Wonder what it’s like to walk through our Headquarters, or what benefits and perks BAFers have? Click here to learn more!

Be a part of something BIG

You’re not just a member of the Big Ass Fans team; it’s BIGGER than us. We are a Madison Industries company, one of the world's leading publicly held industrial organizations. jobs.excerpt: Join the Rest RevolutionThe world is wired and tired.
jobs.description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity

As a Sleep Consultant, you are the voice of Hatch’s sleep support. You will connect with caregivers through sleep chat in the Hatch Baby app, offering warm, personalized guidance that helps them understand their child’s sleep, choose realistic next steps, and feel supported along the way. You balance developmental accuracy with genuine care, and you are passionate about helping others and meeting every caregiver with empathy, especially during some of the most tiring moments of parenthood. We are hiring for multiple part-time positions, 20 hours per week on set shifts, M-F 7am-11am PT or M-F 11am-3pm PT. These are hourly, part-time roles.

What You’ll Do

Provide expert, personalized sleep guidance

  • Apply your knowledge of infant and child sleep development to give accurate, age-appropriate guidance aligned with Hatch’s approved approaches and resources.
  • Follow safe sleep guidelines and Hatch sleep training guidelines at all times.
  • Ask purposeful questions to understand each family’s challenges, routines, goals, and circumstances, and adjust your recommendations as new information emerges.
  • Help families put recommendations into practice, set realistic expectations, and troubleshoot obstacles.
  • Guide caregivers to relevant Hatch Baby sleep features and content, and explain how they support their goals.
  • Recognize when a concern is outside the scope of sleep support, including medical questions, feeding, and urgent situations, and refer families to their pediatrician or escalate through the appropriate channel

Communicate clearly and with empathy

  • Write warm, concise responses suited to a chat conversation, leading with actionable next steps and explaining your reasoning.
  • Respond to caregiver stress with validation, patience, and respect.
  • Build confidence without judgment, pressure, or promises of specific sleep outcomes.
  • Review all conversation history and context before responding.
  • Document key details, recommendations, and next steps so another consultant can pick up the conversation seamlessly.
  • Follow shared Hatch standards, and address differing recommendations thoughtfully to maintain trust.
  • Manage your conversations efficiently while maintaining quality, and meet established response time and customer satisfaction expectations

Who You Are

  • Passionate about helping others. You care about caregivers and love helping a family feel confident and rested.
  • Empathetic. You build trust without judgment, even when a family is stressed or exhausted.
  • A strong writer. You communicate clearly, warmly, and concisely in writing.
  • Detail-oriented. You keep accurate documentation and notice the details that matter in each family’s story.
  • Experienced with sleep. You have experience with infant and child sleep development and safe-sleep practices.
  • Resourceful. You dig into the root of each family’s challenge and use every resource available. You know when to ask for help and you stay flexible and resilient through change.
  • A team player. You follow team policies and processes, and meet your deadlines. You lend a hand, share what you know, welcome feedback, and contribute to team goals and discussions.

Nice to Have

  • Background in pediatric sleep consulting

No pediatric sleep consulting experience? We still encourage you to apply, training is provided!

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work
  • We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
  • Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
  • We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
  • We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility

About Hatch

Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.

Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences

  • Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
  • Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
  • Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package

We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?

We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.

Hatch participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

About the Role

Abnormal was built to spot what everyone else misses. The same instinct should power how we run our business.

As Director, Revenue Systems & Analytics, you'll own the technology and the truth behind Abnormal's go-to-market engine. Reporting to Ted Noble, VP of GTM Operations, you'll lead the strategy, roadmap, and team behind our marketing, sales, and customer success tech stacks, and you'll build the executive-level analytics that show how the whole revenue machine actually performs, from first touch to renewal and expansion. This is a role for a restless builder: someone who sees a disconnected stack or a siloed dashboard as an invitation to redesign it, and who wants to help make Abnormal the #1 AI-native company, starting with how we go to market.

The scale is real and growing fast. Abnormal closed FY26 at roughly $380M in ARR, growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. As we expand from email security into a broader behavioral AI platform, the motions get more complex: more products, more buying journeys, more handoffs between Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success. Your systems and your numbers will be what keeps all of it connected, and what lets leadership see clearly where growth is coming from next.

What You Will Do

  • Own the GTM tech stack end to end. Lead strategy, architecture, and roadmap across the marketing, sales, and customer success technology ecosystems, treating them as one connected revenue platform rather than three separate toolsets.
  • Build a roadmap that drives growth. Align every system investment to company strategy and revenue goals, prioritizing ruthlessly based on impact to pipeline, conversion, retention, and expansion.
  • Lead with an AI-first approach. Define how AI and agentic workflows show up across the GTM stack, from automating manual work to surfacing insights reps and leaders can act on. Set the standard that AI accelerates decisions without sacrificing accuracy, auditability, or trust in the data.
  • Make revenue analytics the single source of truth. Lead the Revenue Analytics function and build and maintain executive-level dashboards that show true end-to-end performance across the full customer lifecycle, so leaders from the CEO down are working from the same numbers.
  • Break down silos. Design metrics, definitions, and reporting that cut across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, uniting every team around the shared goal of growth instead of functional scorecards.
  • Govern data like it matters. Partner closely with Data and Finance on data quality, governance, and metric definitions so GTM reporting reconciles cleanly and holds up in board and executive settings.
  • Manage the stack as a business. Own GTM software strategy, vendor relationships, budget, and renewals, consolidating where it makes sense and investing where it moves the needle.
  • Build and lead the team. Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of systems, data, and analytics professionals, including people leaders, and grow the next generation of leaders within GTM Operations.
  • Be a strategic partner to GTM leadership. Work hand in hand with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, IT, and Security leaders to translate business priorities into systems and insights, and bring a clear point of view on what the data says about where to go next.

Must Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in GTM systems, revenue operations, or revenue analytics at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, with at least 5 years leading teams.
  • Proven track record owning a multi-function GTM tech stack (marketing, sales, and customer success) and delivering a strategic roadmap tied to revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in Salesforce as the core system of record, plus hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse and BI platform for executive reporting.
  • Experience building executive and board-level dashboards that connect the full funnel, from pipeline generation through bookings, retention, and expansion.
  • Strong command of GTM metrics and definitions (pipeline, conversion, ARR, net and gross retention, forecast) and the credibility to defend them in front of senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing AI and automation into GTM systems and workflows, with sound judgment about where it helps and where it adds risk.
  • Experience managing software budgets, vendor negotiations, and stack rationalization.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership: the ability to align Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and IT around shared priorities and shared numbers.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with tools in our ecosystem, such as Marketo, Gainsight, Gong, Snowflake, Sigma, Workato, and Highspot.
  • Background in cybersecurity or another technical, enterprise-focused category.
  • Experience scaling GTM systems and analytics through a multi-product or platform expansion.

We offer smart grid solutions across multiple levels: intelligent connected devices, communications networks, data management, enterprise applications and analytics. Learn more at .

Come join us if you’re interested in being part of an entrepreneurial team, solving complex technical problems and delivering innovative solutions that will directly impact the electrification of everything and the decarbonization of our society.

We have operations throughout the United States and Canada with offices in Burnaby (British Columbia, Canada), Raleigh (North Carolina, USA), and Norwalk (Connecticut, USA).

This position offers a competitive salary plus variable compensation based on performance targets and business objectives. Tantalus also offers generous benefits, including medical, dental and vision plans, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts and paid time off.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Manager, Field Operations Support, the Technical Support Specialist is a member of the Customer Operations team and is responsible for assisting the team in deploying, operating, maintaining and troubleshooting for Tantalus customers. The Technical Support Specialist will be the primary technical interface between the Field Operations and Product Development departments in ensuring products in the field are maintained and functioning.

Location of Position:

This position will be based remotely within the U.S, preferably located in Central or Eastern States.

Specifically, the Technical Support Specialist will:

  • Troubleshoot and solve problems across the TUNet technology set, including embedded hardware and software, RF and IP communications networks, database, Linux back-end, web front-end, and service interfaces.
  • Upgrade and patch TUNet software on customer systems.
  • Configure and maintain billing exports.
  • Provide periodic support to supervise or monitor the introduction of new products in the field.
  • Review and prioritize open cases, escalating as required.
  • Collaborate to develop, establish, and improve processes and procedures related to Tantalus’ technical knowledge base, online community, and other documentation.

It shows in retention — the engineering team's average tenure runs about four years, with zero voluntary attrition.

About the role

We're hiring a Software Engineer to join a small, high-trust engineering team and take real ownership of the front-end product experience. This is a full-stack role that is heavily front-end weighted in practice — you'll spend most of your time in the UI layer, with occasional backend exposure. You'll be this team's first dedicated front-end hire reporting to the front-end lead, so there's a genuine opportunity to shape how the role and the front-end practice grow from here.

What you'll do

  • Own front-end features end to end — from UI/UX implementation through shipping — using JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and React (Vite as the build tool).
  • Work on outlying UI services that consume shared backend services and present data to users, ramping toward independently handling most non-architectural tickets (form changes, UX changes supporting new backend features) within your first few months.
  • Collaborate with a small backend-leaning engineering team (Java/Scala/C# exposure is a plus, not a requirement) to integrate front-end work with core product services.
  • Use AI development tools as a normal part of your workflow — the team actively encourages this — while being able to verify and stand behind your own understanding of what you ship.
  • 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with genuine depth in JavaScript/TypeScript and React; Vite experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable working with real autonomy: someone who can take direction, incorporate feedback quickly, and then run with a piece of work without needing close supervision.
  • Adaptable to a small-company pace and ambiguity — prior experience at a smaller, fast-moving company is a plus.
  • Genuine, thoughtful use of AI coding tools: able to use them productively while still catching and correcting their mistakes yourself.

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

What we're looking for

  • 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with genuine depth in JavaScript/TypeScript and React; Vite experience is a plus.

Role logistics

A take-home skills assessment (submitted via GitHub, Bitbucket, or a zip file; AI tool use is welcomed on this step, graded same-day), followed by a small number of conversational interviews with members of the engineering and leadership team, and a final in-person meeting before an offer is signed.

EP Wealth Advisors (EPWA) is a wealth management advisory firm with over $49.1 billion as of June 30, 2026, serving predominately high net worth individuals. EPWA fosters an inclusive environment that offers opportunities for our associates to learn, grow and enhance their skills to take on new challenges to progress in their professional careers.

Job Summary

    The Associate Director, Technology Support Services is a senior IT operations leader responsible for EP Wealth’s employee-facing technology support operating model.

    This role represents the evolution of the traditional Service Desk Manager into a stronger Technology Support Services leader. The Associate Director will own service desk performance, ticket quality, issue triage, escalation management, SLA and CSAT performance, knowledge base quality, support routing, onboarding and offboarding support workflows, physical asset management discipline, branch office support visibility, ITSM solution ownership, reporting and metrics, automation, and post–go-live hypercare for business and M&A transitions.

    The role is accountable for the support experience and operational effectiveness of employee-facing technology support, while partnering with platform, system, security, infrastructure, and application owners for deeper administration, engineering, integrations, roadmap execution, and escalations.

    With a focus on accountability, service quality, operational discipline, security, and proactive support, this leader will build a scalable and measurable support function that improves employee productivity, reduces friction, strengthens support standards, and enables EP Wealth’s continued growth.

Key Responsbilities

    Technology Support Services Leadership

    • Lead EP Wealth’s Technology Support Services function across service desk operations, ticket triage, escalation management, support quality, onboarding/offboarding support, asset coordination, branch support visibility, knowledge management, and support reporting.
    • Evolve the current service desk model into a proactive, accountable, metrics-driven support services function with clear ownership, scalable processes, consistent service standards, and measurable outcomes.
    • Own the employee-facing technology support model, including intake, routing, prioritization, escalation, communication standards, service recovery, and support experience.
    • Partner with platform, system, security, infrastructure, and application owners for deeper administration, engineering, integrations, root-cause remediation, and escalated technical resolution.
    • Assess current team structure, roles, skills, workload distribution, support tiers, escalation model, service ownership, and operating model maturity.
    • Recommend practical improvements to increase accountability, scalability, service quality, team effectiveness, and career development.
    • Build a culture of ownership, urgency, professionalism, security awareness, documentation, follow-through, and continuous improvement.

      • Service Desk Performance, Ticket Quality, and Support Experience

      • Lead service desk strategy, daily operating rhythms, queue health, ticket hygiene, escalation practices, service quality, staffing alignment, and performance management.
      • Define and manage support performance metrics such as first contact resolution, mean time to resolution, SLA attainment, backlog age, reopen rate, escalation rate, ticket aging, CSAT, employee effort, ticket deflection, knowledge utilization, and request fulfillment cycle time.
      • Establish expectations for ticket quality, categorization, prioritization, documentation, internal notes, resolution summaries, customer communication, and closure standards.
      • Improve issue triage, routing, escalation paths, queue ownership, and handoffs across Technology teams.
      • Use support data to identify recurring issues, training gaps, process breakdowns, knowledge gaps, service bottlenecks, and opportunities for automation or self-service.
      • Ensure high-quality support for employees across offices, remote work locations, and branch environments.

        • IT Service Management and ITSM Solution Ownership

        • Mature EP Wealth’s ITSM operating model using ITIL-aligned practices, including incident management, request fulfillment, change enablement, problem management, knowledge management, service catalog management, service level management, supplier management, reporting, and continual improvement.
        • Own EP Wealth’s ITSM solution as the core support operations platform, including design, administration, configuration, care and feeding, lifecycle management, enhancements, integrations, reporting, data quality, and user experience.
        • Design and maintain ITSM workflows, queues, forms, fields, categories, approval paths, notification rules, automation logic, dashboards, reports, permissions, service catalog items, request types, templates, and integration touchpoints.
        • Establish ITSM platform governance, including enhancement intake, prioritization, release planning, configuration standards, change control, testing, documentation, data hygiene, role-based access, and platform health reviews.
        • Ensure the ITSM solution remains scalable, secure, auditable, easy to use, and aligned to EP Wealth’s support operating model.

          • Knowledge Management, Self-Service, and Service Catalog

          • Own the technology support knowledge management strategy, including article quality, ownership, lifecycle, searchability, governance, and adoption.
          • Implement and mature Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) methodologies to ensure knowledge is created, reused, improved, and retired as part of the normal support workflow.
          • Establish KCS-aligned practices, including capturing knowledge in the workflow, structuring articles for reuse, improving content based on demand and feedback, linking articles to tickets, and using knowledge analytics to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
          • Ensure the knowledge base supports consistent troubleshooting, faster resolution, employee self-service, onboarding readiness, branch support, and M&A/post-go-live hypercare.
          • Establish knowledge quality standards, review cycles, article ownership, usage reporting, content health metrics, and improvement processes.
          • Own the support-facing service catalog, ensuring common requests are clearly defined, requestable, routed appropriately, measurable, and mapped to fulfillment workflows, SLAs, approvals, knowledge articles, and escalation paths.
          • Partner with platform and system owners to ensure support documentation accurately reflects current tools, services, known issues, troubleshooting steps, standard requests, and escalation procedures.

            • Onboarding, Offboarding, and Asset Management Discipline

            • Own employee technology onboarding and offboarding support workflows from an IT operations perspective in partnership with HR, Security, Facilities, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Endpoint Management, and business stakeholders.
            • Standardize onboarding support processes, manager communications, access request coordination, device readiness, software assignment, first-week support, and issue escalation.
            • Ensure offboarding support workflows are timely, secure, complete, and auditable, including device recovery coordination, license reclamation, access removal coordination, asset updates, and exception tracking.
            • Strengthen physical asset management discipline, including inventory accuracy, device assignment, device recovery, lifecycle coordination, warranty/repair coordination, loaner processes, and asset reporting.
            • Use asset and onboarding/offboarding data to identify process gaps, compliance risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for standardization.

              • Branch Office Support and Proactive Monitoring

              • Own the support services model for branch office technology visibility, issue tracking, escalation, and service follow-through.
              • Establish clear support processes for branch-impacting issues, including intake, prioritization, communication, escalation, trend tracking, and resolution ownership.
              • Develop a proactive branch support model supported by online/connected real-time dashboards, event monitoring, alerting, ticket correlation, and branch health visibility.
              • Partner with Network, Infrastructure, Security, Facilities, vendors, and local business contacts to improve branch support readiness, monitoring coverage, escalation quality, and response speed.
              • Develop reporting that provides visibility into branch support trends, recurring issues, service risks, aging tickets, unresolved blockers, and real-time operational health indicators.
              • Move branch support from reactive ticket handling toward proactive monitoring, communication, and operational follow-through.

                • Automation, AI, and Digital Support Channels

                • Lead adoption of automation and AI-enabled support capabilities where appropriate, including virtual agents, workflow automation, intelligent routing, ticket summarization, suggested knowledge, sentiment detection, automated fulfillment, and guided self-service.
                • Partner with Security, Architecture, Legal/Compliance, Data Governance, HR, and business stakeholders to ensure AI-enabled support capabilities are safe, auditable, privacy-aware, permission-aware, and appropriate for a regulated financial services environment.
                • Establish operating controls for AI-assisted support, including escalation rules, access controls, data handling standards, human-in-the-loop safeguards, accuracy review, and performance measurement.
                • Use automation to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, accelerate resolution, and increase support quality without weakening accountability.

                  • M&A Integration, Business Transitions, and Hypercare

                  • Lead the Technology Support Services workstream for M&A integrations and business transitions, ensuring employees are successfully supported through technology change with minimal disruption.
                  • Coordinate support readiness for acquired employees, including support channels, devices, accounts, knowledge resources, asset inventory, software access, communications, issue triage, and training support.
                  • Lead post–go-live hypercare, including elevated support coverage, issue triage, escalation management, business communications, trend analysis, rapid remediation, support metrics, and transition to steady-state support.
                  • Conduct post-hypercare reviews to identify lessons learned, recurring issues, process gaps, and improvements for future integrations.

                    • Vendor, Budget, Security, and Continual Improvement

                    • Manage support operations vendors, service desk tooling, ITSM partners, knowledge platforms, asset lifecycle partners, endpoint service providers, and related service providers.
                    • Support budget planning, renewals, cost optimization, license rationalization, vendor performance reviews, service improvement plans, and business case development.
                    • Embed a security-first mindset across support operations, including identity verification, least-privilege access, endpoint hygiene, phishing response, secure support practices, privileged request handling, and audit-ready documentation.
                    • Partner with Security to ensure support processes align with security controls, identity verification expectations, endpoint compliance needs, and regulated operating requirements.
                    • Develop dashboards, executive reports, service reviews, trend analysis, and continual improvement roadmaps that shift the organization from reactive support to proactive service ownership.
                    • Operate as a trusted partner to Technology leadership, Security, HR, Product, Core Platforms, Business Solutions, Finance, Legal/Compliance, vendors, and business stakeholders.

Qualifications

    Required

    • 3+ years of people leadership experience managing service desk, ITSM, endpoint support, enterprise support, or employee-facing technology support teams.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Application Security
jobs.excerpt: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

MetaMask is a self-custody wallet that does not hold users’ private keys. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, meaning a vulnerability in the product or its software delivery chain can lead directly to financial losses for users. As a result, MetaMask attracts sustained attention from financially motivated attackers and sophisticated supply chain actors.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead application security across the MetaMask extension, mobile app, Snaps, backend services, DeFi primitives, stablecoins, and supporting smart contracts.

The role covers architecture, code, dependencies, build and release controls, security testing, and vulnerability disclosure. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and operating model, lead a small senior team, and remain directly involved in code review and threat modelling.

You will report to the Head of Security and work closely with MetaMask Engineering leadership to ensure security risks are understood, owned, and addressed.

Responsibilities

Leadership and planning

  • Lead and develop the Application Security team, including hiring, performance management and career development, while remaining directly involved in technical work.
  • Set the Application Security strategy, annual goals and quarterly OKRs in line with company objectives and the approved Target Operating Model. Define and track KPIs to measure performance and progress.
  • Report AppSec progress, coverage, remediation performance and material gaps to Security leadership and contribute to Risk Committee reporting.

Secure design and delivery

  • Define security review requirements across development and release, assess whether they are met and escalate unresolved risks.
  • Lead threat modelling and security design reviews across clients, APIs and backend services, including authentication, key management, signing and delegated actions. Assess trust boundaries across the full system and participate in architecture and RFC reviews.
  • Define software supply chain security requirements and work with engineering teams to implement and validate controls for dependencies, builds, artefacts and publishing.
  • Lead security code reviews across MetaMask applications and smart contracts, working with engineers and relevant specialists to address findings.
  • Define and evolve the secure development lifecycle to incorporate AI agents, including their access, actions and human review requirements. Set security standards for AI development tools, generated code and AI components in products.
  • Integrate security testing into development and delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency scanning, secrets detection and AI scanning. Evaluate tools and validate their findings.
  • Help engineers prevent recurring vulnerabilities through secure coding guidance, reusable libraries, training and the security champions programme.

Vulnerability management and external testing

  • Own application vulnerability assessment, triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking within the organisation’s vulnerability management framework. Correlate findings across clients, services and supporting infrastructure with the relevant owners to assess combined impact. Ensure findings have clear owners and deadlines, verify fixes and escalate overdue risks.
  • Set the scope and proposed investment for bug bounty, penetration testing and AI security scanning based on risk and results. Manage external providers, researcher relationships, rewards and payouts, and coordinate vulnerability disclosure.

Assurance and incident support

  • Provide evidence of application security controls for audits and assurance reviews, and support customer and partner due diligence.
  • Provide application security expertise during incidents, including vulnerability analysis and remediation support.

Qualifications

Required:

  • At least eight years in application security or software engineering with a security focus, including two years leading people.
  • Strong practical code review skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or Solidity across browser extensions, mobile applications and backend services, with the ability to identify vulnerabilities and work with engineers to fix them.
  • Proven experience securing applications across clients and backend services, including distributed authentication, authorisation and key management.
  • Experience building or substantially improving an AppSec programme, including security reviews, automated testing, AI scanning, vulnerability management and developer support, with sound judgement on where AI adds value and how to validate its findings.
  • Practical experience securing software supply chains, including dependency policies, software composition analysis, npm, artefact integrity and CI/CD.
  • Experience running bug bounty and penetration testing programmes, including selecting and managing external providers.
  • Working knowledge of EVM smart contract security, including common vulnerabilities, review methods, upgrade and admin controls, and assessing external audits.
  • A record of delivering security improvements through engineering teams outside your reporting line.
  • Clear written communication, from actionable threat models to concise summaries of risk for executives.

Preferred:

  • Offensive security qualifications such as OSCP, OSWE or OSWA, or a proven record in bug bounty programmes or CTF competitions.
  • Experience securing browser extensions or mobile applications.
  • Experience securing development workflows that use AI, or AI components in production applications.
  • Experience in crypto, Web3 or another sector facing sustained attacks, such as fintech, payments or infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of or a strong interest in applied cryptography.
  • Familiarity with attacks by state actors against software companies, particularly DPRK supply chain and social engineering campaigns.
  • Experience providing evidence of secure development controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Role Summary

As a Technical Community Support with SmartSimple’s Essential Support team at Foundant, you'll be the voice of customer support and a critical link between our clients and internal teams. You’ll provide prompt, professional, and knowledgeable technical support to help mission-driven organizations succeed with our software. This role combines troubleshooting expertise with a passion for customer success, operating as a technical problem-solver and customer advocate who helps organizations achieve their missions more efficiently and effectively.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

WhatYou’llDo:

  • Respond to and triage inbound support tickets, applying initial diagnosis and prioritization based on severity and SLA.
  • Troubleshoot common SmartSimple configuration, workflow, and reporting issues, resolving independently where possible.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Subject Matter Experts with clear documentation of steps already taken.
  • Maintain accurate, timely ticket notes and status updates in the ticketing system (powered by Zendesk) to support reporting on KPIs and knowledge continuity.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with all levels of client interaction to ensure proactive, solution-oriented problem identification and resolution.
  • Test fixes provided by the Engineering team and incorporate them into client systems.
  • Advocate new platform features and assist clients in adopting these through upgrades, configuration changes, or training. Provide instruction and documentation to ensure the technical success of these initiatives.  
  • Facilitate relationships across client success, internal teams, and departments to strengthen partnerships.
  • Contributor to continuous process improvement within and between all areas of Support.
  • Participate in team huddles, training sessions, knowledge-sharing activities and process improvement discussions.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for ticket volume, response time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Some travel may be required (estimated less than 10%).
  • Other duties as assigned.

WhatYou’llNeed:

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Sciences, Mathematics (STEM) field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, or SaaS support role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Comfortable learning new software platforms quickly; prior exposure to SaaS, CRM, or grants management tools is a plus.
  • Solid troubleshooting instincts - able to isolate a problem, test hypotheses, and document findings.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing a queue of concurrent tickets.
  • Demonstrable success in thinking strategically, executing tactically, while providing consistent and high levels of client satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable working in a metric-driven environment.

Required Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of cloud and SaaS terminology.
  • Fundamental knowledge of databases and SQL - able to read basic queries, understand table relationships, and assist with simple data troubleshooting.
  • Field data storage concepts - understanding of data types, field mappings, and how data is stored and retrieved in database systems.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge - able to read and understand HTML/CSS code, troubleshoot formatting issues.
  • JavaScript fundamentals - able to recognize JavaScript syntax, understand basic functions and logic, and troubleshoot workflow automations.
  • Workflow automation concepts - understanding of conditional logic, triggers, actions, and how automated workflows function in SaaS.
  • Integration protocols and SSO (Single Sign-On) - familiarity with how external systems connect via integrations, including SMTP, SFTP, API connections, and authentication methods.

Preferred qualifications

  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.

jobs.description:
Overnight Digital Health Clinician – Registered Nurse

Work from Home | Australia-Wide | Dedicated Overnight Shifts | Night-Shift Uplift

What if your next night shift started at home?

Right now, a dedicated team of Registered Nurses are working overnight from home, providing clinical assessment, triage and health advice to people across Australia.

It’s a different way to use your nursing experience. You’ll assess and support people across a broad range of health concerns, using your clinical experience to determine what care they need and how urgently they need it. One call might involve reassuring a concerned parent, while the next could require you to identify clinical deterioration, assess risk or determine that urgent medical care is needed.

If overnight hours suit you, this is an opportunity to continue using your clinical skills and judgement in a role that offers the benefits of working from home, while making a meaningful difference to people across Australia.

Your experience and clinical judgement will be at the heart of what you do.

What You'll Do

As a Digital Health Clinician, you'll use your nursing experience, assessment skills and clinical judgement to:

  • Conduct telephone-based clinical assessments and triage
  • Provide evidence-based health advice across adult and paediatric presentations
  • Assess clinical risk and recognise when escalation is required
  • Support acute, sub-acute and mental health presentations
  • Recommend appropriate care pathways
  • Refer callers to GPs, Urgent Care Clinics, Virtual Emergency Departments and other appropriate health services

Work From Home — Without Working Alone

Working remotely doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll be part of a connected clinical team, with experienced Clinical Leads available throughout your shift for support, guidance and a second clinical perspective when you need it.

As one of our clinicians puts it:

“You are alone, but you are not. We have a really engaging team on Microsoft Teams and the Clinical Leads are incredibly supportive, they will guide you when you need it.”

It's also a role where experienced nurses continue to learn. Every shift brings different presentations, conversations and opportunities to strengthen your assessment skills and clinical decision-making.

“I'm constantly learning in this role, every shift builds my confidence and clinical judgement.”

Why Work With Us?

  • Work from home anywhere in Australia
  • No commute to or from your overnight shift
  • Dedicated overnight shift with uplift for qualifying hours
  • Continue using your clinical assessment, critical-thinking and decision-making skills
  • Make a meaningful difference to patients across Australia
  • Be part of a connected and supportive remote clinical team
  • Comprehensive paid training to support your transition into digital healthcare

Hours & Key Details

  • Full-time and part-time opportunities
  • Minimum 32 hours per fortnight
  • Minimum 6-hour shifts
  • Overnight hours are between 9:00 pm and 6:00 am AEST, with a night-shift uplift applying to all hours worked within this window
  • Fixed shifts within the 9:00 pm–6:00 am overnight window may be negotiable
  • Initial contract through to 30 June 2027

About You

You're an experienced Registered Nurse with strong clinical judgement who is comfortable assessing risk, making clinical decisions and communicating with people who may be anxious, uncertain or unsure what to do next.

You'll bring experience in acute care, emergency nursing, critical care or complex primary healthcare and be ready to apply those skills in a digital environment.

Essential requirements:

  • Current unrestricted AHPRA registration
  • Minimum four years' post-graduate RN experience in the required clinical areas, gained within the last five years
  • Strong clinical assessment, critical-thinking and communication skills
  • Confidence using digital systems and technology
  • Reside and work within Australia

Experience across mental health, adult and paediatric presentations or previous telehealth experience is highly regarded.

Paid Training

As a Digital Health Clinician, you’ll need to be confident working with technology and navigating multiple digital systems as part of your everyday practice.

We'll provide comprehensive paid training before you begin working independently. You'll have the opportunity to become familiar with our systems, clinical pathways and the skills involved in telephone-based assessment and triage.

Please note: Availability to attend two weeks of full-time Monday–Friday training is mandatory.

Ready for a Different Kind of Night Shift?

If overnight hours work for you and you’re looking for a different way to use your nursing experience, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a supportive team of experienced nurses, work from home, and use your clinical skills to make a meaningful difference to people across Australia.

Apply now to join our overnight Digital Health team.
