jobs.title: Konsulentradiolog Neuro
jobs.excerpt: MULIGHEDENTelemedicine Clinic (TMC) var banebrydende for teleradiologistjenester i Europa, da firmaet blev grundlagt i 2002 og er siden blevet en vital partner for mere end 120 radiologiske afdelinger i Storbritannien, Sverige, Danmark og Norge.
jobs.description:
MULIGHEDEN

Telemedicine Clinic (TMC) var banebrydende for teleradiologistjenester i Europa, da firmaet blev grundlagt i 2002 og er siden blevet en vital partner for mere end 120 radiologiske afdelinger i Storbritannien, Sverige, Danmark og Norge. I november 2017 blev TMC en del af Unilabs, en førende europæisk udbyder af kliniske laboratorietests og medicinsk diagnostik. A.P. Møller ejer Unilabs.

Flere og flere europæiske hospitaler har indset fordelene ved at anvende TMC til beskrivelse af deres undersøgelser og TMC har altid været i vækst. I år vil vores team på mere end 350 højt specialiserede radiologer beskrive tæt på 1 million skanninger og røntgenundersøgelser, og vores arbejde har en betydelig positiv indvirkning på livet for patienter og hospitalspersonale. Udover vores teleradiologitjenester består TMC også af TMC Academy, der tilbyder uddannelse og kurser til radiologer over hele verden. TMC har også en stærk IT-infrastruktur og softwareudviklingsafdeling.

I mange år har vi hjulpet hospitaler med at få kvalitetsdiagnostik inden for radiologien. Det unikke ved TMC er blandt andet vores kultur. Mange siger, at TMC minder om en blomstrende opstartsvirksomhed, og de er overraskede over, hvor venlige og omsorgsfulde vi er, når vi har med hinanden og vores forretningspartnere at gøre

I øjeblikket er vi på udkig efter radiologer på deltid eller fuldtid, der er kvalificerede til at arbejde i Danmark med speciale i neuroradiologi. Formålet med arbejdet er at levere radiologiske beskrivelser af høj kvalitet til vores samarbejdssygehuse, -klinikker og deres patienter.

Vi tilbyder fuld fleksibilitet med hensyn til din placering. Du kan vælge at arbejde hjemmefra, flytte til en ny destination efter eget valg eller arbejde i vores hovedkvarter i Barcelona.

Hvis du kan besvare følgende spørgsmål med et entydigt "ja", er det meget sandsynligt, at du vil få glæde af at arbejde sammen med os, og du bør læse denne annonce til ende.

  • Ønsker du at arbejde hjemmefra med fuld fleksibilitet i forhold til din tidsplan?
  • Vil du generere en attraktiv ekstraindkomst?
  • Vil du specialisere dig yderligere og udvikle dig til ekspert inden for et særligt felt?
  • Ønsker du at få glæde af hidtil ukendte produktivitetsniveauer ved at arbejde med den bedste tekniske infrastruktur?
  • Ønsker du at blive en del af et stort internationalt netværk af meget erfarne radiologer?

HVAD VI FORVENTER FRA DIG

Vi kræver, at kandidater opfylder følgende krav, så vi kan levere en service af højeste kvalitet til vores patienter:

  • Være læge med en specialistgrad i diagnostisk radiologi
  • Have arbejdet i mindst 2 år som radiolog, ideelt med en vis grad af specialisering inden for neuro-området
  • Være registreret som radiolog hos de danske myndigheder (eller kan få en sådan registrering)
  • Kunne rapportere på dansk
  • Beherske engelsk (da dette er vores arbejdssprog)
  • Være erfaren computerbruger
  • Have en proaktiv tankegang, være interesseret i at finde løsninger, håndtere stress, være fleksibel og organiseret
  • Være god til kommunikation
  • Kunne forpligte dig til at rapportere mindst 10-12 timer om ugen.

HVAD DU KAN FORVENTE FRA OS

Vi lover at gøre alt for at din tid hos TMC bliver professionelt stimulerende, tilfredsstillende og en behagelig oplevelse. Dette er hvad du kan forvente af os:

  • En attraktiv ekstraindkomst. Du vil tjene en attraktiv ekstraindkomst, der måske giver dig mulighed for at købe længe ønskede goder, forkæle din familie med en særlig ferie eller spare op til dit drømmehus.
  • Mere tid til de vigtige ting i livet. TMC giver dig mulighed for at genvinde værdifuld tid. Du kan arbejde hjemmefra med fuld fleksibilitet i forhold til din tidsplan. Du kan endda overveje at reducere din arbejdstid på hospitalet, bruge mindre tid på daglig pendlen og i stedet afsætte mere kvalitetstid til familie, venner og hobbyer.
  • En mulighed for at specialisere sig. Som radiolog på deltid eller fuldtid arbejder du i den subspecialiserede neuro-sektion hos TMC. Dette giver dig mulighed for at specialisere dig i modaliteter, organer eller sygdomstyper af interesse og du kan udvikle ekspertviden. Du vil også drage fordel af de omfattende videndelingsaktiviteter i vores team på omkring 350 seniorspecialister.
  • Forbliv aktiv. Hvis du er pensioneret, er en periode med TMC i Australien eller New Zealand også en vidunderlig mulighed for at holde forbindelsen med det erhverv, du elsker.
  • Sindsro. Vi er overbeviste om, at du vil blive imponeret over TMC’s kvalitetsstandarder. Streng klinisk styring og interne/eksterne revisioner giver os mulighed for at opnå en rapporteringskvalitet, der sætter nye standarder inden for europæiske sundhedssystemer. I årenes løb har disse høje kvalitetsstandarder skabt stor respekt for vores arbejde inden for det skandinaviske og europæiske radiologimiljø. At have arbejdet med TMC betragtes som en berigelse af en radiologs karriere.

For at indsende din ansøgning skal du klikke på knappen "Ansøg" nederst på denne side.

jobs.excerpt: Technical Lead Power Systems & Grid StabilityRemote USAAre you ready to play a pivotal role in tackling some of the most complex challenges in modern power systems, from low inertia and weak grids to oscillations and wide-area stability and directly support the global transition to Net Zero?
jobs.description:
Technical Lead Power Systems & Grid Stability

Remote USA

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in tackling some of the most complex challenges in modern power systems, from low inertia and weak grids to oscillations and wide-area stability and directly support the global transition to Net Zero?

If you are a technically accomplished, commercially astute professional with deep expertise in power system dynamics and stability analysis, this opportunity could be the next step in your career.

The Company

Our client is a global energy technology innovator, enabling grid operators and utilities to accelerate renewable integration and unlock the pathway to a low-carbon future. Their solutions are trusted worldwide to address the operational challenges of modern grids, from real-time analytics to dynamic stability and control.

The Role: Technical Lead Power Systems & Grid Stability

As our client expands across North America, we are seeking a Technical Lead to join their growing team of power systems specialists. This role combines in-depth technical expertise with customer-facing engagement, working closely with utilities, ISOs/TSOs, and developers to address complex challenges in renewable energy integration and stability.

You will collaborate with product, engineering and sales teams to translate technical challenges into solutions, helping to close deals and shape the future of the grid. Success in this role requires the ability to engage customers on technical pain points such as oscillations, reduced system strength, and low inertia and position advanced solutions like WAMS/PMU-based analytics, dynamic simulation, and grid stability tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Engagement & Solution Advocacy: Engage with customers to identify stability-related challenges and advise on technical solutions for low inertia, oscillations, and weak grid conditions.
  • Technical Presentations & Demonstrations: Deliver clear, impactful presentations on advanced power system analytics and stability solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Dynamic Modelling & Analysis: Apply your expertise in EMT/RMS simulations (PSCAD, PSS®E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, RTDS) to validate solutions and provide technical assurance.
  • PMU/WAMS Analytics: Demonstrate how wide-area monitoring systems and synchrophasor data can be leveraged for oscillation detection, situational awareness, and control.
  • Commercial Support: Work with sales and product teams to build business cases, support bids, and develop technical content that highlights commercial and technical value.
  • Industry Representation: Represent the business at key industry forums, positioning the client as a leader in stability and control for inverter-dominated systems.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a technical bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring product roadmaps reflect emerging system challenges and opportunities.

Experience

  • Education: Bachelors or Masters in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or related field.
  • Specialist Expertise: Proven experience in power system dynamics and stability, particularly with challenges such as oscillations, inter-area modes, low system strength, and reduced inertia.
  • Simulation Tools: Proficiency in PSSE, PSCAD, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, RTDS and related EMT/RMS tools for dynamic and transient analysis.
  • PMU/WAMS Knowledge: Hands-on experience with synchrophasor data, wide-area monitoring, or oscillation detection is highly desirable.
  • Smart Grid & Inverter-Based Resources: Understanding of DERMS, ADMS, EMS, and renewable integration challenges in TSO/DSO environments.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to clearly communicate complex technical topics to executives and engineers alike.
  • Commercial Awareness: Experience supporting sales teams or customer engagements where technical expertise was key to winning business.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive base salary (DOE & qualifications)
  • Annual performance-related bonus
  • 401k Scheme
  • Medical cover
  • Enhanced holiday allowance
  • Training budget for professional development
  • Collaborative working environment
  • Charity days
  • Home working allowance

Next Steps

Please apply with your most up-to-date CV, and a member of our team will be in touch. Alternatively, contact Daniel Salway at CleanTech Talent for a confidential discussion.

CleanTech Talent are acting as an employment agency for this position.

jobs.excerpt: Dein Team:Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen, ziehen Menschen an, die etwas bewegen wollen.
jobs.description:
Dein Team:

Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen, ziehen Menschen an, die etwas bewegen wollen. Bei der fino data services arbeitest du mit Menschen, die neugierig sind, schnell denken und Dinge gerne selbst in die Hand nehmen. Die sich festbeißen, wenn etwas spannend wird, ihre Ideen laut aussprechen und nicht beim ersten Lösungsansatz aufhören. Hier treffen unterschiedliche Köpfe, Perspektiven und Stärken aufeinander. Wir diskutieren, challengen uns, lernen voneinander und bauen gemeinsam Lösungen, die wirklich etwas verändern. Du bekommst dabei nicht nur ein Team, sondern Rückenwind für deine Ideen, Raum zum Ausprobieren und Menschen, die mit dir aus einer guten Idee etwas besonderes machen. Wenn du Lust hast, mit Leuten zu arbeiten, die genauso viel vorhaben wie du: Willkommen bei der fino data services.

Die Rolle:

Du kennst die E-Rechnung aus der Kanzleipraxis: Mandanten fragen, was sie ab 2027 und 2028 tun müssen, Rechnungen kommen in den unterschiedlichsten Formaten an, und nicht jede Lösung hält, was sie verspricht. Genau dieses Wissen brauchen wir. Mit InvoiceRails betreiben wir einen zertifizierten Peppol Access Point, mit GetMyInvoices eine Plattform für über 14.000 Kunden und mit Belegbote ein kostenloses E-Rechnungs-Postfach. Bei uns bringst du deine steuerliche Erfahrung dort ein, wo Lösungen für tausende Unternehmen und Kanzleien entstehen – und wirst zur Stimme der fino data services zur E-Rechnung. In Peppol und die technischen Details arbeiten wir dich ein.

Aufgaben

Nach außen

  • Du erklärst Kunden, Steuerkanzleien und Partnern in Webinaren, was die E-Rechnungspflicht für sie bedeutet – verständlich und praxisnah.

  • Du bringst die Sicht der Kanzleien in Fachveranstaltungen und Arbeitskreise ein, z. B. im Verband elektronische Rechnung (VeR) und bei OpenPeppol.

  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung sprichst du auch auf Konferenzen wie dem E-Rechnungs-Gipfel.

  • Du lieferst Fachinhalte, mit denen unser Marketing in den Markt geht.

Produkte und Services

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass InvoiceRails, GetMyInvoices, Belegbote und Services wie der Billing Manager die gesetzlichen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Du behältst die Pflichten 2027 und 2028 im Blick und stellst sicher, dass keine Frist in einem Produkt oder Service verpasst wird.

  • Du übersetzt Vorschriften und Fragen aus der Praxis in klare Anforderungen, die unsere Entwicklungsteams umsetzen können.

  • Du treibst die Nutzung der E-Rechnung in unseren Produkten voran.

Regelwerk für Rechnungsquellen

  • Du baust das Regelwerk auf, das jeder Rechnungsquelle ihren Weg zuweist – nach dem Prinzip „Peppol zuerst“: Liefert ein Lieferant per Peppol, kommt die Rechnung nur noch darüber.

  • Du bringst das Regelwerk in GetMyInvoices produktiv.

  • Danach übernimmt unser Datenteam die Pflege, du sicherst die Qualität.

Deine Prioritäten sind klar: gesetzliche Fristen zuerst, dann Außenwirkung, dann Regelwerk.

Woran wir Erfolg messen: mehr Rechnungen per Peppol statt über Portale, keine verpasste gesetzliche Frist, ein produktiv genutztes Regelwerk und Sichtbarkeit, die Anfragen bringt. Die konkreten Zielwerte legen wir in deinen ersten 90 Tagen gemeinsam fest – ein Teil deiner Vergütung ist daran gekoppelt.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter (all genders) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, z. B. als Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter (all genders).

  • Praxis: Du hast Berufserfahrung in einer Steuerkanzlei oder im Rechnungswesen und kennst die Abläufe rund um Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen.

  • E-Rechnung: Du hast dich bereits mit der E-Rechnung beschäftigt (z. B. XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, umsatzsteuerliche Anforderungen) und willst tiefer einsteigen – auch in Peppol und die europäische Norm EN 16931.

  • Erklären: Du kannst komplexe steuerliche Themen verständlich erklären, z. B. aus Mandantengesprächen oder Schulungen. Webinare und Vorträge reizen dich – Routine auf der Bühne musst du noch nicht mitbringen.

  • Übersetzung: Du hast Lust, gemeinsam mit Entwicklern Produkte zu gestalten, und machst aus Vorschriften klare Anforderungen.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du setzt Prioritäten selbst, treibst Themen eigenständig voran und bringst sie zu Ende.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Gelegentliche Reisen zu Fachveranstaltungen und Arbeitskreisen sind für dich in Ordnung.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Plus: Erfahrung mit DATEV oder Belegverarbeitungs-Software.

Benefits

Was wir bieten:

Klare Verantwortlichkeiten und Unterstützung:

Bei uns weißt du genau, was von dir erwartet wird, und du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Fehler als wertvolle Lernchancen betrachtet werden.

Gemeinschaftliches Engagement für außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse:

Unser Team strebt leidenschaftlich nach Spitzenleistungen und sieht deinen Beitrag als unverzichtbar an. Gemeinsam erreichen wir Großartiges.

Individuelle Entwicklung und Selbstverantwortung:

Wir fördern Selbstmotivation und deine persönliche Verantwortung, um herausragende Leistungen zu erzielen.

Dynamisches Feedback für kontinuierliches Lernen:

Bei uns erhältst du direktes und zeitnahes Feedback, damit du schnell auf Veränderungen reagieren und dich kontinuierlich verbessern kannst.

Offene Kommunikation und persönliche Entwicklung:

Wir leben offene Kommunikation und unterstützen dich aktiv bei der Gestaltung deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Lösungsorientierung und Unternehmenserfolg im Fokus:

Unser Ziel ist es, Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die das Unternehmen voranbringen. Dein Engagement für diesen Erfolg wird bei uns hoch geschätzt.

Teamtage, Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern: Gemeinsame Events für Teamspirit und Freude am Arbeitsplatz

Corporate Benefits: Genieße verschiedene Vergünstigungen.

Hundefreundliche Arbeitsplätze: Bring deinen besten Freund mit.

Bikeleasing: Genieße die Vorteile eines Bikeleasings, umweltfreundlich und fit zur Arbeit.

Role: Senior Business Analyst- Commercial P&C/ MGA

Duration: Long Term

Location: United States- Remote

Experience: 8+ Years

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong Commercial P&C insurance and MGA experience to support implementation of Sure Commercial.

The ideal candidate should understand the complete MGA insurance lifecycle, including broker submissions, appetite/eligibility, underwriting, risk assessment, rating, quote, bind, policy issuance, endorsements, renewals and cancellations.

  • Gather and document business requirements from MGA stakeholders and underwriters.
  • Translate business requirements into Sure Commercial configuration, user stories, workflows and functional specifications.
  • Perform fit-gap analysis and define configuration vs. integration requirements.
  • Support commercial insurance product, underwriting, rating and policy transaction requirements.
  • Define broker submission and submission-to-bind workflows.
  • Support integrations with rating engines, carrier, broker, accounting and other downstream systems.
  • Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and business rules.
  • Support SIT, UAT, testing, defect analysis and business sign-off.
  • Facilitate client workshops and work closely with product owners, architects, developers and QA teams.

Must-Have

  • Strong understanding of the MGA business model and underwriting lifecycle.
  • Experience with MGAs, specialty insurers, program administrators or delegated underwriting organizations.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial P&C, underwriting, appetite, eligibility, rating, quote/bind and policy transactions.
  • Experience with at least one commercial insurance platform.
  • Commercial experience highly preferred.
  • Strong experience with user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and business rules.
  • Experience with implementation, configuration, SIT and UAT.
  • Strong client-facing communication and Agile/Scrum experience.

Preferred

  • MGA or specialty insurance implementation experience.
  • Experience with ISO/Verisk, RAS, external rating engines or insurance data services.
  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML, data mapping and integrations.
  • Exposure to JIRA, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Postman or SQL.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Vulnerability Management & Remediation: Lead the identification, tracking, prioritization, and remediation of infrastructure and application vulnerabilities. Maintain visibility into the vulnerability portfolio and drive findings through resolution within established remediation timelines.

Team Leadership & Workload Management: Lead and develop the vulnerability management engineering team. Establish priorities, balance workloads, coordinate assignments, and provide technical guidance to support timely and effective remediation.

Risk Management & Compliance: Drive remediation activities aligned with enterprise risk requirements, security policies, and BOD 26-04 obligations. Partner with application owners, vendor managers, and risk stakeholders to resolve vulnerabilities within required time frames.

Security Operations & Incident Response: Represent infrastructure vulnerability management during incident calls involving application vulnerabilities. Coordinate escalations, communicate remediation status, and collaborate with security teams to address emerging risks and operational concerns.

Vulnerability Intelligence & Threat Analysis: Monitor industry trends, emerging vulnerabilities, threat intelligence, and adversary techniques to assess potential organizational impact. Apply knowledge of common attack vectors, intrusion techniques, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework to support vulnerability prioritization and risk reduction.

Security Monitoring & Technical Analysis: Leverage vulnerability assessment tools, SIEM platforms, network traffic analysis, and security event correlation to investigate findings, validate remediation progress, and identify potential security gaps.

Risk Metrics & Executive Reporting: Develop, maintain, and quality-assure monthly vulnerability and risk metrics for management and executive stakeholders. Provide clear visibility into remediation progress, outstanding risks, compliance status, and opportunities for continued improvement.

Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps in vulnerability management processes, compliance controls, and operational workflows. Develop and implement improvements that strengthen remediation accountability, improve efficiency, and reduce recurring security issues.

Documentation & Knowledge Management: Create and maintain team processes, procedures, operational standards, and training documentation. Ensure vulnerability management practices are consistent, repeatable, and aligned with enterprise security objectives.

Training & Team Development: Support onboarding, training, and ongoing development of vulnerability management engineers. Promote knowledge sharing, technical consistency, and effective collaboration across cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with application engineering, infrastructure operations, security operations, vendor management, and risk teams to resolve technical and process-related challenges and maintain accurate vulnerability records in the system of record.

Operational Excellence & Technology Evolution: Evaluate emerging security tools, assessment methodologies, and industry practices to improve vulnerability detection, remediation workflows, and overall security program effectiveness.

What You Bring to the Team

  • The Security Leader: Demonstrated ability to lead vulnerability management engineers, coordinate remediation activities, balance team workloads, and drive accountability across technical teams.
  • The Vulnerability Management Expert: Hands-on experience with cybersecurity tools and technologies such as Qualys, Nessus, and Symantec, including vulnerability assessment, prioritization, tracking, and remediation.
  • The Risk Management Mindset: Understanding of enterprise risk management, vulnerability remediation requirements, security controls, and compliance frameworks, including BOD 26-04, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS ASV.
  • The Threat Intelligence Foundation: Knowledge of common attack vectors, adversary tactics and techniques, threat intelligence, security hardening, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • The Security Operations Toolkit: Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, including Splunk, security event correlation, monitoring programs, and investigation of security-related issues.
  • The Technical Troubleshooter: Ability to investigate complex security, network, system, and application issues; analyze network traffic and packets; and identify practical solutions to vulnerability and remediation challenges.
  • The Compliance and Reporting Partner: Experience maintaining vulnerability records, preparing risk metrics, supporting management reporting, and communicating remediation status and exposure to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • The Process Improvement Driver: Ability to identify operational gaps, develop actionable solutions, establish repeatable processes, and build roadmaps that align vulnerability management activities with broader cybersecurity operations goals.
  • The Collaborative Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing priorities, communicate technical findings, and drive remediation through resolution.
  • The Technical Foundation: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • The Operationally Ready Professional: Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work independently and collaboratively, and participate in after-hours and weekend on-call rotations as business needs require.

Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

  • Security Certifications: Industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, GIAC certifications, or GCIH.
  • Cloud Security & Risk Assessment: Experience with cloud enterprise security tools, risk assessment methodologies, security controls, and vulnerability management in SaaS or other cloud-based environments.
  • Security Proxy & Network Analysis: Experience with URL filtering, web proxy technologies, network troubleshooting, packet analysis, and network security controls.
  • Executive Reporting & Visualization: Demonstrated experience developing management presentations, executive dashboards, and operational reporting using tools such as PowerPoint and Visio.
  • Regulatory & Compliance Expertise: Familiarity with vulnerability remediation mandates, security compliance requirements, and enterprise risk reporting, particularly BOD 26-04
  • Operational Excellence: A track record of improving remediation timelines, reducing outstanding vulnerabilities, strengthening compliance, and delivering measurable reductions in security risk over time.

Why Join Us?

Meaningful Security Challenges: Help protect cloud-based Unified Communications services by reducing vulnerabilities and strengthening enterprise security.

Security Leadership & Impact: Lead a team of engineers and collaborate across application, infrastructure, and security organizations to drive measurable improvements in risk reduction.

Data-Driven Risk Management: Use vulnerability intelligence, security monitoring, and executive metrics to prioritize remediation and improve security decision-making.

Continuous Improvement: Shape vulnerability management processes, strengthen compliance practices, and implement solutions that improve operational efficiency and security outcomes.

Collaborative Cybersecurity Operations: Work with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges, improve remediation accountability, and advance cybersecurity operations.

A Culture of Operational Excellence: Help establish scalable, repeatable vulnerability management practices that support a more secure, resilient, and compliant cloud environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 6+ years of relevant IT or cybersecurity experience.
  • 5+ years of security experience with hands-on exposure to cybersecurity products such as Qualys, Symantec, or Nessus.

jobs.description:
Description

The Project Manager ensures the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical research projects. The Project Manager I must ensure compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements. These tasks are done under close supervision by Senior Project Manager/Program Director and/or Associate Director, Project Management

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • We can count on you to deliver results while using a disciplined approach to project management
  • You are looking for the next career step to prepare you to become a project manager.
  • You are knowledgeable about clinical research projects and looking to continue learning.
  • Working in an organization that is driven by science and innovation and completing meaningful work is important to you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • May serve as primary contact for the Sponsor, vendors and internal team throughout the study.
  • Coordinates tasks and deadlines between the different departments involved in the project.
  • Oversees project coordinators, SSU team members, RDA and RAC resources to ensure correct prioritization of site activation activities amongst team members
  • Interacts with vendor management to ensure vendor supplies and services are coordinated for with site activation timelines
  • Escalates to project manager II when site activation timelines are at risk or cannot be maintained.
  • Assists with managing the needs and expectations of the Sponsor and other internal and external project stakeholders.
  • Assists with ensuring all team members are adequately trained on the project.
  • May plan the activities and resources (e.g. internal and external resources, equipment, etc.) required for the project.
  • Manages the quality of assigned work and deliverables
  • Assists with providing project status updates to external and internal stakeholders
  • Ensures assigned tasks are completed in compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements.
  • Reconciles study trackers
  • Assists with analyzing discrepancies between planned and actual results and participates in the development and implementation of corrective actions to be taken as needed.
  • Assists with enforcing effective change control and risk management throughout the project.
  • Reviews and may assist in the drafting of project operational plans, processes, and manuals as applicable (e.g., project management plan, monitoring plan, etc.).
  • Assists with ensuring that study specific documents and project deliverables (e.g., protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report, etc.) meet applicable country requirements.
  • Oversee activities related to sites selection (feasibility questionnaires, sites selection, planning of site qualification visits)
  • Monitors patient recruitment, subject status, and follows up with sites on recruitment strategy plan.
  • Participates in the planning and conduct of Investigator’s Meeting.
  • In collaboration with the Regulatory Affairs group, may oversee activities related to central ethics and regulatory submissions.
  • Ensures collection of required essential documents from the sites prior to study initiation and maintains of currency of site level documentation throughout the study.
  • May assist the project manager II with quality reviews and or audits of the Trial Master File (TMF) to ensure inspection readiness.
  • May support clinical monitoring activities, such as CRA training, visit report review, site letters, and escalated site issues
  • May track site qualification, initiation, routine and close-out visits, project-specific training, monitoring visit reports and follow-up letters, compliance with monitoring plan, escalation of site-related issues.
  • Maintains the project specific training matrix and confirms project team members are fully training per the study matrix prior to team members performing study tasks
  • Supports the sites and ensures that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).
  • In collaboration with the Data Management group, may ensure that the CRF complies with the protocol and Sponsor requirements and ensures queries resolution and data review process follow the study timelines until database lock.
  • May provide technical, therapeutic and project management expertise in training and process improvement efforts for the department.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research

Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in a similar role, including activities related to management of clinical studies in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and/or CRO industry
  • At least 2 years experience coordinating activities related clinical trial management

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, FDA and Canadian regulations
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English, French is an asset
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors
  • Good problem-solving abilities
  • Good organizational skills
  • Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines
  • Experience managing small to medium projects using a disciplined approach to project management
  • Core Project Management competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and deliver resource-based project plans
  • Excellent people management skills; experience working with and managing teams in a matrix environment

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in EU.

jobs.excerpt: About Sprintlaw (UK) Ltd Sprintlaw is a fast-growing legal services company on a mission to change the way legal services are delivered to startups and small businesses.
jobs.description:
About Sprintlaw (UK) Ltd

Sprintlaw is a fast-growing legal services company on a mission to change the way legal services are delivered to startups and small businesses.

We started in Australia in 2017 and have since grown into an international business, expanding into the UK and helping tens of thousands of startups and small businesses with their legal needs.

Now, we’re coming to Arizona.

We’ve built Sprintlaw around making legal services simpler, more accessible and more affordable. We use technology, fixed-fee pricing and streamlined processes to give small businesses a better legal experience.

Our clients range from early-stage founders and local businesses through to fast-growing technology companies. We help them with the legal work businesses regularly need, including company formation, corporate matters, commercial contracts, intellectual property, employment, fundraising, privacy and online terms.

We run Sprintlaw more like a technology startup than a traditional law firm, with customer experience, creativity and finding better ways of doing things at the core of how we operate.

You can find out more about Sprintlaw here:

Sprintlaw in Arizona

Arizona is the next chapter for Sprintlaw.

We’ve chosen Arizona because its approach to Alternative Business Structures closely aligns with what we’ve been building internationally for years: using technology, new business models and great lawyers to make legal services more accessible to businesses.

We’re currently seeking approval from the Arizona Supreme Court to operate as an Alternative Business Structure in Arizona. We don’t currently operate as a law firm in Arizona and won’t provide legal services through the proposed ABS unless and until the relevant approval has been granted.

We’re now starting to build our team in Arizona in anticipation of approval, and we’re looking for a commercial lawyer who wants to join us at an early stage.

As one of our first lawyers in Arizona, you’ll have the opportunity to get involved in how we set up and develop our legal services, processes and ways of working as the team grows.

The Role

We’re looking for an Arizona-qualified lawyer with around 2–4 years of corporate and commercial experience to join our legal team.

Following ABS approval and commencement of our Arizona legal-services operation, the role will involve working directly with startups and small businesses across a broad range of corporate and commercial work, including drafting and reviewing contracts, general corporate matters, startup fundraising, technology agreements, privacy and employment.

You’ll be responsible for managing your own projects and clients, with support from our Compliance Attorney where needed. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable handling standard corporate and commercial work independently, while knowing when to raise more complex or unfamiliar issues with the team.

Prior to ABS approval, the role will be limited to permitted preparatory, operational and other non-client legal-services activities as we prepare for launch.

This is a remote role and you can be based anywhere in Arizona. You’ll also work closely with our broader team as we develop our Arizona legal offering and processes.

What You’ll Work On

Following ABS approval, you may work on a broad mix of corporate and commercial matters, including:

  • Drafting and reviewing commercial contracts
  • Filing trademark applications
  • Services, consulting and vendor agreements
  • SaaS and technology agreements
  • NDAs, licensing and intellectual property agreements
  • Company formation and general corporate work
  • Shareholder and corporate governance matters
  • Startup fundraising and investment documents
  • Website terms and online business agreements
  • Privacy and data protection
  • Employment and independent contractor agreements
  • General commercial advice for startups and small businesses

We don’t handle litigation or disputes, so this is very much a transactional and advisory role.

You don’t need to be an expert in every area above. We’re much more interested in finding someone with strong corporate and commercial fundamentals who enjoys variety and wants to develop a broad practice.

Any client-facing legal-services responsibilities in this role will commence only after the required regulatory approval has been granted.

About You

You must be an active member in good standing of the State Bar of Arizona and authorized to practice law in Arizona.

You must also be based in Arizona, although you can live anywhere in the state. This is a remote role.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has around 2–4 years of legal experience
  • Has a good grounding in corporate and commercial law
  • Is comfortable managing straightforward legal work independently
  • Enjoys working directly with founders and business owners
  • Gives practical, commercial advice
  • Communicates clearly and can make complicated things easy for clients to understand
  • Is organized and comfortable managing multiple projects
  • Is comfortable working with technology
  • Takes ownership of their work
  • Enjoys working autonomously while still being part of a wider team

Experience working with startups, emerging companies or small businesses would be particularly useful.

Experience in technology, intellectual property, fundraising, privacy or employment would also be looked upon favorably.

We’re open to lawyers coming from private practice, in-house roles or a combination of the two.

Why Join Sprintlaw?

Our lawyers work across a high volume and variety of corporate and commercial projects for startups and small businesses. There are no billable hour targets or requirements to bring in your own clients, and you’ll have a high degree of autonomy in managing your work.

We’re a remote and flexible team, and have been operating this way across our international businesses for years.

You’ll also be joining at an early stage of our Arizona operations. As the team grows, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and get involved in developing our legal services and operations in Arizona.

You’ll get:

  • $90,000–$110,000 USD base salary, depending on experience
  • A fully remote role from anywhere in Arizona
  • No billable hour targets
  • No requirement to bring in new clients
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Exposure to a broad range of corporate and commercial work following ABS approval
  • Direct client contact following ABS approval and completion of applicable onboarding requirements
  • Significant autonomy over your work
  • The opportunity to be one of our early Arizona hires
  • An international team across Arizona, Australia and the UK
  • Health insurance
  • Work-from-home allowance
  • Coworking membership
  • Generous sick leave benefits

We’re a fully distributed team and offer genuine flexibility around where and when you work. You can work remotely from anywhere in Arizona, with the option to use a coworking space if you prefer.

We don’t have fixed office hours, but you’ll need to be available for clients and the team when required and manage your workload and deadlines effectively.

Application

If you’re an Arizona lawyer who enjoys working with businesses, wants exposure to a broad range of commercial work and likes the idea of helping us build something new in Arizona, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Work Model: 100% Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Billing / Finance

Build Your Career With Alia Services

Alia Services connects talented professionals with growing companies around the world. We specialize in remote recruitment, workforce, and payroll solutions, helping organizations build exceptional teams while creating meaningful career opportunities for professionals.

We're looking for an experienced Billing Coordinator (Billing Coordinator III) who understands the complete billing lifecycle and is comfortable taking ownership of complex orders, invoice discrepancies, vendor documentation, and billing-related financial processes.

If you're detail-oriented, confident working with high-volume financial data, and enjoy investigating problems and finding solutions, this could be a great opportunity to continue developing your career in Billing and Finance Operations.

Why Join Alia Services?

At Alia Services, we want our team members to feel supported throughout their employment while having opportunities to grow professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to:

  • 100% Remote Work – Work from the comfort of your home while collaborating with an international team and client.
  • Health Insurance – Health insurance coverage provided through SafetyWing, beginning as soon as you are hired.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Enjoy paid time off to rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • Reliable Payroll – Consistent payroll administration and support from the Alia Services team.
  • Dedicated HR Support – Access to our People Operations team for employment-related questions, support, and guidance throughout your time with us.
  • Professional Growth – Opportunities to develop your skills, gain international experience, and grow professionally.
  • Coaching & Feedback – One-on-one coaching, ongoing feedback, mentorship, and development opportunities.
  • International Experience – Gain valuable experience working remotely with international companies and teams.
  • Cross-Functional Development – Opportunities to expand your knowledge and gain exposure to different areas of the business.
  • Equipment Coordination – Equipment support and coordination may be available depending on the position and client requirements.
  • Ongoing Employee Support – From onboarding through your day-to-day employment, Alia Services serves as your dedicated partner throughout your experience with the client.

With Alia Services, you're not just being placed in a remote role we remain part of your employment journey, providing ongoing HR, payroll, benefits, and professional support while you grow in your career.

About the Role

As a Billing Coordinator, you will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end billing process, from vendor invoice review and order progression through customer invoicing and financial reconciliation.

This is not simply a data-entry billing position. You'll independently manage orders, investigate discrepancies, resolve billing issues, communicate with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure invoices are processed accurately and on time.

You'll also serve as an experienced resource for the team, helping resolve complex billing situations, supporting newer team members, and contributing to process and system improvements.

Success in this position requires strong attention to detail, financial accuracy, problem-solving ability, Excel proficiency, and the confidence to independently investigate and resolve billing issues.

What You'll Do

Billing & Invoice Management

  • Manage the end-to-end billing process, including vendor invoice flow, order progression, and customer invoicing
  • Independently manage the invoicing of assigned orders from review through completion
  • Review vendor invoices and credit memos for accuracy and resolve discrepancies whenever possible
  • Process and review various order types, including regular, drop ship, release, e-commerce, and program orders
  • Review daily open-order reports and take appropriate action to resolve holds, obtain documentation, and close orders
  • Prepare and process billing-related financial documents, including invoices, pre-bills, early invoices, budget invoices, and manually generated invoices
  • Support invoice revisions, credit memos, requisitions, and other billing adjustments
  • Ensure consistent invoicing practices while meeting established billing KPIs, productivity expectations, and deadlines

Order & Financial Analysis

  • Review order details, vendor documentation, costs, selling prices, volume, margins, and other financial information to ensure billing accuracy
  • Investigate discrepancies involving vendor invoices, customer invoices, order information, or payment-related documentation
  • Process and validate order changes, including adjustments to:
    • Cost and selling price
    • Freight and shipping charges
    • Vendors
    • Partially invoiced or partially processed orders
    • Cancellations
    • Commission-related information
  • Understand how billing activities impact vendor payments, customer invoices, margins, and commissions
  • Validate shipping and freight charges and determine whether orders meet requirements for hold release
  • Support sales tax validation and review applicable tax calculations based on customer or transaction location
  • Reconstruct complex orders and billing activity when necessary to identify and correct discrepancies

ERP, Vouching & Billing Systems

  • Work confidently within the company's Billing ERP and related financial systems
  • Process and review various voucher types, including invoices, samples, vendor prepayments, credits, and manual entries
  • Accurately code manual billing and financial entries
  • Understand billing-related and non-billing-related sales order holds, including when holds can be released and when escalation is required
  • Complete master and reverse-master supplier orders, including freight calculations, allocations, and balancing
  • Process specialized vendor transactions and ensure entries are properly reconciled
  • Utilize reporting and shared-resource tools to research and resolve billing issues

Communication & Issue Resolution

  • Maintain direct and professional communication with Account Executives, vendors, Finance, and other internal departments
  • Independently diagnose billing issues based on internal, vendor, or Account Executive correspondence
  • Provide efficient, accurate resolutions whenever possible
  • Escalate complex invoicing issues with clear context, supporting documentation, and recommended next steps
  • Maintain ownership of escalated issues through final resolution
  • Handle complex Account Executive requests and provide appropriate billing guidance
  • Identify recurring issues or trends and communicate them to team leadership

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Prepare and maintain Excel spreadsheets used for billing operations, reconciliation, order auditing, and reporting
  • Review billing and spoilage requests for accurate financial and GL coding
  • Support credit memo and invoice requisition processes
  • Participate actively in team meetings by identifying trends, discussing exceptions, and recommending solutions
  • Collaborate with team members and leadership to identify opportunities for process and system improvements
  • Maintain accurate documentation and follow established billing procedures

Team & Leadership Support

  • Serve as an experienced resource for other members of the Billing team
  • Proactively assist teammates with workloads and complex billing situations
  • Provide front-line guidance and support when needed
  • Support new hires by coordinating with trainers and assisting with onboarding and training activities
  • Help provide departmental overviews and process education to employees outside of the Billing function
  • Provide constructive observations and performance feedback to team leadership when appropriate
  • Perform additional billing and operational responsibilities based on business needs

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 18–24+ months of professional Billing experience or equivalent industry experience
  • Ability to independently manage the invoicing of orders
  • Previous experience with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Finance Operations, or a related function
  • Strong understanding of billing and invoicing processes
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook
  • Strong computer skills and ability to learn new ERP and financial systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and work effectively under deadline pressure
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Professional and solution-oriented approach to internal and external communication
  • Flexibility to work overtime when business needs require it

Data Entry Requirements

  • Typing speed of approximately 40+ WPM
  • Strong numerical and 10-key data-entry skills
  • Ability to process high volumes of financial information accurately and efficiently

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of Billing, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, or Finance Operations experience
  • Experience working in a corporate or B2B billing environment
  • Experience with ERP or financial management systems
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel experience
  • Experience handling complex invoice discrepancies, credits, order changes, and reconciliations
  • Understanding of margins, commissions, freight, sales tax, and other components of the revenue cycle
  • Experience working with high-volume transactions or customer accounts
  • Previous experience mentoring, training, or supporting junior team members

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You'll be a strong fit if you're someone who doesn't simply process an invoice and move on. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, investigate discrepancies, and make sure the entire transaction is accurate before it is completed.

You're comfortable working with detailed financial information, navigating multiple systems, communicating with different departments, and taking ownership of an issue until it's resolved.

You're also someone your teammates can rely on. You're willing to share your knowledge, help troubleshoot difficult situations, and contribute ideas that make the billing process more accurate and efficient.

Ready for Your Next Opportunity?

If you have experience in Billing, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, or Finance Operations and you're ready for a role where you can take greater ownership of complex billing processes, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your career with Alia Services.

jobs.excerpt: Company SummaryLearning Network is a growing, innovative, and customer-centric educational services company.
jobs.description:
Company Summary

Learning Network is a growing, innovative, and customer-centric educational services company. We seek creative and tenacious individuals to help us drive success through service.

Service is very important to us. At Learning Network, you will be among people who care about their customers and colleagues. We prioritize service by ensuring the details are done and done well - every time. We make promises, and we keep those promises. We recognize that our customers and employees don’t have to choose us. As such, service is embedded deep within our culture - and providing white-glove service is an expectation of every employee.

At Learning Network, you’ll be a part of something special. You’ll sleep better knowing you make a difference by bringing the most innovative education to thousands of students. You’ll do this amongst a supportive community of people who care. In return, you’ll care. You’ll show you care by being teachable, doing your job well, and valuing the relationships with your colleagues. You’ll achieve your goals and play nicely in the sandbox with others while doing it. We don’t do drama, and neither should you.

Working at Learning Network isn’t for everyone. But for those who choose to commit to hard work, service, students, and colleagues, it’s an incredibly rewarding experience.

Impact & Why This Matters

In a world where too many students feel unseen, disconnected, or left behind—whether due to distance, circumstance, or doubt—you will be their consistent champion.

Every proactive outreach, personalized video feedback, and timely intervention has the power to restore belief, spark 'I can do this' moments, accelerate mastery, and set a young person on a trajectory toward post-high school success, meaningful careers, and purposeful lives—whether through college, skilled trades, certifications, apprenticeships, entrepreneurship, or other paths that align with their unique strengths and dreams.

This isn’t routine teaching. It's legacy-building in the digital age: redefining what’s possible in education by delivering white-glove, heart-centered support that reaches students anywhere and empowers them to own their futures—one empowered learner at a time.

Purpose

You will be the daily force that ignites curiosity, rebuilds confidence, and unlocks lifelong potential in every student. You will find ways to open doors for students. You will champion personalized success through relentless engagement, clear guidance, and unwavering belief—delivering transformative, white-glove service that changes trajectories for students and families alike.

Role Overview

This is a deeply student-facing, relationship-driven role where your impact hinges on daily human connection. You'll reach out consistently via phone, text, chat, Zoom, and email while guiding learners through a powerful, structured curriculum.

Your success is measured in both key performance indicators like engagement rates and on-pace progress and in lives changed: students who re-engage after setbacks, gain confidence through meaningful feedback, stay on pace toward graduation, and emerge more resilient and capable.

It demands extreme ownership, lightning responsiveness, and joyful persistence because when you show up fully, students feel seen, valued, and unstoppable.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build unbreakable daily connections that keep students motivated, seen, and soaring, turning potential drop-offs into breakthroughs through caring, proactive outreach.
  • Guide learners through the curriculum with clarity and passion, reinforcing key concepts and helping them master material.
  • Monitor engagement and progress with eagle-eyed attention; spot struggling or disengaged students early and launch timely, personalized interventions that reignite momentum.
  • Deliver timely grading and powerful, meaningful feedback that reinforces learning, celebrates growth, builds self-efficacy, and equips students to conquer challenges with confidence.

Essential Duties

  1. Serve students, families, and colleagues with genuine professionalism, integrity, humility, and a white-glove mindset that makes every interaction feel personal and uplifting.
  2. Own daily monitoring of student engagement and academic progress; act swiftly and thoughtfully when support is needed most.
  3. Foster genuine relationships through consistent, reliable, multi-channel communication that makes students and families feel supported all day, every school day.
  4. Empower mastery of course material by guiding students with clarity, varied explanations, and encouragement that sparks deeper understanding.
  5. Provide prompt, high-quality grading and feedback that inspires forward movement and long-term growth.
  6. Keep precise, actionable records of progress and interventions to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  7. Collaborate enthusiastically with peers and leaders to amplify student success across the team.
  8. Engage fully in professional development, meetings, and training to continuously elevate your impact.
  9. Teach faithfully within the assigned curriculum, pacing, and resources only, channeling your creativity into masterful delivery rather than any creation from scratch or use of outside materials.
  10. Lead live sessions when called upon, bringing energy and connection using only provided content.
  11. Support proctoring during testing windows, including occasional travel, to ensure fair and secure assessments.
  12. Embrace other duties as needed to advance our mission.

Work Schedule and Availability

  1. Work a fixed schedule: 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Mountain Time (Denver/America), year-round, auto-adjusting for daylight saving time.
  2. Work full time in this exempt role, requiring at least 40 hours per week with uninterrupted focus during scheduled hours.
  3. Remain actively available and immediately responsive throughout the workday via phone, chat, Zoom, email, and internal systems so students, parents, and colleagues can reach you in real time.
  4. Avoid all concurrent work during scheduled hours and maintain full professional focus; ensure any outside employment does not interfere with performance and is approved in writing in advance.
  5. Maintain a private, professional, distraction-free remote workspace with reliable high-speed internet that supports video and required tools.
  6. Maintain consistent daily availability; absences exceeding two consecutive instructional days materially disrupt student support, engagement, and progress monitoring and generally cannot be accommodated during the instructional term.

This Role Is Your Calling If:

  • You wake up energized by the chance to be a consistent, believing adult in a student's life—especially when the world feels overwhelming.
  • You thrive on forging real relationships that spark "aha" moments, rebuild confidence, and drive lasting growth.
  • You're wired for excellence: self-driven, ultra-responsive, and proud to own every student's progress as if it were your own family member.
  • You see online education as a superpower—reaching underserved students anywhere, personalizing at scale, and redefining access to transformative learning.
  • You embrace clear structure, metrics, and accountability because they fuel your ability to deliver extraordinary results.

This Role May Not Align If:

  • You seek high flexibility in your schedule or a self-paced workday.
  • You prefer minimal direct interaction with students or parents.
  • You dislike proactive outreach such as phone calls or frequent messaging.
  • You expect primarily asynchronous teaching with limited real-time engagement.
  • You struggle with tight responsiveness, follow-through, or time management under metrics.
  • You want to balance this position with another job.
  • You resist oversight, performance tracking, or structured expectations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  1. Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly, empathetically, and professionally.
  2. Ability to build rapport, gain commitment, and explain concepts using varied methods.
  3. Extreme ownership of outcomes with high self-motivation, discipline, and accountability to exceed expectations.
  4. Proven content knowledge and prior educational success with students from a variety of backgrounds.
  5. Strong organizational skills, time management, attention to detail, and the ability to handle competing priorities.
  6. Independent work capability paired with effective remote team collaboration.
  7. Proficiency with Mac OS, Google Workspace, learning management systems, and task tools (e.g., Asana); quick adaptation to new technologies.
  8. Willingness and ability to travel to assigned testing locations for proctoring.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education or related field (required)
  • Teacher certification and an approved teacher preparation program (required)
  • Ability to obtain certifications in Arizona, Colorado, Washington, and other states as may be assigned (required)
  • 3+ years teaching experience (preferred)
  • 2+ years online teaching experience (preferred)
  • Ability to pass required background checks (required)

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision employee coverage for as little as $1 each per month;
  • Personal paid time off in addition to major holidays;
  • Short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and AD&D insurance are all 100% paid by the employer; and
  • 401(k) with employer contributing a dollar-for-dollar match of employee contributions up to 6% of employee earnings.
Base Pay Range
$50,000—$55,000 USD

jobs.description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Analytics team and focus on the supply side of SeatGeek's marketplace. You'll partner with stakeholders across the Supply organization, with extra focus on our seller and client-facing teams. Using advanced analytics, you'll turn raw data into insights that shape decisions, surface opportunities, and drive measurable results.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, knows how to connect business strategy to marketplace and product data, and has a passion for identifying the most meaningful opportunities to improve user and business outcomes. As a member of SeatGeek’s Analytics team, you will be able to collaborate with and learn from a group of high-performing analysts, data scientists, and engineers.

What you'll do

  • Develop a deep understanding of the live events business and how supply dynamics drive marketplace health
  • Partner with stakeholders on the Supply, Product, and Engineering teams, understanding their objectives and defining an analytics roadmap to support those goals
  • Guide seller policy decisions — such as fees, fulfillment standards, and seller performance requirements — by quantifying trade-offs up front and measuring impact after launch
  • Work directly with the Client Success and Entertainment teams that manage our relationships with sports teams and venues, identifying opportunities to maximize the value of our partnerships and help our clients grow their businesses
  • Equip account managers with data-driven insights to strengthen seller relationships and uncover growth opportunities
  • Leverage first-class AI dev tools to build out measurement frameworks, develop key reporting, and collaborate with engineers to drive rapid iteration of features, bringing ideas to life faster than ever before
  • Conduct exploratory and root-cause analysis to explain shifts in performance and surface pockets of opportunity for improvement
  • Translate complex analysis into clear, data-driven narratives and recommendations for internal leaders
  • Create or improve key datasets and contribute to our analytical tooling ecosystem (e.g. dbt, Hex) to ensure we can answer today’s questions and tomorrow’s

What you have

  • 4+ years of experience working in analytics, data science, or adjacent roles — preferably in tech, ecommerce marketplaces, or consumer products
  • Expert-level knowledge of SQL and experience performing analysis with large datasets
  • Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous problem spaces, from framing questions to delivering recommendations
  • Strong communication skills — able to simplify complex analyses, defend methodology choices, and inspire action through insights
  • Excited to contribute to a team culture centered around curiosity, humility, and impact
  • A track record of influencing business strategy with data
  • Nice-to-have: Domain expertise or past experience with a two sided marketplace

Our stack

You absolutely do not need experience with all of these, but we thought you might be curious. Tools can be learned, so we care much more about your general engineering skill than knowledge of a particular language.

  • Required languages: SQL (Python nice-to-have)
  • Data Warehouse: Redshift
  • Dashboarding: Looker & Hex
  • Version control: GitLab
  • AI tooling: Claude Code, Hex Agent
  • Scheduling/Orchestration: Airflow
  • ETL: Fivetran, Python and dbt
  • Event Stream: mParticle
  • Experimentation: Eppo
  • Product Analytics: Mixpanel

Perks

  • Equity stake
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
  • A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
  • 401(k) matching
  • Student loan matching program
  • Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
  • $500 per year for wellness expenses
  • Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
  • $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
  • Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

The salary range for this role is $108,000 - $157,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.

SeatGeek is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings. Come join us!

jobs.description:
Supplax — це американська компанія з українським серцем, яка вже понад 5 років активно розвивається на ринку. Ми виконуємо роль віддаленого бек-офісу для майстрів у США, що спеціалізуються на ремонтних роботах. Наша команда налічує понад 100 фахівцівта повністю бере на себе всі організаційні та операційні процеси, окрім самих ремонтних робіт. Серед них: маркетинг, продажі, управління командами майстрів, контроль якості, збір відгуків, навчання технічного персоналу тощо. Працюємо у 30+ найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 30 000 ремонтних проєктів.

Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням . Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відеовідгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.

Наша компанія стрімко вдосконалюється та зростає, тож зараз ми у пошуку активного Sales Manager у відділ B2B. Ти відповідатимеш за роботу з холодною базою контактів: встановлення першого контакту з потенційними B2B-клієнтами, виявлення їхніх потреб та формування зацікавленості для подальшої взаємодії.

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:
  • Повну зайнятість та п’ятиденний робочий тиждень.
  • Віддалений формат роботи.
  • Графік роботи: 16:00 — 01:00 за Києвом.
  • Повноцінне навчання та занурення у специфіку роботи.
  • Заробітну плату $800-$1000, складається зі ставки і бонусів, виплата в $.
  • Системну роботу з B2B клієнтами, а саме дизайнерами та контракторами.
  • Регулярну практику англійської мови з викладачем
  • Можливість швидко прокачати навички холодних дзвінків .
  • Кар'єрний ріст завдяки високим результатам роботи.
Твоя роль включає:
  • Активну роботу з холодними дзвінками (150+ дзвінків на день).
  • Ініціювання першого контакту з потенційними клієнтами та виявлення їхніх зацікавленості в співпраці.
  • Передача зацікавлених лідів на акаунт-менеджера.
Ти точно наш, якщо…
  • Маєш високий рівень розмовної англійської — не нижче C1 (або впевнений B2+ з регулярною практикою): позиція передбачає постійне спілкування з носіями мови.
  • Комфортно почуваєшся у холодних дзвінках та не боїшся активної комунікації.
  • Твоя зона комфорту — це багато розмов, ініціативність та робота на результат.
  • Умієш працювати у високому темпі.
  • Швидко навчаєшся та готовий постійно вдосконалювати свої навички холодних дзвінків.
Зацікавило? Відгукуйся та до зустрічі на співбесіді!

With a growing client base, they are now looking to strengthen their outbound sales function to drive new opportunities and support business growth.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Confidence in handling objections and navigating sales conversations
  • Experience working across multiple outreach channels (calls, email, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Strong ability to qualify leads effectively

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

South Africa)

Our client is a fast-growing short-term rental management company that launched just over two years ago. Today, we manage 75+ Airbnb units, with a clear roadmap to reach 100 units by the end of this year and 200+ units by the end of next year. Our mission is to
deliver exceptional guest experiences while scaling with precision and operational excellence.

The Role

We’re looking for a high-performing Operations Manager with a proven track record in Airbnb/short-term rental operations and hospitality management. This person will set the standard for our operations as we scale, lead our VA team effectively, and ensure the systems and processes are not only maintained but continuously improved.

    ● Revenue Manager
    ● Pricing Manager (Dynamic Pricing)
    ● Full-time Staffing & Furnishing Manager

● 3 Company Directors

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage our VA team (guest communications, scheduling, admin) to ensure top-tier performance.

    ● Maintain and improve operational systems and processes – suggest and implement better tools where needed.
    ● Work closely with leadership to uphold quality standards across all units.
    ● Oversee expense tracking, reporting, and accountability within the operations team.
    ● Ensure guest communication is optimized, balancing efficiency with 5-star guest experience.
    ● Collaborate with directors, revenue manager, and pricing manager to align operations with company growth targets.
    ● Drive a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.

What We Offer

  • A chance to join a fast-scaling property business with huge growth plans.
    ● Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with a driven leadership team.
    ● Opportunity to own and shape operations as we scale past 200+ units.
    ● Competitive pay aligned with experience.

● Fully remote, South Africa–based role.


Requirements

Short-term rental experience
Worked for another company like this and has ideas and suggestions for improvements & efficiency
Hospitality experience in operations management
Has managed 75 + units at a time
A few key areas I’m looking for in an Operations Manager:
Looking for someone who can take ownership of operations and run things with a high level of accountability — almost like a director
We need someone who can come in and ensure all processes are fully dialled in across the business.
The role needs someone who can:
Manage staff effectively and hold them accountable
Produce detailed performance reports, especially on guest services
Reassign and manage team priorities as things shift
Identify operational issues early and proactively resolve them
Build, refine, and enforce systems across the business
Lead and develop the team through training, expectations, and performance reviews
Provide strategic input and help drive the business as we scale
Maintain strong communication and give consistent reporting so nothing falls through the cracks
These areas are critical as they continue to grow quickly, so they need someone who can operate at a strong leadership level from day one.

Benefits

Autonomy
Ownership of the team and operations at the highest level in the company
A chance to scale a business
A Competitive salary
Incentives for achievement of goals on an annual basis - based on performance (company & individual)
Remote working
The chance to work for a growing UK business
